BESPOKE SAINTS ENGLISH — OLD TESTAMENT
Provisional reading manuscript · 12 November 2026
Inherited text with marked, unaccepted Greek-comparison proposals. Not a complete fresh Greek audit.
Unit markers preserve exact identity and support verification. Continuations retain their parent anchor; no verse number is invented.

=== Genesis ===

--- Genesis 1 ---

[UNIT genesis-section-1-v1-1]
Genesis 1:1 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
In the beginning God made heaven and earth.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-1-v1-2]
Genesis 1:2 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
Now the earth was unseen and unformed, and darkness was over the deep; and the Spirit of God was moving over the water.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-1-v1-3]
Genesis 1:3 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
And God said, “Let there be light.” And there was light.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-1-v1-4]
Genesis 1:4 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
And God saw that the light was good, and God divided the light from the darkness.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-1-v1-5]
Genesis 1:5 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
And God called the light Day, and the darkness He called Night. And there was evening, and there was morning: one day.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-1-v1-6]
Genesis 1:6 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
And God said, “Let there be a firmament in the midst of the water, and let it divide water from water.” And it was so.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-1-v1-7]
Genesis 1:7 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
And God made the firmament, and God divided the water beneath the firmament from the water above the firmament.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-1-v1-8]
Genesis 1:8 [COMPARED; RETAINED]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-1-v1-9]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-1-v1-10]
Genesis 1:10 [COMPARED; RETAINED]

[UNIT genesis-section-1-v1-11]

[UNIT genesis-section-1-v1-21]

[UNIT genesis-section-1-v1-25]
Genesis 1:25 [UNACCEPTED PROPOSAL]
And God made the wild beasts of the earth according to their kind, and the cattle according to their kind, and all the creeping things of the earth according to their kind. And God saw that they were good.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-1-v1-26]
Genesis 1:26 [COMPARED; RETAINED]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-1-v1-27]
Genesis 1:27 [COMPARED; RETAINED]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-1-v1-28]
Genesis 1:28 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
And God blessed them, saying, “Grow and multiply, and fill the earth and subdue it. Rule over the fish of the sea, the birds of heaven, all the cattle, all the earth, and every creeping thing that creeps upon the earth.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-1-v1-29]
Genesis 1:29 [COMPARED; RETAINED]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-1-v1-30]
Genesis 1:30 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
And to every wild beast of the earth, every bird of heaven, and every creeping thing upon the earth that has life within it, I have given every green plant for food.” And it was so.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-1-v1-31]
Genesis 1:31 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
And God saw all that He had made, and behold, it was very good. And there was evening, and there was morning: a sixth day.
[/UNIT]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-2-v2-2]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-2-v2-3]
Genesis 2:3 [COMPARED; RETAINED]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-2-v2-4]
Genesis 2:4 [COMPARED; RETAINED]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-2-v2-5]
Genesis 2:5 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
and every green plant of the field before it appeared upon the earth, and every plant of the field before it sprang up. For God had not sent rain upon the earth, and there was no man to till the ground.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-2-v2-6]
Genesis 2:6 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
But a spring rose from the earth and watered the whole face of the ground.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-2-v2-7]
Genesis 2:7 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
And God formed man from the dust of the earth, and breathed into his face the breath of life; and man became a living soul.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-2-v2-8]
Genesis 2:8 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
And the Lord God planted a garden in Eden, toward the east, and there He placed the man whom He had formed.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-2-v2-9]
Genesis 2:9 [UNACCEPTED PROPOSAL]
And God also caused every tree that was beautiful to behold and good for food to spring up from the earth, with the tree of life in the midst of the garden, and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-2-v2-10]
Genesis 2:10 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
And a river flows out of Eden to water the garden, and from there it divides into four branches.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-2-v2-11]
Genesis 2:11 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
The name of the first is Pishon; it flows around the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-2-v2-12]
Genesis 2:12 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
And the gold of that land is good; there also are the carbuncle and the green stone.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-2-v2-13]
Genesis 2:13 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
The name of the second river is Gihon; it flows around the whole land of Ethiopia.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-2-v2-14]
Genesis 2:14 [COMPARED; RETAINED]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-2-v2-15]
Genesis 2:15 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
And the Lord God took the man whom He had formed and placed him in the garden, to tend it and keep it.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-2-v2-16]
Genesis 2:16 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
And the Lord God commanded Adam, saying, “You may freely eat from every tree in the garden;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-2-v2-17]
Genesis 2:17 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
but from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil you shall not eat. For on the day you eat from it, you shall surely die.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-2-v2-18]
Genesis 2:18 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
And the Lord God said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. Let Us make him a helper corresponding to him.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-2-v2-19]
Genesis 2:19 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
And God also formed from the earth every wild beast of the field and every bird of heaven, and brought them to Adam to see what he would call them. And whatever Adam called each living creature, that was its name.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-2-v2-20]
Genesis 2:20 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
And Adam gave names to all the cattle, all the birds of heaven, and all the wild beasts of the field. But for Adam no helper like himself was found.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-2-v2-21]
Genesis 2:21 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
And God cast a deep sleep upon Adam, and he slept. And He took one of his ribs and filled its place with flesh.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-2-v2-22]
Genesis 2:22 [UNACCEPTED PROPOSAL]
And the Lord God built the rib He had taken from Adam into a woman, and brought her to Adam.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-2-v2-23]
Genesis 2:23 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
And Adam said: This, at last, is bone of my bones and flesh of my flesh. She shall be called Woman, for she was taken from her husband.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-2-v2-24]
Genesis 2:24 [COMPARED; RETAINED]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-2-v2-25]
Genesis 2:25 [COMPARED; RETAINED]

[/UNIT]

--- Genesis 3 ---

[UNIT genesis-section-3-v3-1]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-3-v3-2]
Genesis 3:2 [COMPARED; RETAINED]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-3-v3-3]
Genesis 3:3 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
But of the fruit of the tree in the midst of the garden, God said, ‘You shall not eat of it, nor shall you touch it, lest you die.’”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-3-v3-4]
Genesis 3:4 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
And the serpent said to the woman, “You shall surely not die.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-3-v3-5]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-3-v3-6]
Genesis 3:6 [COMPARED; RETAINED]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-3-v3-7]
Genesis 3:7 [UNACCEPTED PROPOSAL]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-3-v3-8]
Genesis 3:8 [COMPARED; RETAINED]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-3-v3-9]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-3-v3-10]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-3-v3-11]

[UNIT genesis-section-3-v3-12]

[UNIT genesis-section-3-v3-13]
Genesis 3:13 [COMPARED; RETAINED]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-3-v3-14]
Genesis 3:14 [COMPARED; RETAINED]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-3-v3-15]
Genesis 3:15 [COMPARED; RETAINED]

[UNIT genesis-section-3-v3-16]
Genesis 3:16 [COMPARED; RETAINED]

[UNIT genesis-section-3-v3-17]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-3-v3-18]
Genesis 3:18 [COMPARED; RETAINED]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-3-v3-19]

[/UNIT]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-3-v3-21]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-3-v3-22]

--- Genesis 4 ---

[UNIT genesis-section-4-v4-1]
Genesis 4:1
Now Adam knew Eve his wife, and she conceived and bore Cain, and said, “I have gained a man through God.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-4-v4-2]
Genesis 4:2
And again she bore his brother Abel. And Abel became a shepherd of sheep, but Cain tilled the earth.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-4-v4-3]
Genesis 4:3
And after some time Cain brought an offering to the Lord from the fruits of the earth.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-4-v4-4]
Genesis 4:4
And Abel also brought an offering from the firstborn of his sheep and from their fat. And God looked with favour upon Abel and his gifts,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-4-v4-5]
Genesis 4:5
but He gave no heed to Cain and his offerings. And Cain was greatly distressed, and his face fell.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-4-v4-6]
Genesis 4:6
And the Lord God said to Cain, “Why are you so distressed, and why has your face fallen?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-4-v4-7]
Genesis 4:7
If you offer rightly but do not divide rightly, have you not sinned? Be still. His turning shall be toward you, and you shall rule over him.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-4-v4-8]
Genesis 4:8
And Cain said to Abel his brother, “Let us go out into the field.” And while they were in the field, Cain rose against Abel his brother and slew him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-4-v4-9]
Genesis 4:9
And God said to Cain, “Where is Abel your brother?” And he said, “I do not know. Am I my brother’s keeper?”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-4-v4-10]
Genesis 4:10
And God said, “What have you done? The voice of your brother’s blood cries unto Me from the earth.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-4-v4-11]
Genesis 4:11
And now you are cursed from the earth, which opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-4-v4-12]
Genesis 4:12
When you till the earth, it shall no longer yield its strength to you. You shall be groaning and trembling upon the earth.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-4-v4-13]
Genesis 4:13
And Cain said to the Lord, “My guilt is too great for me to be forgiven.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-4-v4-14]
Genesis 4:14
If Thou dost cast me out this day from the face of the earth, I shall be hidden from Thy face; and I shall be groaning and trembling upon the earth, and whoever finds me shall slay me.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-4-v4-15]
Genesis 4:15
And the Lord God said to him, “Not so. Whoever slays Cain shall incur sevenfold vengeance.” And the Lord God set a mark upon Cain, that no one finding him should slay him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-4-v4-16]
Genesis 4:16
And Cain went out from the face of God and dwelt in the land of Nod, opposite Eden.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-4-v4-17]
Genesis 4:17
And Cain knew his wife, and she conceived and bore Enoch. And he was building a city, and named the city after his son Enoch.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-4-v4-18]
Genesis 4:18
And to Enoch was born Gaidad; and Gaidad begot Maiel; and Maiel begot Methuselah; and Methuselah begot Lamech.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-4-v4-19]
Genesis 4:19
And Lamech took two wives. The name of the first was Adah, and the name of the second was Zillah.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-4-v4-20]
Genesis 4:20
And Adah bore Jabal; he was the father of those who dwell in tents and keep livestock.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-4-v4-21]
Genesis 4:21
His brother’s name was Jubal; he introduced the psaltery and the lyre.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-4-v4-22]
Genesis 4:22
And Zillah also bore Thobel, a smith who worked bronze and iron with the hammer. And Thobel’s sister was Naamah.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-4-v4-23]
Genesis 4:23
And Lamech said to his wives: Adah and Zillah, hear my voice; wives of Lamech, give ear to my words. For I have slain a man to my own hurt, and a young man to my own bruising.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-4-v4-24]
Genesis 4:24
For Cain has been avenged sevenfold, but Lamech seventy times seven.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-4-v4-25]
Genesis 4:25
And Adam knew Eve his wife, and she conceived and bore a son, and named him Seth, saying, “For God has raised up another seed for me in place of Abel, whom Cain slew.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT genesis-section-4-v4-26]
Genesis 4:26
And to Seth also a son was born, and he named him Enosh. He hoped to call upon the name of the Lord God.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-21-v21-7]

[UNIT exodus-section-21-v21-11]

[UNIT exodus-section-21-v21-16]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-21-v21-17]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-21-v21-18]
Exodus 21:18

[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-21-v21-19]
Exodus 21:19
if the man rises and walks outside with a staff, the one who struck him shall be guiltless; only he shall pay for his lost labour and his healing.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-21-v21-20]
Exodus 21:20
And if a man strikes his male slave or his female slave with a rod, and the slave dies under his hands, he shall surely be avenged by judgment.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-21-v21-21]
Exodus 21:21
But if the slave survives a day or two, he shall not be avenged; for he is his silver.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-21-v21-22]
Exodus 21:22
And if two men fight and strike a woman with child, and her child comes out not fully formed, he shall surely be fined; as the woman’s husband shall impose on him, he shall pay according to an assessment.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-21-v21-23]
Exodus 21:23
But if it was fully formed, he shall give life for life,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-21-v21-24]
Exodus 21:24
eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-21-v21-25]
Exodus 21:25
burn for burn, wound for wound, bruise for bruise.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-21-v21-26]
Exodus 21:26
And if a man strikes the eye of his household slave or of his female slave, and blinds it, he shall set them free for their eye.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-21-v21-27]
Exodus 21:27
And if he knocks out the tooth of his household slave or of his female slave, he shall set them free for their tooth.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-21-v21-28]
Exodus 21:28
And if a bull gores a man or a woman, and the person dies, the bull shall surely be stoned, and its flesh shall not be eaten; but the owner of the bull shall be guiltless.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-21-v21-29]
Exodus 21:29
But if the bull was in the habit of goring before, and its owner has been warned, and he does not remove it, and it kills a man or a woman, the bull shall be stoned, and its owner also shall die.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-21-v21-30]
Exodus 21:30
But if a ransom is imposed on him, he shall give for the ransom of his life all that they impose on him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-21-v21-31]
Exodus 21:31
Whether it gores a son or a daughter, they shall deal with him according to this ordinance.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-21-v21-32]
Exodus 21:32
And if the bull gores a male slave or a female slave, he shall give thirty didrachmas of silver to their master, and the bull shall be stoned.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-21-v21-33]
Exodus 21:33
And if a man opens a pit, or hews out a pit, and does not cover it, and a calf or donkey falls in it,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-21-v21-34]
Exodus 21:34
the owner of the pit shall make restitution. He shall give silver to the animal’s owner, and the dead animal shall be his.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-21-v21-35]
Exodus 21:35
And if a man’s bull gores his neighbour’s bull, and it dies, they shall sell the living bull and divide its silver; and they shall also divide the dead bull.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-21-v21-36]
Exodus 21:36
But if the bull is known to have been in the habit of goring before, and its owner has been warned, and he does not remove it, he shall repay bull for bull; and the dead bull shall be his.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-21-v21-37]
Exodus 21:37
And if a man steals a calf or a sheep, and slaughters it or sells it, he shall repay five calves for the calf, and four sheep for the sheep.”
[/UNIT]

--- Exodus 22 ---

[UNIT exodus-section-22-v22-1]
Exodus 22:1
“And if the thief is found breaking in, and is struck and dies, there is no murder in his case.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-22-v22-2]
Exodus 22:2
But if the sun has risen upon him, he is guilty; he shall die in return. And if he has nothing, let him be sold for the theft.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-22-v22-3]
Exodus 22:3
But if he is caught, and the stolen thing is found alive in his hand, from donkey to sheep, he shall repay them double.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-22-v22-4]
Exodus 22:4
And if a man grazes a field or a vineyard, and lets his beast graze another field, he shall repay from his own field according to its yield; but if it grazes the whole field, he shall repay the best of his field and the best of his vineyard.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-22-v22-5]
Exodus 22:5
And if fire breaks out and catches thorns, and burns a threshing floor, or standing grain, or a plain, he who kindled the fire shall make restitution.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-22-v22-6]
Exodus 22:6
And if a man gives his neighbour silver or goods to keep, and they are stolen from the man’s house, if the thief is found, he shall repay double.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-22-v22-7]
Exodus 22:7
But if the thief is not found, the master of the house shall come before God and swear that he has not dealt wickedly with any of his neighbour’s deposit.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-22-v22-8]
Exodus 22:8
In every alleged wrong concerning a calf, beast of burden, sheep, garment, or any disputed loss, whatever it may be, the case of both parties shall come before God. Whoever is convicted through God shall repay his neighbour double.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-22-v22-9]
Exodus 22:9
And if a man gives his neighbour a beast of burden, or a calf, or a sheep, or any beast to keep, and it is injured, or dies, or is taken captive, and no one knows,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-22-v22-10]
Exodus 22:10
an oath by God shall be between them that he has not acted dishonestly concerning any of his neighbour’s deposit. The owner shall accept it, and he shall not make restitution.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-22-v22-11]
Exodus 22:11
But if it was stolen from him, he shall make restitution to its owner.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-22-v22-12]
Exodus 22:12
If it was taken by a wild animal, he shall bring the owner to the prey, and he shall not make restitution.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-22-v22-13]
Exodus 22:13
And if a man borrows from his neighbour, and it is injured, or dies, or is taken captive, and its owner is not with it, he shall make restitution.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-22-v22-14]
Exodus 22:14
But if its owner is with it, he shall not make restitution; and if it is hired, it shall be reckoned against its hire.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-22-v22-15]
Exodus 22:15
And if a man deceives a virgin who is not betrothed, and lies with her, he shall surely give the marriage payment for her to be his wife.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-22-v22-16]
Exodus 22:16
But if her father firmly refuses, and is unwilling to give her to him as a wife, he shall pay silver to the father according to the marriage payment for virgins.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-22-v22-17]
Exodus 22:17
You shall not preserve sorcerers alive.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-22-v22-18]
Exodus 22:18
Everyone who lies with a beast, you shall surely put to death.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-22-v22-19]
Exodus 22:19
He who sacrifices to gods, except to the Lord alone, shall surely be destroyed.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-22-v22-20]
Exodus 22:20
And you shall not ill-treat a resident foreigner, neither shall you afflict him; for you were resident foreigners in the land of Egypt.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-22-v22-21]
Exodus 22:21
You shall not mistreat any widow or orphan.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-22-v22-22]
Exodus 22:22
But if you afflict them, and they cry aloud to Me, I will surely listen to their voice,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-22-v22-23]
Exodus 22:23
I will be angry with wrath and kill you with the sword. Your wives will become widows and your children orphans.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-22-v22-24]
Exodus 22:24
And if you lend silver to your poor brother beside you, you shall not press him hard, neither shall you lay interest upon him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-22-v22-25]
Exodus 22:25
And if you take your neighbour’s garment in pledge, you shall restore it to him before the setting of the sun;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-22-v22-26]
Exodus 22:26
for this is his covering, his only garment for his nakedness; What shall he sleep in? If therefore he cries to Me, I will listen to him; for I am merciful.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-22-v22-27]
Exodus 22:27
You shall not revile gods, neither shall you speak evil of the rulers of your people.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-22-v22-28]
Exodus 22:28
You shall not delay the firstfruits of your threshing floor and your winepress; you shall give Me the firstborn of your sons.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-22-v22-29]
Exodus 22:29
You shall do the same with your calf, and your sheep, and your beast of burden; it shall be under its mother for seven days, and on the eighth day you shall give it to Me.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-22-v22-30]
Exodus 22:30
You shall be holy people to Me. You shall not eat flesh taken by wild animals; throw it to the dog.”
[/UNIT]

--- Exodus 23 ---

[UNIT exodus-section-23-v23-1]
Exodus 23:1
“You shall not receive an empty report. You shall not agree with the unrighteous to become an unrighteous witness.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-23-v23-2]
Exodus 23:2
You shall not join the many in evil; neither shall you join a multitude in turning aside with the many, to turn aside judgment.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-23-v23-3]
Exodus 23:3
Neither shall you favour a poor man in judgment.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-23-v23-4]
Exodus 23:4
And if you meet your enemy’s ox or his beast of burden wandering, you shall surely turn it back and restore it to him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-23-v23-5]
Exodus 23:5
And if you see your enemy’s beast of burden fallen beneath its load, you shall not pass it by; but you shall raise it up together with him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-23-v23-6]
Exodus 23:6
You shall not pervert the judgment of a poor man in his cause.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-23-v23-7]
Exodus 23:7
You shall keep far away from every unrighteous charge; the innocent and the righteous you shall not kill, neither shall you justify the ungodly for gifts.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-23-v23-8]
Exodus 23:8
And you shall receive no gifts; for gifts blind the eyes of those who see, and corrupt righteous words.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-23-v23-9]
Exodus 23:9
And you shall not afflict a resident foreigner; for you know the soul of the resident foreigner, since you yourselves were resident foreigners in the land of Egypt.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-23-v23-10]
Exodus 23:10
For six years you shall sow your land, and gather its produce;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-23-v23-11]
Exodus 23:11
but in the seventh you shall grant it release, and leave it; and the poor of your nation shall eat, and what they leave the wild beasts shall eat. You shall do the same with your vineyard and your olive grove.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-23-v23-12]
Exodus 23:12
For six days you shall do your works, but on the seventh day there shall be rest, that your ox and your beast of burden may rest, and that the son of your female slave and the resident foreigner may be refreshed.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-23-v23-13]
Exodus 23:13
Keep everything I have said to you. Do not call to mind the name of other gods or let it be heard from your mouth.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-23-v23-14]
Exodus 23:14
Three times a year you shall keep a feast to Me.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-23-v23-15]
Exodus 23:15
Keep the feast of unleavened bread; for seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the appointed time in the month of new grain; for in it you came out of Egypt. You shall not appear before Me empty-handed.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-23-v23-16]
Exodus 23:16
And you shall keep the feast of harvest, of the firstfruits of your labours which you sow in your field; and the feast of completion as the year goes out, when you gather your labours out of your field.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-23-v23-17]
Exodus 23:17
Every male of yours shall appear three times in the year before the Lord your God.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-23-v23-18]
Exodus 23:18
For when I cast out nations before you, and enlarge your borders, you shall not sacrifice the blood of My offering with leaven, neither shall the fat of My feast remain until morning.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-23-v23-19]
Exodus 23:19
You shall bring the firstfruits of the first produce of your land into the house of the Lord your God. You shall not boil a lamb in its mother’s milk.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-23-v23-20]
Exodus 23:20
And behold, I send My angel before your face, to keep you in the way, that he may bring you into the land which I have prepared for you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-23-v23-21]
Exodus 23:21
Take care, and listen to him, and do not disobey him; for he shall not yield before you, for My name is upon him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-23-v23-22]
Exodus 23:22
If you diligently listen to My voice, and you do all that I command you, and you keep My covenant, you shall be to Me a treasured people from among all the nations; for all the earth is Mine, and you shall be to Me a royal priesthood and a holy nation. You shall say these words to the sons of Israel: ‘If you diligently listen to My voice, and you do all that I say to you, I will be an enemy to your enemies, and oppose those who oppose you.’
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-23-v23-23]
Exodus 23:23
For My angel shall go before you, and bring you to the Amorite, and Hittite, and Perizzite, and Canaanite, and Girgashite, and Hivite, and Jebusite; and I will destroy them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-23-v23-24]
Exodus 23:24
You shall not bow down to their gods, neither shall you serve them, nor do according to their works; but you shall utterly overthrow them, and utterly shatter their pillars.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-23-v23-25]
Exodus 23:25
And you shall serve the Lord your God, and I will bless your bread, and your wine, and your water; and I will turn sickness away from you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-23-v23-26]
Exodus 23:26
None shall be unfruitful or barren in your land; I will fulfil the number of your days.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-23-v23-27]
Exodus 23:27
And I will send fear before you, and confound all the nations among whom you come; and I will make all your adversaries fugitives.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-23-v23-28]
Exodus 23:28
And I will send hornets before you, and they shall drive out the Amorites, and Hivites, and Canaanites, and Hittites from before you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-23-v23-29]
Exodus 23:29
I will not drive them out in one year, lest the land become desolate, and the beasts of the land multiply against you;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-23-v23-30]
Exodus 23:30
little by little I will drive them out from before you, until you increase and inherit the land.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-23-v23-31]
Exodus 23:31
And I will set your borders from the Red Sea to the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the great river Euphrates; and I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hands, and cast them out from before you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-23-v23-32]
Exodus 23:32
You shall make no covenant with them, nor with their gods;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT exodus-section-23-v23-33]
Exodus 23:33
neither shall they dwell in your land, lest they cause you to sin against Me; for if you serve their gods, these shall be a stumbling block to you.”
[/UNIT]

[/UNIT]

[/UNIT]

[/UNIT]

--- Leviticus 1 ---

[UNIT leviticus-section-1-v1-2]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-1-v1-3]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-1-v1-4]
Leviticus 1:4

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-1-v1-5]
Leviticus 1:5
And they shall slaughter the calf before the Lord; and the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall bring the blood, and pour the blood round about upon the altar which is at the doors of the Tent of Testimony.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-1-v1-6]
Leviticus 1:6
And when they have skinned the whole burnt offering, they shall divide it limb by limb.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-1-v1-7]

And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall put fire upon the altar, and pile wood upon the fire.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-1-v1-8]
Leviticus 1:8
And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall pile the divided parts, and the head, and the fat upon the wood upon the fire which is upon the altar.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-1-v1-9]
Leviticus 1:9
But they shall wash the entrails and the feet with water; and the priests shall place all upon the altar. It is an offering, a sacrifice, a sweet savour unto the Lord.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-1-v1-10]
Leviticus 1:10
And if his gift unto the Lord is from the flock, from lambs and young goats, for a whole burnt offering, he shall bring an unblemished male, and lay his hand upon its head.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-1-v1-11]
Leviticus 1:11
And they shall slaughter it at the north side of the altar before the Lord; and the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall pour its blood round about upon the altar.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-1-v1-12]
Leviticus 1:12
And they shall divide it limb by limb, with the head and the fat; and the priests shall pile them upon the wood upon the fire which is upon the altar.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-1-v1-13]
Leviticus 1:13
And they shall wash the entrails and the feet with water; and the priest shall bring all, and place it upon the altar. It is an offering, a sacrifice, a sweet savour unto the Lord.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-1-v1-14]
Leviticus 1:14
And if you bring an offering of birds as a gift unto the Lord, he shall bring his gift from the turtledoves or the pigeons.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-1-v1-15]
Leviticus 1:15
And the priest shall bring it unto the altar, and pinch off the head; and the priest shall place it upon the altar, and drain the blood at the base of the altar.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-1-v1-16]
Leviticus 1:16
And he shall remove the crop with the feathers, and cast it beside the altar toward the east, into the place of the ashes.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-1-v1-17]
Leviticus 1:17
And he shall break it open by its wings, but shall not divide it; and the priest shall place it upon the altar, upon the wood upon the fire. It is an offering, a sacrifice, a sweet savour unto the Lord.
[/UNIT]

And the priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of whole burning; and he shall pour out all its blood beside the base of the altar of whole burning.

[UNIT leviticus-section-4-v4-35]
Leviticus 4:35
And he shall remove all its fat, as the fat of a sheep is removed from the sacrifice of deliverance; and the priest shall place it upon the altar, upon the whole burnt offering of the Lord. And the priest shall make atonement for him for the sin which he has committed, and he shall be forgiven.
[/UNIT]

--- Leviticus 5 ---

[UNIT leviticus-section-5-v5-1]
Leviticus 5:1
And if a soul sins, and hears the voice of a solemn adjuration, and he is a witness, whether he has seen or has knowledge of the matter, if he does not declare it, he shall bear the sin.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-5-v5-2]
Leviticus 5:2
Or if a soul touches any unclean thing, whether a dead thing, or an unclean thing torn by wild beasts, or one of the dead things, or one of the unclean abominations, or a carcass of unclean livestock,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-5-v5-3]
Leviticus 5:3
or touches human uncleanness, any uncleanness of a man by touching which he is defiled, and it escapes his notice, but afterward he knows it and incurs guilt;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-5-v5-4]
Leviticus 5:4
or if a soul swears, declaring with his lips to do evil or to do good, whatsoever a man declares with an oath, and it escapes his notice, and he knows it and sins in any one of these matters,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-5-v5-5]
Leviticus 5:5
he shall confess the sin concerning that wherein he has sinned.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-5-v5-6]
Leviticus 5:6
And he shall bring unto the Lord, for the offence and the sin which he has committed, a female from the flock, a ewe lamb or a female young goat from the goats, for sin. And the priest shall make atonement for him for the sin which he has committed, and his sin shall be forgiven him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-5-v5-7]
Leviticus 5:7
And if his hand cannot provide enough for a sheep, he shall bring unto the Lord for the sin which he has committed two turtledoves or two young pigeons, one for sin and one for a whole burnt offering.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-5-v5-8]
Leviticus 5:8
And he shall bring them unto the priest, and the priest shall bring the one for sin first; and the priest shall pinch its head at the neck joint, but shall not divide it.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-5-v5-9]
Leviticus 5:9
And he shall sprinkle some of the blood of the offering for sin upon the wall of the altar; but the remaining blood he shall drain at the base of the altar, for it is for sin.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-5-v5-10]
Leviticus 5:10
And he shall prepare the second as a whole burnt offering, as is fitting. And the priest shall make atonement for the sin which he has committed, and he shall be forgiven.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-5-v5-11]
Leviticus 5:11
And if his hand cannot obtain a pair of turtledoves or two young pigeons, he shall bring his gift for the sin which he has committed: a tenth of an oiphi of fine flour for sin. He shall pour no oil upon it, neither shall he put frankincense upon it, for it is for sin.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-5-v5-12]
Leviticus 5:12
And he shall bring it unto the priest; and the priest shall take from it a full handful, and place its memorial portion upon the altar of whole burnt offerings unto the Lord. It is a sin offering.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-5-v5-13]
Leviticus 5:13
And the priest shall make atonement for him for the sin which he has committed in any one of these matters, and he shall be forgiven. But what remains shall be the priest’s, as the sacrifice of fine flour.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-5-v5-14]
Leviticus 5:14
And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-5-v5-15]
Leviticus 5:15
If a soul is overtaken by forgetfulness, and sins unintentionally concerning the holy things of the Lord, he shall bring unto the Lord for his offence an unblemished ram from the flock, valued in silver shekels according to the sanctuary shekel, for the offence which he has committed.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-5-v5-16]
Leviticus 5:16
And he shall repay that wherein he has sinned against the holy things, and add a fifth part unto it, and give it unto the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the guilt offering, and he shall be forgiven.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-5-v5-17]
Leviticus 5:17
And if a soul sins, and does any of the things which the commandments of the Lord forbid, though he did not know it, and incurs guilt and bears the sin,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-5-v5-18]
Leviticus 5:18
he shall bring unto the priest an unblemished ram from the flock, valued in silver, for a guilt offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him for his ignorance, wherein he acted ignorantly and did not know it, and he shall be forgiven.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-5-v5-19]
Leviticus 5:19
For he has indeed committed an offence before the Lord.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-5-v5-20]
Leviticus 5:20
And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-5-v5-21]
Leviticus 5:21
If a soul sins, and utterly disregards the commandments of the Lord, and deals falsely with his neighbour concerning a deposit, or a partnership, or robbery, or any wrong which he has done unto his neighbour,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-5-v5-22]
Leviticus 5:22
or finds a lost thing and deals falsely concerning it, and swears unjustly concerning any of all the things which a man may do so as to sin therein,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-5-v5-23]
Leviticus 5:23
then it shall be, when he has sinned and incurred guilt, that he shall return the plunder which he seized, or that which he obtained by wrong, or the deposit which was entrusted unto him, or the lost thing which he found,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-5-v5-24]
Leviticus 5:24
concerning every matter about which he swore unjustly. And he shall repay the principal, and add a fifth part unto it; he shall repay it unto the one to whom it belongs, on the day when he is convicted.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-5-v5-25]
Leviticus 5:25
And for his offence he shall bring unto the Lord an unblemished ram from the flock, of a value corresponding to the offence which he has committed against Him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-5-v5-26]
Leviticus 5:26
And the priest shall make atonement for him before the Lord, and he shall be forgiven concerning any of all the things which he has done and wherein he has offended Him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-11-v11-4]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-11-v11-5]
Leviticus 11:5

[UNIT leviticus-section-11-v11-6]
Leviticus 11:6

[UNIT leviticus-section-11-v11-7]
Leviticus 11:7

[UNIT leviticus-section-11-v11-32]

[UNIT leviticus-section-11-v11-33]

[UNIT leviticus-section-11-v11-35]
Leviticus 11:35
And anything on which any of their carcasses falls shall become unclean. Ovens and pot-stands shall be demolished; these are unclean and shall be unclean for you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-11-v11-36]
Leviticus 11:36
But springs of water, a cistern, and a gathering of water shall remain clean; whosoever touches their carcasses shall be unclean.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-11-v11-37]

[UNIT leviticus-section-11-v11-38]

[/UNIT]

If an animal that you may eat dies, whosoever touches its carcass shall be unclean until evening.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-11-v11-40]
Leviticus 11:40
And whosoever eats from these carcasses shall wash his garments and be unclean until evening. Whosoever carries any of their carcasses shall wash his garments, bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-11-v11-41]
Leviticus 11:41
And every creeping thing that creeps upon the earth shall be an abomination for you; it shall not be eaten.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-11-v11-42]
Leviticus 11:42
And whatever moves on its belly, whatever walks on four continually, whatever has many feet among all the creeping things that creep upon the earth, you shall not eat, for it is an abomination for you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-11-v11-43]
Leviticus 11:43
And you shall in no wise make your souls abominable through any creeping things that creep upon the earth; neither shall you be defiled through them, nor shall you be unclean through them;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-11-v11-44]
Leviticus 11:44
for I am the Lord your God; and you shall be sanctified and you shall be holy, for I am holy, the Lord your God. And you shall not defile your souls through any creeping things that move upon the earth;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-11-v11-45]
Leviticus 11:45
for I am the Lord who brought you up out of the land of Egypt to be your God; and you shall be holy, for I am holy, the Lord.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-11-v11-46]
Leviticus 11:46
This is the law concerning animals, birds, every creature that moves in the water, and every creature that creeps upon the earth,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-11-v11-47]
Leviticus 11:47
to distinguish between the unclean and the clean, and between the living creatures that are eaten and the living creatures that are not eaten.
[/UNIT]

[/UNIT]

--- Leviticus 13 ---

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-1]
Leviticus 13:1
And the Lord spoke unto Moses and Aaron, saying:
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-2]
Leviticus 13:2
If anyone has on the skin of his body a bright scar-like mark, and it becomes a lesion of leprosy on his skin, he shall be brought unto Aaron the priest or to one of his sons, the priests.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-3]
Leviticus 13:3
And the priest shall examine the lesion on the skin of his body. If the hair in the lesion has turned white and the lesion appears lower than the skin of his body, it is a lesion of leprosy. The priest shall examine him and declare him unclean.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-4]
Leviticus 13:4
If the bright spot on his skin is white but does not appear lower than the skin, and its hair has not turned white, but it is faint, the priest shall isolate the lesion for seven days.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-5]
Leviticus 13:5
And the priest shall examine the lesion on the seventh day; and, behold, if the lesion remains before him, and the lesion has not shifted in the skin, the priest shall isolate him for a second seven days.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-6]
Leviticus 13:6
And the priest shall examine him on the seventh day a second time; and, behold, if the lesion is faint, and the lesion has not shifted in the skin, the priest shall declare him clean, for it is a mark; and having washed his garments, he shall be clean.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-7]
Leviticus 13:7
But if the mark changes and shifts in the skin after the priest has examined him for cleansing, he shall appear before the priest a second time,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-8]
Leviticus 13:8
and the priest shall examine him; and, behold, if the mark has shifted in the skin, the priest shall declare him unclean; it is leprosy.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-9]
Leviticus 13:9
And when a lesion of leprosy occurs in anyone, he shall come unto the priest.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-10]
Leviticus 13:10
And the priest shall examine him; and, behold, if there is a white scar in the skin, and it has turned the hair white, and there is some sound living flesh in the scar,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-11]
Leviticus 13:11
it is longstanding leprosy on the skin of his body. The priest shall declare him unclean and isolate him, for he is unclean.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-12]
Leviticus 13:12
But if the leprosy breaks out abundantly in the skin, and the leprosy covers all the skin of the lesion from head to foot, throughout the whole view of the priest,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-13]
Leviticus 13:13
the priest shall examine him; and, behold, if the leprosy has covered all the skin of his body, the priest shall declare him clean as to the lesion, because it has all turned white; it is clean.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-14]
Leviticus 13:14
And on whatever day living skin appears on him, he shall be defiled.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-15]
Leviticus 13:15
And the priest shall examine the sound skin, and the sound skin shall make him unclean, because it is unclean; it is leprosy.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-16]
Leviticus 13:16
But if the sound skin is restored and turns white, he shall come unto the priest,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-17]
Leviticus 13:17
and the priest shall examine him; and, behold, if the lesion has turned white, the priest shall declare the lesion clean; he is clean.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-18]
Leviticus 13:18
And if an ulcer occurs on the skin of the body and heals,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-19]
Leviticus 13:19
and a white scar or a whitish or fiery-red bright spot appears in the place of the ulcer, he shall appear before the priest.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-20]
Leviticus 13:20
And the priest shall examine it; and, behold, if its appearance is lower than the skin, and its hair has turned white, the priest shall declare him unclean; it is leprosy which has blossomed in the ulcer.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-21]
Leviticus 13:21
But if the priest examines it, and, behold, there is no white hair in it, and it is not lower than the skin of the body, but is faint, the priest shall isolate him seven days.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-22]
Leviticus 13:22
If it spreads in the skin, the priest shall declare him unclean; it is a lesion of leprosy that has blossomed in the ulcer.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-23]
Leviticus 13:23
But if the bright spot stays in its place and does not spread, it is the scar of the ulcer; the priest shall declare him clean.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-24]
Leviticus 13:24
And if the skin of the body has a burn from fire, and the healed area of the burn on his skin becomes a shining, bright, whitish-red or completely white spot,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-25]
Leviticus 13:25
the priest shall examine him; and, behold, if the hair in the shining spot has turned white, and its appearance is lower than the skin, it is leprosy which has blossomed in the burn; and the priest shall declare him unclean; it is a lesion of leprosy.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-26]
Leviticus 13:26
But if the priest examines it, and, behold, there is no white hair in the shining spot, and it is not lower than the skin, but is faint, the priest shall isolate him seven days.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-27]
Leviticus 13:27
And the priest shall examine him on the seventh day; but if it has indeed spread in the skin, the priest shall declare him unclean; it is a lesion of leprosy which has blossomed in the ulcer.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-28]
Leviticus 13:28
But if the shining spot stays in its place, has not spread in the skin, and is faint, it is the scar of the burn. The priest shall declare him clean, for it is the mark of the burn.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-29]
Leviticus 13:29
And if a man or woman has a lesion of leprosy on the head or beard,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-30]
Leviticus 13:30
the priest shall examine the lesion; and, behold, if its appearance is more hollow than the skin, and there is fine yellowish hair in it, the priest shall declare him unclean; it is a broken patch, leprosy of the head or leprosy of the beard.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-31]
Leviticus 13:31
And if the priest examines the lesion of the broken patch, and, behold, its appearance is not more hollow than the skin, and there is no yellowish hair in it, the priest shall isolate the lesion of the broken patch seven days.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-32]
Leviticus 13:32
And the priest shall examine the lesion on the seventh day; and, behold, if the broken patch has not spread, and there is no yellowish hair in it, and the appearance of the broken patch is not hollow below the skin,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-33]
Leviticus 13:33
then the skin shall be shaved, but the broken patch shall not be shaved. The priest shall isolate the broken patch for a second seven days.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-34]
Leviticus 13:34
And the priest shall examine the broken patch on the seventh day; and, behold, if the broken patch has not spread in the skin after he was shaved, and its appearance is not hollow below the skin, the priest shall declare him clean; and having washed his garments, he shall be clean.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-35]
Leviticus 13:35
But if the broken patch has indeed spread in the skin after he has been cleansed,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-36]
Leviticus 13:36
the priest shall examine him; and, behold, if the broken patch has spread in the skin, the priest shall not inspect for yellow hair, for he is unclean.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-37]
Leviticus 13:37
But if before him the broken patch has remained in place and black hair has grown in it, the broken patch has healed. He is clean, and the priest shall declare him clean.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-38]
Leviticus 13:38
And if a man or woman has shining, whitish patches on the skin of the body,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-39]
Leviticus 13:39
the priest shall examine him; and, behold, if there are shining, whitish patches on the skin of his body, it is a white eruption; he is clean. It blossoms in the skin of his body; he is clean.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-40]
Leviticus 13:40
If anyone loses the hair of his head, he is bald; he is clean.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-41]
Leviticus 13:41
If he loses the hair at the front of his head, he is bald at the forehead; he is clean.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-42]
Leviticus 13:42
But if there is a white or fiery-red lesion on his bald head or bald forehead, it is leprosy on his bald head or bald forehead.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-43]
Leviticus 13:43
And the priest shall examine him; and, behold, if the appearance of the lesion on his bald head or his bald forehead is white tinged with red, like the appearance of leprosy on the skin of his body,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-44]
Leviticus 13:44
he is a man with leprosy; the priest shall surely declare him unclean; his lesion is upon his head.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-45]
Leviticus 13:45
And he that has leprosy, in whom the lesion is, shall have his garments loosened and his head uncovered, and shall put a covering about his mouth, and shall be called unclean;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-46]
Leviticus 13:46
all the days in which the lesion is upon him, being unclean, he shall be unclean; he shall dwell apart; his dwelling shall be outside the camp.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-47]
Leviticus 13:47
And if a garment has a lesion of leprosy, whether a woollen garment or a garment of coarse flax,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-48]
Leviticus 13:48
or in warp or weft, or in linen or wool, or in leather or any worked leather,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-49]
Leviticus 13:49
and the lesion in the leather, garment, warp, weft, or any worked leather article is greenish or fiery red, it is a lesion of leprosy, and he shall show it unto the priest.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-50]
Leviticus 13:50
And the priest shall examine the lesion, and the priest shall isolate the lesion for seven days.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-51]
Leviticus 13:51
And on the seventh day the priest shall examine the lesion. If it has spread in the garment, warp, weft, or leather, in whatever use is made of leather, the lesion is persistent leprosy; it is unclean.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-52]
Leviticus 13:52
He shall burn up the garment, the warp or weft in wool or linen, or any leather article that has the lesion, for it is persistent leprosy; it shall be burned up with fire.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-53]
Leviticus 13:53
But if the priest examines it and the lesion has not spread in the garment, warp, weft, or any leather article,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-54]
Leviticus 13:54
then the priest shall give instructions, and he shall wash the article with the lesion; the priest shall isolate the lesion for a second seven days.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-55]
Leviticus 13:55
And after it has been washed, the priest shall examine the lesion. If it has not changed its appearance and has not spread, it is unclean; it shall be burned up with fire. It has become established in the garment, warp, or weft.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-56]
Leviticus 13:56
And if the priest examines it and the lesion is faint after washing, he shall tear it out of the garment, leather, warp, or weft.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-57]
Leviticus 13:57
If it appears again in the garment, warp, weft, or any leather article, it is blossoming leprosy; the affected article shall be burned up with fire.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-58]
Leviticus 13:58
And a garment, warp, weft, or any leather article that is washed, from which the lesion departs, shall be washed a second time and be clean.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-13-v13-59]
Leviticus 13:59
This is the law of a lesion of leprosy in a garment of wool or coarse flax, or in warp or weft, or in any leather article, for declaring it clean or unclean.
[/UNIT]

--- Leviticus 14 ---

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-1]
Leviticus 14:1
And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying:
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-2]

This is the law of the person with leprosy on the day he is cleansed: he shall be brought unto the priest,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-3]
Leviticus 14:3

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-4]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-5]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-6]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-7]
Leviticus 14:7

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-8]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-9]
Leviticus 14:9

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-10]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-13]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-14]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-15]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-17]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-18]
Leviticus 14:18
The priest shall put the remaining oil in his hand on the head of the person who has been cleansed. The priest shall make atonement for him before the Lord.

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-19]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-21]
Leviticus 14:21

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-22]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-23]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-24]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-25]
Leviticus 14:25

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-26]
Leviticus 14:26
And the priest shall pour some of the oil upon the priest’s left hand,
[/UNIT]

and with his right finger the priest shall sprinkle some of the oil in his left hand seven times before the Lord.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-28]
Leviticus 14:28
And the priest shall put some of the oil on his hand on the right earlobe of the person being cleansed, the extremity of his right hand, and the extremity of his right foot, on the place of the guilt offering’s blood.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-29]
Leviticus 14:29
He shall put the remaining oil in the priest’s hand on the head of the person who has been cleansed, and the priest shall make atonement for him before the Lord.

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-30]

And he shall prepare one of the turtledoves or young pigeons, as his hand can provide,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-31]
Leviticus 14:31
one for sin and one for a whole burnt offering, together with the sacrifice. The priest shall make atonement before the Lord for the person being cleansed.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-32]
Leviticus 14:32
This is the law for the one with a lesion of leprosy and for the one whose hand cannot provide for his cleansing.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-33]
Leviticus 14:33
And the Lord spoke unto Moses and Aaron, saying:
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-34]
Leviticus 14:34
When you enter the land of the Canaanites, which I give unto you for a possession, and I put a lesion of leprosy in the houses of the land of your possession,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-35]
Leviticus 14:35
then the owner of the house shall come and tell the priest, saying: Something like a lesion has appeared to me in the house.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-36]
Leviticus 14:36
And the priest shall command that the house be emptied before he enters to examine the lesion, so that nothing in the house becomes unclean. Afterward the priest shall enter to examine the house.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-37]
Leviticus 14:37
And he shall examine the lesion in the walls of the house, greenish or fiery-red hollows whose appearance is lower than the walls,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-38]
Leviticus 14:38
and the priest shall leave the house, go to its door, and isolate the house for seven days.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-39]
Leviticus 14:39

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-40]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-41]
Leviticus 14:41
And they shall scrape the house all around inside and pour the dust outside the city into an unclean place.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-42]
Leviticus 14:42
And they shall take other scraped stones and put them in place of those stones. They shall take other earth and plaster the house.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-43]
Leviticus 14:43
If a lesion comes again and springs up in the house after the stones have been removed and the house scraped and plastered,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-44]
Leviticus 14:44
then the priest shall enter and examine it. If the lesion has spread in the house, it is persistent leprosy in the house; it is unclean.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-45]
Leviticus 14:45
And they shall demolish the house, and carry its timbers, its stones, and all its dust outside the city into an unclean place.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-46]
Leviticus 14:46
And whosoever enters the house during any of the days it is isolated shall be unclean until evening.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-47]
Leviticus 14:47

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-48]
Leviticus 14:48
But if the priest comes and enters and examines it, and, behold, the lesion has not spread at all in the house after the house was plastered, the priest shall declare the house clean, for the lesion has healed.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-49]
Leviticus 14:49
And to purify the house he shall take two living clean birds, cedarwood, spun scarlet thread, and hyssop.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-50]
Leviticus 14:50
And he shall slaughter one bird into an earthenware vessel over living water,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-51]
Leviticus 14:51
and take the cedarwood, spun scarlet thread, hyssop, and living bird, dip it in the blood of the bird slaughtered over living water, and sprinkle the house with them seven times,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-52]
Leviticus 14:52
and he shall purify the house with the bird’s blood, the living water, the living bird, the cedarwood, the hyssop, and the spun scarlet thread.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-53]
Leviticus 14:53
And he shall release the living bird outside the city into the plain, make atonement for the house, and it shall be clean.

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-54]
Leviticus 14:54
This is the law concerning every lesion of leprosy and every broken patch,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-55]
Leviticus 14:55
and for leprosy of a garment or house,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-56]

and for a scar, a mark, or a shining spot,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-14-v14-57]

and to explain on what day it is unclean and on what day it shall be cleansed. This is the law of leprosy.
