--- Leviticus 15 ---

[UNIT leviticus-section-15-v15-1]
Leviticus 15:1
And the Lord spoke unto Moses and Aaron, saying:
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-15-v15-2]
Leviticus 15:2
Speak unto the sons of Israel, and you shall say unto them: If any man has a flow from his body, his flow is unclean.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-15-v15-3]
Leviticus 15:3
And this is the law of his uncleanness: discharging seed from his body through the flow by which his body has become stopped up, this is his uncleanness in him; all the days of the flow of his body, in which his body has become stopped up through the flow, are his uncleanness.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-15-v15-4]
Leviticus 15:4
Every bed on which the man with a seminal discharge lies is unclean, and every article on which the man with a seminal discharge sits shall be unclean.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-15-v15-5]
Leviticus 15:5
And whosoever touches his bed shall wash his garments, bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-15-v15-6]
Leviticus 15:6
And whosoever sits on an article on which the man with a seminal discharge has sat shall wash his garments, bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-15-v15-7]
Leviticus 15:7
And whosoever touches the skin of the man with a seminal discharge shall wash his garments, bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-15-v15-8]
Leviticus 15:8
If the man with a seminal discharge spits on someone clean, that person shall wash his garments, bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-15-v15-9]
Leviticus 15:9
And any donkey saddle on which the man with a seminal discharge mounts shall be unclean until evening.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-15-v15-10]
Leviticus 15:10
And whosoever touches anything that was under him shall be unclean until evening. Whosoever carries those things shall wash his garments, bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-15-v15-11]
Leviticus 15:11
And anyone whom the man with a seminal discharge touches when he has not washed his hands shall wash his garments, bathe his body in water, and be unclean until evening.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-15-v15-12]
Leviticus 15:12
And an earthenware vessel touched by the man with a seminal discharge shall be shattered, and a wooden vessel shall be washed with water and be clean.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-15-v15-13]
Leviticus 15:13
When the man with a seminal discharge is cleansed from his flow, he shall count seven days for his cleansing, wash his garments, bathe his body in water, and be clean.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-15-v15-14]
Leviticus 15:14
And on the eighth day he shall take two turtledoves or two young pigeons, bring them before the Lord to the doors of the Tent of Testimony, and give them unto the priest.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-15-v15-15]
Leviticus 15:15
And the priest shall prepare them, one for sin and one for a whole burnt offering. The priest shall make atonement for him before the Lord for his flow.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-15-v15-16]
Leviticus 15:16
And if a man has an emission of semen, he shall bathe his whole body in water and be unclean until evening.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-15-v15-17]
Leviticus 15:17
And every garment and every skin on which there is semen shall be washed with water and be unclean until evening.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-15-v15-18]
Leviticus 15:18
And if a man lies with a woman with an emission of semen, they shall bathe in water and be unclean until evening.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-15-v15-19]
Leviticus 15:19
And if a woman has a flow of blood, her flow shall be in her body; she shall remain in her menstrual discharge for seven days. Whosoever touches her shall be unclean until evening,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-15-v15-20]
Leviticus 15:20
and everything on which she lies during her menstrual discharge shall be unclean, and everything on which she sits shall be unclean.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-15-v15-21]
Leviticus 15:21
And whosoever touches her bed shall wash his garments, bathe his body in water, and be unclean until evening.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-15-v15-22]
Leviticus 15:22
And whosoever touches any article on which she sits shall wash his garments, bathe in water, and be unclean until evening.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-15-v15-23]
Leviticus 15:23
If, while she is on her bed or on the article on which she sits, he touches her, he shall be unclean until evening.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-15-v15-24]
Leviticus 15:24
If anyone lies with her and her uncleanness comes upon him, he shall be unclean for seven days, and every bed on which he lies shall be unclean.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-15-v15-25]
Leviticus 15:25
And if a woman has a flow of blood for many days outside the time of her menstrual discharge, or if she also has a flow after her menstrual discharge, all the days of her unclean flow shall be like the days of her menstrual discharge; she shall be unclean.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-15-v15-26]
Leviticus 15:26
And every bed on which she lies during all the days of her flow shall be like the bed of her menstrual discharge, and every article on which she sits shall be unclean, as in the uncleanness of her menstrual discharge.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-15-v15-27]
Leviticus 15:27
Whosoever touches her shall be unclean. He shall wash his garments, bathe his body in water, and be unclean until evening.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-15-v15-28]
Leviticus 15:28
When she is cleansed from her flow, she shall count seven days, and afterward she shall be cleansed.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-15-v15-29]
Leviticus 15:29
And on the eighth day she shall take two turtledoves or two young pigeons and bring them unto the priest at the entrance of the Tent of Testimony.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-15-v15-30]
Leviticus 15:30
And the priest shall prepare one for sin and one for a whole burnt offering. The priest shall make atonement for her before the Lord for her unclean flow.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-15-v15-31]
Leviticus 15:31
And you shall make the sons of Israel wary of their uncleannesses, so that they do not die because of their uncleanness in defiling My tent which is among them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-15-v15-32]
Leviticus 15:32
This is the law for the man with a seminal discharge and for anyone who has an emission of semen and becomes defiled through it,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-15-v15-33]
Leviticus 15:33
and for the woman bleeding in her menstrual discharge, for the one with a seminal discharge in his flow, male or female, and for the man who lies with a woman in menstrual separation.
[/UNIT]

--- Leviticus 16 ---

[UNIT leviticus-section-16-v16-1]
Leviticus 16:1
And the Lord spoke unto Moses after Aaron’s two sons died when they presented strange fire before the Lord and died.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-16-v16-2]
Leviticus 16:2
And the Lord said unto Moses: Speak unto Aaron your brother, and let him not enter at all times into the holy place within the veil, before the propitiatory cover which is upon the ark of testimony, so that he does not die; for I will appear in a cloud above the propitiatory cover.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-16-v16-3]
Leviticus 16:3
In this way Aaron shall enter the holy place: with a calf from the cattle for sin and a ram for a whole burnt offering.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-16-v16-4]
Leviticus 16:4
And he shall put on a consecrated linen tunic, with linen undergarments against his skin, gird himself with a linen belt, and put on a linen turban. These are holy garments. He shall bathe his whole body in water and put them on.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-16-v16-5]
Leviticus 16:5
And from the congregation of the sons of Israel he shall take two male young goats from the goats for sin and one ram for a whole burnt offering.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-16-v16-6]
Leviticus 16:6
And Aaron shall present the calf for his sin offering and make atonement for himself and his house.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-16-v16-7]
Leviticus 16:7
And he shall take the two male young goats and present them before the Lord beside the door of the Tent of Testimony.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-16-v16-8]
Leviticus 16:8
And Aaron shall place upon the two male young goats one lot for the Lord and one lot for the one sent away.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-16-v16-9]
Leviticus 16:9
And Aaron shall present the male young goat on which the lot for the Lord fell and offer it for sin.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-16-v16-10]
Leviticus 16:10
And he shall present alive before the Lord the male young goat on which the lot of the one sent away fell, to make atonement over it, so as to send it away for removal. He shall release it into the wilderness.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-16-v16-11]
Leviticus 16:11
And Aaron shall present the calf for the sin offering of himself and his house alone, make atonement for himself and his house, and slaughter the calf for his own sin offering.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-16-v16-12]
Leviticus 16:12
And he shall take the firepan full of burning coals from the altar opposite the Lord, fill his hands with finely compounded incense, and bring them within the veil,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-16-v16-13]
Leviticus 16:13
and put the incense on the fire before the Lord. The vapour of incense shall cover the propitiatory cover above the testimonies, and he shall not die.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-16-v16-14]
Leviticus 16:14
And he shall take some of the calf’s blood and sprinkle it with his finger on the propitiatory cover toward the east; before the propitiatory cover he shall sprinkle some of the blood with his finger seven times.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-16-v16-15]
Leviticus 16:15
And he shall slaughter the male young goat for the people’s sin offering before the Lord and bring some of its blood within the veil. He shall do with its blood as he did with the calf’s blood, sprinkling its blood on the propitiatory cover, before the propitiatory cover,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-16-v16-16]
Leviticus 16:16
and make atonement for the holy place from the sons of Israel’s uncleannesses and their wrongdoings, concerning all their sins. He shall do the same for the Tent of Testimony established among them amid their uncleanness.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-16-v16-17]
Leviticus 16:17
And no one shall be in the Tent of Testimony when he enters to make atonement in the holy place until he comes out. He shall make atonement for himself, his house, and the whole congregation of the sons of Israel.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-16-v16-18]
Leviticus 16:18
And he shall go out unto the altar opposite the Lord and make atonement upon it. He shall take some of the calf’s blood and some of the male young goat’s blood and put it all around on the altar’s horns,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-16-v16-19]
Leviticus 16:19
and he shall sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times, cleanse it, and consecrate it from the sons of Israel’s uncleannesses.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-16-v16-20]
Leviticus 16:20
And he shall finish making atonement for the holy place, the Tent of Testimony, and the altar, and perform cleansing for the priests. He shall present the living male young goat.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-16-v16-21]
Leviticus 16:21
And Aaron shall lay his hands on the living male young goat’s head and confess over it all the sons of Israel’s lawless deeds, all their injustices, and all their sins. He shall put them on the living male young goat’s head and send it into the wilderness by the hand of a prepared man.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-16-v16-22]
Leviticus 16:22
And the male young goat shall take upon itself their injustices to an inaccessible land, and he shall release the male young goat into the wilderness.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-16-v16-23]
Leviticus 16:23
And Aaron shall enter the Tent of Testimony, take off the linen robe he wore when entering the holy place, and lay it aside there.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-16-v16-24]
Leviticus 16:24
And he shall bathe his body in water in a holy place and put on his robe. He shall go out, prepare his whole offering and the people’s whole offering, and make atonement for himself, his house, and the people, as for the priests.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-16-v16-25]
Leviticus 16:25
And he shall offer up the fat of the offerings for sins on the altar.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-16-v16-26]
Leviticus 16:26
And the one who sends away the male young goat designated for release shall wash his garments and bathe his body in water. Afterward he shall enter the camp.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-16-v16-27]
Leviticus 16:27
And they shall carry outside the camp the calf and male young goat for the sin offering whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place. They shall burn them up with fire, their hides, flesh, and dung.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-16-v16-28]
Leviticus 16:28
The one who burns them shall wash his garments and bathe his body in water. Afterward he may enter the camp.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-16-v16-29]
Leviticus 16:29
And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you: in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, humble your souls, and you shall do no work, neither the native nor the resident foreigner who is attached unto you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-16-v16-30]
Leviticus 16:30
For on this day he shall make atonement for you, to cleanse you from all your sins before the Lord; and you shall be cleansed.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-16-v16-31]
Leviticus 16:31
It shall be a Sabbath of Sabbaths, a rest unto you; and you shall humble your souls: an everlasting statute.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-16-v16-32]
Leviticus 16:32
The priest whom they anoint and whose hands they consecrate to serve as priest after his father shall make atonement. He shall put on the linen robe, a holy robe,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-16-v16-33]
Leviticus 16:33
and he shall make atonement for the Holy of Holies, and for the Tent of Testimony and the altar shall he make atonement; and for the priests and for the whole congregation shall he make atonement.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-16-v16-34]
Leviticus 16:34
And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make atonement for the sons of Israel from all their sins; it shall be done once in the year, as the Lord directed Moses.
[/UNIT]

--- Leviticus 17 ---

[UNIT leviticus-section-17-v17-1]
Leviticus 17:1
And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying:
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-17-v17-2]
Leviticus 17:2
Speak unto Aaron and unto his sons and unto all the sons of Israel, and you shall say unto them: This is the word which the Lord commanded, saying:
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-17-v17-3]
Leviticus 17:3
Any person of the sons of Israel or of the resident foreigners attached to you who slaughters a calf, sheep, or goat in the camp, or slaughters it outside the camp,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-17-v17-4]
Leviticus 17:4
and does not bring it unto the door of the Tent of Testimony, to prepare it as a whole burnt offering or an offering of deliverance acceptable unto the Lord for a sweet savour; and whosoever slaughters outside, and does not bring it unto the door of the Tent of Testimony, so as not to present a gift unto the Lord before the tent of the Lord: blood shall be reckoned unto that man; he has poured out blood; that soul shall be destroyed from among his people.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-17-v17-5]
Leviticus 17:5
This is so that the sons of Israel may bring up their sacrifices, which they themselves slaughter in the plains; they shall bring them unto the Lord, to the doors of the Tent of Testimony, unto the priest, and sacrifice them as a sacrifice of deliverance unto the Lord.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-17-v17-6]
Leviticus 17:6
And the priest shall pour the blood all around against the altar before the Lord beside the doors of the Tent of Testimony and offer up the fat for a sweet savour unto the Lord.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-17-v17-7]
Leviticus 17:7
And they shall no longer sacrifice their sacrifices to the vain things after which they prostitute themselves. This shall be an everlasting ordinance for you throughout your generations.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-17-v17-8]
Leviticus 17:8
And you shall say unto them: Any man of the sons of Israel, or of the sons of the resident foreigners attached unto you, who prepares a whole burnt offering or a sacrifice,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-17-v17-9]
Leviticus 17:9
and does not bring it to the door of the Tent of Testimony to offer it unto the Lord, that person shall be destroyed from among his people.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-17-v17-10]
Leviticus 17:10
And any man of the sons of Israel, or of the resident foreigners attached unto you, who eats any blood: I will set My face against the soul that eats the blood, and destroy him from among his people.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-17-v17-11]
Leviticus 17:11
For the life of all flesh is its blood, and I have given it unto you upon the altar to make atonement for your lives; for its blood shall make atonement in place of the life.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-17-v17-12]
Leviticus 17:12
Therefore I have said unto the sons of Israel: No soul among you shall eat blood; and the resident foreigner attached unto you shall not eat blood.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-17-v17-13]
Leviticus 17:13
And any person of the sons of Israel or of the resident foreigners attached to you who hunts a wild animal or bird that may be eaten shall pour out the blood and cover it with earth.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-17-v17-14]
Leviticus 17:14
For the life of all flesh is its blood; and I said unto the sons of Israel: You shall eat no blood of any flesh, for the life of all flesh is its blood; whosoever eats it shall be destroyed.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-17-v17-15]
Leviticus 17:15
And every soul, whether among the natives or among the resident foreigners, that eats an animal which has died or has been taken by wild beasts, shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and be unclean until evening, and shall be clean.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-17-v17-16]
Leviticus 17:16
But if he does not wash his garments and does not bathe his body in water, he shall bear his lawless deed.
[/UNIT]

--- Leviticus 18 ---

[UNIT leviticus-section-18-v18-1]
Leviticus 18:1
And the Lord said unto Moses, saying,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-18-v18-2]
Leviticus 18:2
Speak unto the sons of Israel, and you shall say unto them: I am the Lord your God.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-18-v18-3]
Leviticus 18:3
You shall not follow the practices of the land of Egypt, where you dwelt; and you shall not follow the practices of the land of Canaan, where I am bringing you; neither shall you walk in their statutes.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-18-v18-4]
Leviticus 18:4
You shall do My judgments, and keep My ordinances, to walk in them; I am the Lord your God.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-18-v18-5]
Leviticus 18:5
And you shall keep all My ordinances and all My judgments, and do them; the man who does them shall live by them; I am the Lord your God.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-18-v18-6]
Leviticus 18:6
No person shall approach any relative of his flesh to uncover nakedness. I am the Lord.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-18-v18-7]
Leviticus 18:7
You shall not uncover your father’s nakedness or your mother’s nakedness. She is your mother; you shall not uncover her nakedness.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-18-v18-8]
Leviticus 18:8
You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife; it is your father’s nakedness.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-18-v18-9]
Leviticus 18:9
The nakedness of your sister, from your father or from your mother, born at home or born outside: you shall not uncover her nakedness.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-18-v18-10]
Leviticus 18:10
The nakedness of your son’s daughter or your daughter’s daughter, you shall not uncover their nakedness, for it is your nakedness.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-18-v18-11]
Leviticus 18:11
You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s wife’s daughter. She is your sister by the same father; you shall not uncover her nakedness.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-18-v18-12]
Leviticus 18:12
You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s sister; she is your father’s close relative.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-18-v18-13]
Leviticus 18:13
You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother’s sister; she is your mother’s close relative.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-18-v18-14]
Leviticus 18:14
You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s brother, and you shall not go in to his wife. She is your relative.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-18-v18-15]
Leviticus 18:15
You shall not uncover your daughter-in-law’s nakedness. She is your son’s wife; you shall not uncover her nakedness.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-18-v18-16]
Leviticus 18:16
You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother’s wife; it is your brother’s nakedness.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-18-v18-17]
Leviticus 18:17
You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter. You shall not take her son’s daughter or her daughter’s daughter to uncover their nakedness; they are your relatives. It is an act of impiety.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-18-v18-18]
Leviticus 18:18
You shall not take a woman in addition to her sister as a rival, to uncover her nakedness alongside her while she is alive.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-18-v18-19]
Leviticus 18:19
And you shall not approach a woman in separation for her uncleanness to uncover her nakedness.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-18-v18-20]
Leviticus 18:20
And you shall not lie with your neighbour’s wife to emit semen and become defiled through her.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-18-v18-21]
Leviticus 18:21
And you shall not give any of your seed to serve a ruler, neither shall you profane the holy name; I am the Lord.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-18-v18-22]
Leviticus 18:22
And you shall not lie with a male as one lies with a woman; it is an abomination.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-18-v18-23]
Leviticus 18:23
And you shall not lie with any four-footed animal for insemination and become defiled through it. A woman shall not stand before any four-footed animal to be mounted; it is detestable.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-18-v18-24]
Leviticus 18:24
Do not defile yourselves in any of these things; for in all these things the nations whom I drive out before your face were defiled,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-18-v18-25]
Leviticus 18:25
and the land became defiled, and I repaid them for wrongdoing because of it, and the land became indignant with those settled upon it.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-18-v18-26]
Leviticus 18:26
And you shall keep all My statutes and all My commands, and do none of these abominations, neither the native nor the resident foreigner who has joined himself among you—
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-18-v18-27]
Leviticus 18:27
for the people of the land who were before you did all these abominations, and the land became defiled—
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-18-v18-28]
Leviticus 18:28
so that the land is not indignant with you when you defile it, as it was indignant with the nations before you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-18-v18-29]
Leviticus 18:29
For whosoever does any of all these abominations, the souls that do them shall be destroyed from among their people.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-18-v18-30]
Leviticus 18:30
And you shall keep My ordinances, that you do none of all the abominable practices which were before you; and you shall not be defiled in them, for I am the Lord your God.
[/UNIT]

--- Leviticus 19 ---

[UNIT leviticus-section-19-v19-1]
Leviticus 19:1
And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying:
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-19-v19-2]
Leviticus 19:2
Speak unto the congregation of the sons of Israel, and you shall say unto them: You shall be holy, for I am holy, the Lord your God.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-19-v19-3]
Leviticus 19:3
Each shall revere his father and his mother, and you shall keep My Sabbaths. I am the Lord your God.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-19-v19-4]
Leviticus 19:4
You shall not follow idols, neither shall you make cast gods for yourselves; I am the Lord your God.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-19-v19-5]
Leviticus 19:5
And if you sacrifice a sacrifice of deliverance unto the Lord, you shall sacrifice it so that it is acceptable for you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-19-v19-6]
Leviticus 19:6
It shall be eaten on the day when you sacrifice it and on the morrow; and if any remains until the third day, it shall be burned with fire.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-19-v19-7]
Leviticus 19:7
If it is eaten at all on the third day, it is unfit for sacrifice; it shall not be accepted.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-19-v19-8]
Leviticus 19:8
But he that eats it shall bear sin, for he has profaned the holy things of the Lord; and the souls that eat shall be destroyed from among their people.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-19-v19-9]
Leviticus 19:9
And when you reap the harvest of your land, you shall not wholly reap the harvest of your field; and you shall not gather what falls from your harvest,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-19-v19-10]
Leviticus 19:10
neither shall you glean your vineyard again, nor gather the grapes of your vineyard; you shall leave them for the poor and the resident foreigner; I am the Lord your God.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-19-v19-11]
Leviticus 19:11
You shall not steal. You shall not lie. No one shall defraud his neighbour.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-19-v19-12]
Leviticus 19:12
And you shall not swear by My name for an unjust cause, and you shall not profane the name of your God. I am the Lord your God.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-19-v19-13]
Leviticus 19:13
You shall not wrong your neighbour, neither shall you rob; and the wages of the hired worker shall in no wise remain with you overnight until morning.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-19-v19-14]
Leviticus 19:14
You shall not speak evil of the deaf, neither shall you put a stumbling block before the blind; and you shall fear the Lord your God; I am the Lord your God.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-19-v19-15]
Leviticus 19:15
You shall do no injustice in judgment; you shall not favour the person of the poor, neither shall you admire the person of the mighty; you shall judge your neighbour in righteousness.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-19-v19-16]
Leviticus 19:16
You shall not go about deceitfully among your nation; you shall not conspire against the blood of your neighbour; I am the Lord your God.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-19-v19-17]
Leviticus 19:17
You shall not hate your brother in your mind; you shall surely reprove your neighbour, and you shall not bear sin because of him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-19-v19-18]
Leviticus 19:18
And your hand shall not take vengeance, neither shall you remain angry with the sons of your people; and you shall love your neighbour as yourself; I am the Lord.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-19-v19-19]
Leviticus 19:19
You shall keep My law; you shall not mate your livestock with a different stock, neither shall you sow your vineyard with a different kind, nor put upon yourself a spurious garment woven of two materials.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-19-v19-20]
Leviticus 19:20
And if anyone lies with a woman with an emission of semen, and she is a household slave reserved for a man but has not been ransomed or given freedom, there shall be an inquiry concerning them. They shall not die, because she has not been freed.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-19-v19-21]
Leviticus 19:21
And he shall bring his guilt offering unto the Lord beside the door of the Tent of Testimony, a ram for a guilt offering.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-19-v19-22]
Leviticus 19:22
And the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the guilt offering before the Lord for the sin he has committed, and the sin he has committed shall be forgiven him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-19-v19-23]
Leviticus 19:23
But when you enter the land which the Lord your God gives unto you, and plant any tree for food, you shall purge its uncleanness; its fruit shall be unpurged unto you three years; it shall not be eaten.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-19-v19-24]
Leviticus 19:24
And in the fourth year all its fruit shall be holy, praiseworthy unto the Lord.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-19-v19-25]
Leviticus 19:25
But in the fifth year you shall eat the fruit; its produce shall be an increase unto you; I am the Lord your God.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-19-v19-26]
Leviticus 19:26
You shall not eat on the mountains. You shall not divine by omens or observe birds for divination.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-19-v19-27]
Leviticus 19:27
You shall not make a sisoe from the hair of your head or spoil the appearance of your beards.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-19-v19-28]
Leviticus 19:28
And you shall make no incisions in your body for a dead person, neither shall you put tattooed letters upon yourselves; I am the Lord your God.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-19-v19-29]
Leviticus 19:29
You shall not profane your daughter by making her a prostitute, lest the land prostitute itself and the land be filled with lawlessness.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-19-v19-30]
Leviticus 19:30
You shall keep My Sabbaths and revere My holy things. I am the Lord.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-19-v19-31]
Leviticus 19:31
You shall not follow spirit mediums, neither shall you attach yourselves unto enchanters, to be defiled by them; I am the Lord your God.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-19-v19-32]
Leviticus 19:32
You shall rise before the face of the grey-haired, and honour the person of an elder, and fear your God; I am the Lord your God.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-19-v19-33]
Leviticus 19:33
If a resident foreigner comes to you in your land, you shall not oppress him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-19-v19-34]
Leviticus 19:34
The resident foreigner who approaches you shall be as the native among you; and you shall love him as yourself, for you were resident foreigners in the land of Egypt; I am the Lord your God.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-19-v19-35]
Leviticus 19:35
You shall do no injustice in judgment, in measures, weights, or scales.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-19-v19-36]
Leviticus 19:36
You shall have just scales, just weights, and a just chous. I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-19-v19-37]
Leviticus 19:37
And you shall keep all My law and all My ordinances, and do them; I am the Lord your God.
[/UNIT]

--- Leviticus 20 ---

[UNIT leviticus-section-20-v20-1]

And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying:
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-20-v20-2]
Leviticus 20:2
And you shall speak unto the sons of Israel: If any of the sons of Israel, or of the resident foreigners who have joined Israel, gives any of his seed unto a ruler, let him surely be put to death; the nation upon the land shall stone him with stones.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-20-v20-3]
Leviticus 20:3
And I will set My face against that man and destroy him from among his people, because he gave some of his seed to a ruler, defiling My holy things and profaning the name of those consecrated to Me.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-20-v20-4]
Leviticus 20:4
But if the natives of the land utterly overlook that man with their eyes, when he gives any of his seed unto a ruler, so as not to put him to death,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-20-v20-5]
Leviticus 20:5
then I will set My face against that man and his kin. I will destroy him from among their people, together with all who agree with him so that he prostitutes himself after rulers.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-20-v20-6]
Leviticus 20:6
And the soul that follows spirit mediums or enchanters, to prostitute himself after them: I will set My face against that soul and destroy him from among his people.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-20-v20-7]
Leviticus 20:7
And you shall be holy, for I, the Lord your God, am holy.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-20-v20-8]
Leviticus 20:8
And you shall keep My ordinances, and do them; I am the Lord who sanctifies you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-20-v20-9]
Leviticus 20:9
Any man who speaks evil of his father or his mother shall surely be put to death. He has spoken evil of his father or his mother; he shall be guilty.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-20-v20-10]
Leviticus 20:10
If a man commits adultery with a man’s wife, or commits adultery with his neighbour’s wife, both the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-20-v20-11]
Leviticus 20:11
If anyone lies with his father’s wife, he has uncovered his father’s nakedness. Both shall surely be put to death; they are guilty.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-20-v20-12]
Leviticus 20:12
And if anyone lies with his daughter-in-law, both shall surely be put to death, for they have acted impiously; they are guilty.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-20-v20-13]
Leviticus 20:13
And if anyone lies with a male as one lies with a woman, both have committed an abomination. They shall be put to death; they are guilty.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-20-v20-14]
Leviticus 20:14
If anyone takes a woman and her mother, it is a lawless deed. They shall burn him and them with fire, so that there may be no lawlessness among you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-20-v20-15]
Leviticus 20:15
And if anyone has intercourse with a four-footed animal, he shall surely be put to death, and you shall kill the animal.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-20-v20-16]
Leviticus 20:16
And if a woman approaches any animal to be mounted by it, you shall kill the woman and the animal. They shall surely be put to death; they are guilty.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-20-v20-17]
Leviticus 20:17
If anyone takes his sister, his father’s daughter or his mother’s daughter, and sees her nakedness, and she sees his nakedness, it is a reproach. They shall be destroyed before the sons of their people. He has uncovered his sister’s nakedness; they shall bear their sin.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-20-v20-18]
Leviticus 20:18
And if a man lies with a woman during her menstrual separation and uncovers her nakedness, he has exposed her fountain, and she has uncovered the flow of her blood. Both shall be destroyed from among their kin.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-20-v20-19]
Leviticus 20:19
And you shall not uncover the nakedness of your father’s sister or your mother’s sister; for he has uncovered his own kinship; they shall bear sin.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-20-v20-20]
Leviticus 20:20
If anyone lies with his female relative, he has uncovered the nakedness of his kinship. They shall die childless.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-20-v20-21]
Leviticus 20:21
If anyone takes his brother’s wife, it is an uncleanness. He has uncovered his brother’s nakedness; they shall die childless.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-20-v20-22]
Leviticus 20:22
And keep all My ordinances and My judgments, and you shall do them; and the land into which I bring you to dwell therein shall in no wise be indignant with you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-20-v20-23]
Leviticus 20:23
And you shall not walk in the laws of the nations that I am driving away from you, for they did all these things, and I abhorred them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-20-v20-24]
Leviticus 20:24
And I said to you: Inherit their land, and I will give it to you as a possession, a land flowing with milk and honey. I am the Lord your God, who separated you from all the nations.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-20-v20-25]
Leviticus 20:25
And you shall distinguish them, between the clean livestock and the unclean livestock, and between the clean birds and the unclean; and you shall not make your souls abominable through livestock, or birds, or any creeping things of the earth which I have set apart unto you as unclean.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-20-v20-26]
Leviticus 20:26
And you shall be holy to Me, for I am holy, the Lord your God. I separated you from all the nations to be Mine.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-20-v20-27]
Leviticus 20:27
And if a man or a woman becomes a spirit-medium or an enchanter, both shall surely be put to death. You shall stone them with stones; they are guilty.
[/UNIT]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-21-v21-20]

[UNIT leviticus-section-22-v22-2]

Leviticus 22:3

[UNIT leviticus-section-22-v22-4]
Leviticus 22:4

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-22-v22-5]
Leviticus 22:5

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-22-v22-7]
Leviticus 22:7

[/UNIT]

He shall not eat an animal found dead or torn by beasts, becoming unclean through them. I am the Lord.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-22-v22-9]

[UNIT leviticus-section-22-v22-10]

[UNIT leviticus-section-22-v22-12]
Leviticus 22:12
And if a priest’s daughter marries an outsider, she shall not eat the first portions of the holy things.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-22-v22-13]
Leviticus 22:13
And if a priest’s daughter becomes a widow or is expelled, and has no seed, she shall return to her father’s house as in her youth and may eat her father’s bread. But no outsider shall eat of it.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-22-v22-14]
Leviticus 22:14
And if a man eats holy things in ignorance, he shall add a fifth to it and give the holy thing unto the priest.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-22-v22-15]
Leviticus 22:15
And they shall not profane the holy things of the sons of Israel that they set aside for the Lord,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-22-v22-16]
Leviticus 22:16

[UNIT leviticus-section-22-v22-18]

[/UNIT]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-22-v22-22]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-22-v22-23]
Leviticus 22:23

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-22-v22-24]

You shall not bring unto the Lord an animal castrated by crushing, or by squeezing out, or by cutting out, or by tearing away; and in your land you shall not do this.

[UNIT leviticus-section-22-v22-25]
Leviticus 22:25

[UNIT leviticus-section-22-v22-28]
Leviticus 22:28

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-22-v22-29]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-22-v22-30]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-22-v22-32]

who brought you out of the land of Egypt to be your God. I am the Lord.

[UNIT leviticus-section-24-v24-7]

And you shall put pure frankincense and salt upon the arrangement. They shall be set before the Lord as a memorial for the loaves.

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-24-v24-9]

And it shall belong unto Aaron and his sons, and they shall eat these things in a holy place, for this is most holy for him from the things sacrificed unto the Lord, an everlasting ordinance.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-24-v24-10]
Leviticus 24:10

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-24-v24-11]
Leviticus 24:11

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-24-v24-12]

[UNIT leviticus-section-24-v24-13]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-24-v24-14]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-24-v24-15]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-24-v24-16]
Leviticus 24:16
Let one who names the Lord’s name surely be put to death. Let the whole congregation of Israel stone him with stones. Whether resident foreigner or native-born, when he names the Lord’s name, let him die.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-24-v24-17]
Leviticus 24:17
And if a man strikes a human being and the person dies, he shall surely be put to death.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-24-v24-18]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-24-v24-19]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-24-v24-20]

[UNIT leviticus-section-24-v24-21]
Leviticus 24:21
One who strikes a human being and the person dies shall surely be put to death.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-24-v24-22]

--- Leviticus 25 ---

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-1]
Leviticus 25:1

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-2]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-3]

For six years you shall sow your field, and for six years you shall prune your vine and gather its fruit.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-4]
Leviticus 25:4
But in the seventh year the land shall have a Sabbath, a rest, a Sabbath unto the Lord. You shall not sow your field or prune your vine.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-5]
Leviticus 25:5
And you shall not reap the things growing of themselves in your field or gather the grapes of your consecration. It shall be a year of rest for the land.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-6]
Leviticus 25:6
And the land’s Sabbath produce shall be food for you, your male slave, your female slave, your hired worker, and the lodger attached to you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-7]

And all its produce shall also be food for your livestock and the wild animals in your land.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-8]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-9]
Leviticus 25:9
And you shall make proclamation with a trumpet sound throughout your land in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month. On the Day of Atonement you shall make proclamation with a trumpet throughout your land.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-10]
Leviticus 25:10
And you shall consecrate the fiftieth year, and proclaim release throughout the land unto all who dwell therein; this shall be a year of release, a signal unto you; and each one shall depart unto his possession, and each of you shall depart unto his ancestral homeland.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-11]
Leviticus 25:11
This is a signal of release: the fiftieth year shall be a year for you. You shall not sow, reap what grows of itself, or gather its consecrated produce.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-12]
Leviticus 25:12
For it is a signal of release; it shall be holy to you. You shall eat its produce from the fields.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-13]
Leviticus 25:13
In the year of release, at its signal, each shall return to his possession.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-14]
Leviticus 25:14
But if one sells property unto your neighbour, or you acquire it from your neighbour, let no man oppress his neighbour.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-15]
Leviticus 25:15
According to the number of years after the signal you shall acquire from your neighbour; according to the number of harvest years he shall sell to you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-16]
Leviticus 25:16
As the years increase, you shall increase its purchase price; as the years decrease, you shall decrease its purchase price, for he is selling you a number of harvests.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-17]
Leviticus 25:17
Let no man oppress his neighbour, and you shall fear the Lord your God; I am the Lord your God.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-18]
Leviticus 25:18
And you shall do all My statutes and all My judgments, keep them, and do them; then you shall dwell confidently on the land.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-19]
Leviticus 25:19
And the land shall yield its produce, and you shall eat to fullness and dwell confidently upon it.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-20]
Leviticus 25:20

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-21]
Leviticus 25:21

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-22]
Leviticus 25:22
And you shall sow in the eighth year and eat old produce. Until the ninth year, until its produce comes in, you shall eat old stores from the old.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-23]
Leviticus 25:23
And the land shall not be sold in perpetuity, for the land is Mine; for you are resident foreigners and lodgers before Me;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-24]
Leviticus 25:24

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-25]
Leviticus 25:25
But if your brother who is with you becomes poor, and sells some of his possession, and his nearest kinsman comes, he shall redeem that which his brother sold.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-26]
Leviticus 25:26
If someone has no kinsman but prospers by his hand and enough is found for his redemption,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-27]
Leviticus 25:27

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-28]
Leviticus 25:28
If his hand does not prosper enough to repay him, the sale shall remain with the one who acquired it until the sixth year of release. It shall go out at the release, and he shall depart to his possession.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-29]
Leviticus 25:29
But if anyone sells a dwelling house in a walled city, its redemption shall be possible until a year of days is fulfilled; that shall be its redemption period.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-30]
Leviticus 25:30
If it is not redeemed before its whole year is complete, the house in the city that has a wall shall be confirmed permanently to its buyer throughout his generations. It shall not go out at the release.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-31]
Leviticus 25:31
But houses in settlements that have no surrounding wall shall be reckoned with the field of the land. They shall always be redeemable and shall go out at the release.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-32]
Leviticus 25:32
And the cities of the Levites—the houses in their cities of possession—shall always be redeemable by the Levites.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-33]
Leviticus 25:33
And whosoever redeems from the Levites, the sale of their houses in the city of their possession shall go out at the release; for the houses in the cities of the Levites are their possession among the sons of Israel.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-34]
Leviticus 25:34
And the fields set apart for their cities shall not be sold, for this is their everlasting possession.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-35]
Leviticus 25:35
If your brother becomes poor and grows weak in his hands beside you, you shall support him as a resident foreigner and a lodger, and your brother shall live with you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-36]
Leviticus 25:36
You shall take no interest or increase from him, and you shall fear your God; I am the Lord; and your brother shall live with you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-37]
Leviticus 25:37
You shall not give him your silver at interest or give your food for an increase.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-38]
Leviticus 25:38
I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt to give you the land of Canaan and to be your God.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-39]
Leviticus 25:39
If your brother is brought low beside you and is sold to you, he shall not serve you with the service of a household slave.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-40]
Leviticus 25:40
He shall be with you as a hired worker or a lodger; he shall work beside you until the year of release.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-41]
Leviticus 25:41
And he shall go out at the release, and his children with him. He shall depart to his kin and return to his ancestral possession.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-42]
Leviticus 25:42
For these are My household slaves, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt; one shall not be sold with the sale of a household slave.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-43]
Leviticus 25:43
You shall not wear him down with toil, but you shall fear the Lord your God.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-44]
Leviticus 25:44
And your male slave and your female slave, as many as you have from the nations which are round about you: from them you may acquire a male slave and a female slave.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-45]
Leviticus 25:45
And you may also acquire from the sons of the lodgers among you and from their relatives who come to be in your land; they shall become your possession.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-46]
Leviticus 25:46
And you shall distribute them to your children after you, and they shall be held by you permanently. But among your brethren, the sons of Israel, no one shall wear down his brother with toils.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-47]
Leviticus 25:47
If the hand of the resident foreigner or lodger beside you gains means, and your brother becomes needy and is sold to the resident foreigner or lodger beside you, a foreigner by birth,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-48]
Leviticus 25:48
after he is sold to him, he shall have a right of redemption. One of his brethren may redeem him,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-49]
Leviticus 25:49
his father’s brother or the son of his father’s brother may redeem him, or one of his close kin from his tribe may redeem him; but if, having prospered by his hands, he redeems himself,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-50]
Leviticus 25:50
then he shall calculate with the one who acquired him from the year he sold himself to him until the year of release. His sale price shall be like a hired worker’s pay; he shall be with him year by year.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-51]
Leviticus 25:51
If many years remain for someone, he shall repay his redemption from his sale money in proportion to them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-52]
Leviticus 25:52
If few years remain until the year of release, he shall calculate with him according to his years and repay his redemption.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-53]
Leviticus 25:53
He shall be with him as a hired worker year by year; you shall not wear him down with toil before you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-54]
Leviticus 25:54
If he is not redeemed by these means, he shall go out in the year of release, he and his children with him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-25-v25-55]
Leviticus 25:55
For the sons of Israel are household slaves to Me; these are My servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. I am the Lord your God.

[UNIT leviticus-section-26-v26-1]

[/UNIT]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-26-v26-6]

And war shall not pass through your land. I will give peace in your land. You shall lie down, with no one to frighten you, and I will destroy harmful animals from your land.

[UNIT leviticus-section-26-v26-9]

And I will look upon you, increase you, multiply you, and establish My covenant with you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-26-v26-10]
Leviticus 26:10
And you shall eat old stores and old stores of old stores, and clear out the old before the new.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-26-v26-11]
Leviticus 26:11
And I will place My covenant among you, and My soul shall not abhor you;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-26-v26-12]
Leviticus 26:12
and I will walk among you and be your God, and you shall be My people.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-26-v26-13]
Leviticus 26:13
I am the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt while you were slaves. I shattered the bond of your yoke and led you with boldness.

[UNIT leviticus-section-26-v26-14]
Leviticus 26:14
But if you do not obey Me and do not do these ordinances of Mine,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-26-v26-15]

[UNIT leviticus-section-26-v26-16]
Leviticus 26:16
then I will do this to you: I will bring distress upon you, scab and jaundice that waste your eyes and melt away your life. You shall sow your seeds in vain, and your adversaries shall eat them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-26-v26-17]
Leviticus 26:17
And I will set My face against you, and you shall fall before your enemies. Those who hate you shall pursue you, and you shall flee when no one pursues you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-26-v26-18]
Leviticus 26:18
And if up to this point you do not obey Me, I will discipline you seven times more for your sins.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-26-v26-19]
Leviticus 26:19
And I will shatter the arrogance of your pride, and make your heaven iron, and your land as bronze;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-26-v26-20]
Leviticus 26:20
and your strength shall be in vain. Your land shall not yield its seed, and the tree of your field shall not yield its fruit.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-26-v26-21]
Leviticus 26:21
And if after these things you walk crookedly and will not obey Me, I will add seven blows upon you according to your sins.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-26-v26-22]

And I will send the wild animals of the land against you. They shall devour you, consume your livestock, and make you few, so that your roads become desolate.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-26-v26-23]

And if by these things you are not disciplined, but walk crookedly toward Me,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-26-v26-24]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-26-v26-25]

[UNIT leviticus-section-26-v26-26]

[UNIT leviticus-section-26-v26-27]
Leviticus 26:27
If after these things you do not obey Me, but walk crookedly toward Me,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-26-v26-28]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-26-v26-29]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-26-v26-30]

[UNIT leviticus-section-26-v26-32]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-26-v26-33]

[UNIT leviticus-section-26-v26-34]

[UNIT leviticus-section-26-v26-35]

[UNIT leviticus-section-26-v26-36]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-26-v26-37]
Leviticus 26:37
and brother shall disregard brother as in war, though no one runs after them. You shall not be able to withstand your enemies.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-26-v26-38]
Leviticus 26:38
And you shall perish among the nations, and your enemies’ land shall devour you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-26-v26-39]
Leviticus 26:39
And those who remain of you shall be ruined because of your sins; they shall waste away in the land of their enemies.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-26-v26-40]
Leviticus 26:40
And they shall confess their sins and their fathers’ sins, because they transgressed and disregarded Me, and because they walked crookedly before Me.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-26-v26-41]
Leviticus 26:41
And I too walked with them in contrary anger, and I will destroy them in their enemies’ land. Then their uncircumcised heart will feel shame, and then they will accept their sins.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-26-v26-42]
Leviticus 26:42
And I will remember the covenant of Jacob and the covenant of Isaac, and the covenant of Abraham I will remember; and I will remember the land.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-26-v26-43]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-26-v26-44]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-26-v26-45]

--- Leviticus 27 ---

[UNIT leviticus-section-27-v27-1]
Leviticus 27:1
And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying:
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-27-v27-2]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-27-v27-3]
Leviticus 27:3

[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-27-v27-4]
Leviticus 27:4
For a female the assessed value shall be thirty didrachmas.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-27-v27-5]
Leviticus 27:5
From five to twenty years old, the valuation shall be twenty didrachmas for a male and ten didrachmas for a female.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-27-v27-6]
Leviticus 27:6
From one month to five years old, the valuation shall be five didrachmas of silver for a male and three didrachmas for a female.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-27-v27-7]
Leviticus 27:7
From sixty years old and upward, the valuation shall be fifteen didrachmas of silver for a male and ten didrachmas for a female.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-27-v27-8]
Leviticus 27:8
But if he is too poor for the valuation, he shall stand before the priest, and the priest shall value him; the priest shall value him according to the strength of the hand of the one who vowed.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-27-v27-9]
Leviticus 27:9
If it concerns livestock of a kind presented as a gift unto the Lord, whatever one gives from these unto the Lord shall be holy.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-27-v27-10]
Leviticus 27:10
He shall not exchange it, good for bad or bad for good. If he does exchange it, animal for animal, both it and its substitute shall be holy.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-27-v27-11]
Leviticus 27:11
If it concerns any unclean livestock of a kind not presented as a gift unto the Lord, he shall set the animal before the priest.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-27-v27-12]
Leviticus 27:12
And the priest shall value it, between good and bad. As the priest values it, so it shall stand.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-27-v27-13]
Leviticus 27:13
If he does redeem it, he shall add a fifth to its valuation.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-27-v27-14]
Leviticus 27:14
And if a man consecrates his house as holy unto the Lord, the priest shall value it, between good and bad. As the priest values it, so it shall stand.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-27-v27-15]
Leviticus 27:15
If the one who consecrated it redeems his house, he shall add a fifth of the silver of the valuation to it, and it shall be his.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-27-v27-16]
Leviticus 27:16
If a man consecrates unto the Lord part of the field of his possession, the valuation shall be according to its seed: fifty didrachmas of silver for a kor of barley.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-27-v27-17]
Leviticus 27:17
If he consecrates his field from the year of release, it shall stand according to its valuation.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-27-v27-18]
Leviticus 27:18
If he consecrates his field later, after the release, the priest shall calculate the silver for him according to the years remaining until the year of release, and a deduction shall be made from its assessment.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-27-v27-19]
Leviticus 27:19
If the one who consecrated the field redeems it, he shall add a fifth of the silver to its valuation, and it shall be his.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-27-v27-20]
Leviticus 27:20
If he does not redeem the field and sells the field to another man, he shall no longer redeem it.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-27-v27-21]
Leviticus 27:21
When the release has passed, the field shall be holy unto the Lord like land set apart. It shall become the priest’s possession.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-27-v27-22]
Leviticus 27:22
If he consecrates unto the Lord part of a field he acquired, which is not part of the field of his inherited possession,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-27-v27-23]
Leviticus 27:23
the priest shall calculate for him the total valuation from the year of release, and he shall repay the valuation on that day as holy unto the Lord.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-27-v27-24]
Leviticus 27:24
And in the year of release the field shall be returned to the man from whom he acquired it, whose possession the land was.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-27-v27-25]
Leviticus 27:25
And every valuation shall be by sacred weights; the didrachma shall be twenty obols.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-27-v27-26]
Leviticus 27:26
And every firstborn which is born among your livestock shall belong unto the Lord, and none shall consecrate it; whether calf or sheep, it is the Lord’s.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-27-v27-27]
Leviticus 27:27
If it is one of the unclean four-footed animals, he shall exchange it according to its valuation and add a fifth to it, and it shall be his. If he does not redeem it, it shall be sold according to its assessed value.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-27-v27-28]
Leviticus 27:28
But every devoted thing which a man dedicates unto the Lord, of all that he has, from man unto livestock, and from the field of his possession, he shall neither sell nor redeem; every devoted thing shall be most holy unto the Lord.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-27-v27-29]
Leviticus 27:29
And whatsoever is devoted from among men shall not be redeemed, but shall surely be put to death.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-27-v27-30]
Leviticus 27:30
Every tithe of the land, from the seed of the land and the fruit of trees, belongs unto the Lord; it is holy unto the Lord.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-27-v27-31]
Leviticus 27:31
But if a man indeed redeems his tithe, he shall add a fifth part unto it, and it shall be his.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-27-v27-32]
Leviticus 27:32
And every tithe of cattle and sheep, and everything that comes under the staff in the count—the tenth shall be holy unto the Lord.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-27-v27-33]
Leviticus 27:33
You shall not exchange a good one for a bad one; but if you do indeed exchange it, its substitute also shall be holy; it shall not be redeemed.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT leviticus-section-27-v27-34]
Leviticus 27:34
These are the commandments that the Lord commanded Moses for the sons of Israel on Mount Sinai.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-8-v8-1]
Numbers 8:1
And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying:
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-8-v8-2]
Numbers 8:2

[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-8-v8-3]
Numbers 8:3
And Aaron did so. He lit its lamps from the one side toward the front of the lampstand, as the Lord instructed Moses.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-8-v8-4]
Numbers 8:4
And this was the construction of the lampstand: solid gold, its stem and its lilies, entirely solid. According to the form the Lord showed Moses, so he made the lampstand.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-8-v8-5]
Numbers 8:5
And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying:
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-8-v8-6]
Numbers 8:6
Take the Levites from among the sons of Israel, and you shall purify them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-8-v8-7]
Numbers 8:7
And you shall do thus unto them for their purification: you shall sprinkle them with water of purification, and a razor shall pass over their whole body, and they shall wash their garments and be clean.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-8-v8-8]
Numbers 8:8
And they shall take one calf from the cattle, and its sacrifice of fine flour prepared with oil; and you shall take a year-old calf from the cattle for sin.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-8-v8-9]
Numbers 8:9
And you shall bring the Levites before the Tent of Testimony, and shall gather the whole congregation of the sons of Israel.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-8-v8-10]
Numbers 8:10
And you shall bring the Levites before the Lord, and the sons of Israel shall lay their hands upon the Levites.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-8-v8-11]
Numbers 8:11
And Aaron shall set the Levites apart as a gift before the Lord from the sons of Israel, so that they may perform the works of the Lord.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-8-v8-12]
Numbers 8:12
But the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the calves; and he shall offer the one for sin and the other for a whole burnt offering unto the Lord, to make atonement for them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-8-v8-13]
Numbers 8:13
And you shall set the Levites before the Lord, and before Aaron, and before his sons, and shall give them as a gift before the Lord.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-8-v8-14]
Numbers 8:14
And you shall separate the Levites from among the sons of Israel, and they shall be Mine.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-8-v8-15]
Numbers 8:15
And after these things the Levites shall enter to perform the works of the Tent of Testimony; and you shall cleanse them, and shall give them before the Lord.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-8-v8-16]
Numbers 8:16
For they are given to Me as a gift from among the sons of Israel. In place of those opening every womb, all the firstborn among the sons of Israel, I have taken them for Myself.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-8-v8-17]
Numbers 8:17
For every firstborn among the sons of Israel is Mine, human and livestock alike. On the day I struck down every firstborn in the land of Egypt, I consecrated them to Myself.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-8-v8-18]
Numbers 8:18
And I took the Levites in place of every firstborn among the sons of Israel.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-8-v8-19]
Numbers 8:19
And I gave the Levites as a gift unto Aaron and his sons from among the sons of Israel, to perform the works of the sons of Israel in the Tent of Testimony and make atonement for the sons of Israel, and there shall be no one among the sons of Israel approaching the holy things.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-8-v8-20]
Numbers 8:20
And Moses, Aaron, and the whole congregation of the sons of Israel did for the Levites everything that the Lord commanded Moses concerning the Levites. So the sons of Israel did for them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-8-v8-21]
Numbers 8:21
And the Levites purified themselves and washed their clothes. Aaron gave them as a gift before the Lord, and Aaron made atonement for them to purify them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-8-v8-22]
Numbers 8:22
And afterward the Levites entered to minister their ministry in the Tent of Testimony before Aaron and his sons. As the Lord instructed Moses concerning the Levites, so they did for them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-8-v8-23]
Numbers 8:23
And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying:
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-8-v8-24]
Numbers 8:24
This concerns the Levites: from twenty-five years old and upward, they shall enter to work in the Tent of Testimony.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-8-v8-25]
Numbers 8:25
And from fifty years old he shall withdraw from the ministry, and shall work no longer.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-8-v8-26]
Numbers 8:26
And his brother shall minister in the Tent of Testimony, to keep the charges; but he shall perform no work. Thus you shall deal with the Levites in their charges.
[/UNIT]

--- Numbers 9 ---

[UNIT numbers-section-9-v9-1]
Numbers 9:1
And the Lord spoke unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the second year after they came out of the land of Egypt, in the first month, saying:
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-9-v9-2]
Numbers 9:2
Tell the sons of Israel to observe the Passover at its appointed time.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-9-v9-3]
Numbers 9:3
On the fourteenth day of the first month, toward evening, you shall observe it at the appointed times; you shall observe it according to its law and according to its prescribed determination.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-9-v9-4]
Numbers 9:4
And Moses told the sons of Israel to observe the Passover.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-9-v9-5]
Numbers 9:5
At the beginning, on the fourteenth day of the month in the wilderness of Sinai, the sons of Israel did as the Lord instructed Moses.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-9-v9-6]
Numbers 9:6
And men arrived who were unclean through a dead person and could not observe the Passover that day. They approached Moses and Aaron that day.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-9-v9-7]
Numbers 9:7
And those men said to him: We are unclean through a dead person. Must we therefore fail to present the gift unto the Lord at its appointed time among the sons of Israel?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-9-v9-8]
Numbers 9:8
And Moses said unto them: Stand here, and I will hear what the Lord will command concerning you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-9-v9-9]
Numbers 9:9
And the Lord spoke unto Moses, saying:
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-9-v9-10]
Numbers 9:10
Speak unto the sons of Israel, saying: If any man among you, or among your generations, is unclean through a dead person, or is on a distant journey, he shall observe the Passover unto the Lord.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-9-v9-11]
Numbers 9:11
In the second month, on the fourteenth day, toward evening, they shall observe it. They shall eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-9-v9-12]
Numbers 9:12
They shall leave none of it until morning and shall break no bone of it. They shall observe it according to the law of the Passover.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-9-v9-13]
Numbers 9:13
And if a man is clean, and is not on a distant journey, and fails to observe the Passover, that soul shall be destroyed from his people; because he did not present the gift unto the Lord at its appointed time, that man shall bear his sin.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-9-v9-14]
Numbers 9:14
But if a sojourner comes unto you in your land, and observes the Passover unto the Lord, he shall observe it according to the law of the Passover and according to its prescribed order. You shall have one law, both for the sojourner and for the native of the land.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-9-v9-15]
Numbers 9:15
And on the day the Tent was erected, the cloud covered the Tent, the House of Testimony. In the evening there was over the Tent an appearance like fire until morning.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-9-v9-16]
Numbers 9:16
So it was continually: the cloud covered it by day, and an appearance of fire by night.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-9-v9-17]
Numbers 9:17
And whenever the cloud rose from the Tent, afterward the sons of Israel set out. Where the cloud stood, there the sons of Israel camped.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-9-v9-18]
Numbers 9:18
By the command of the Lord the sons of Israel shall camp, and by the command of the Lord they shall set out; all the days in which the cloud overshadows the Tent, the sons of Israel shall camp.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-9-v9-19]
Numbers 9:19
And when the cloud remains over the Tent for many days, the sons of Israel shall keep the charge of God, and shall in no wise set out.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-9-v9-20]
Numbers 9:20
And it shall be, when the cloud covers the Tent for a number of days, that by the voice of the Lord they shall camp, and by the command of the Lord they shall set out.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-9-v9-21]
Numbers 9:21
And it shall be, when the cloud remains from evening until morning, and the cloud rises in the morning, that they shall set out by day or by night.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-9-v9-22]
Numbers 9:22
For the days of a month, while the cloud continues overshadowing it, the sons of Israel shall camp, and shall in no wise set out.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-9-v9-23]
Numbers 9:23
For by the command of the Lord they shall set out. They kept the Lord’s charge, by the command of the Lord through Moses.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-10-v10-4]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-10-v10-5]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-10-v10-6]
Numbers 10:6

They shall blow a signal at their departure.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-10-v10-7]
Numbers 10:7
And when you gather the congregation, you shall blow, but not with a signal.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-10-v10-8]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-10-v10-9]

[UNIT numbers-section-10-v10-10]
Numbers 10:10

--- Numbers 19 ---

[UNIT numbers-section-19-v19-1]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-19-v19-2]

[UNIT numbers-section-19-v19-3]

[/UNIT]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-19-v19-5]
Numbers 19:5

[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-19-v19-6]
Numbers 19:6
And the priest shall take cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet material, and they shall throw them into the burning heifer.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-19-v19-7]
Numbers 19:7
And the priest shall wash his clothes and bathe his body in water. Afterward he may enter the camp, but the priest shall be unclean until evening.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-19-v19-8]
Numbers 19:8
And the one who burns it shall wash his clothes and bathe his body, and he shall be unclean until evening.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-19-v19-9]
Numbers 19:9
And a clean person shall gather the heifer's ashes and deposit them outside the camp in a clean place. They shall be kept for the congregation of the sons of Israel as water of sprinkling; it is a means of purification.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-19-v19-10]
Numbers 19:10
And the one who gathers the heifer's ashes shall wash his clothes and be unclean until evening. This shall be an everlasting ordinance for the sons of Israel and the attached sojourners.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-19-v19-11]
Numbers 19:11
Whosoever touches a dead person, any human being who has died, shall be unclean for seven days.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-19-v19-12]
Numbers 19:12
That person shall be purified on the third day and on the seventh day, and he shall be clean. If he is not purified on the third day and on the seventh day, he shall not be clean.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-19-v19-13]
Numbers 19:13
Whosoever touches the dead body of any human being who has died, and is not purified, has defiled the Tent of the Lord; that soul shall be wiped out from Israel. Because water of sprinkling was not sprinkled upon him, he is unclean; his uncleanness is still in him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-19-v19-14]
Numbers 19:14
And this is the law: If a person dies in a house, everyone who enters the house and everything in the house shall be unclean for seven days.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-19-v19-15]
Numbers 19:15
And every open vessel without a fastening tied upon it is unclean.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-19-v19-16]
Numbers 19:16
And anyone who touches, on the open plain, one slain, a dead person, a human bone, or a tomb shall be unclean for seven days.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-19-v19-17]
Numbers 19:17
And for the unclean person they shall take some ashes from what was burned for purification, and they shall pour living water over them into a vessel.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-19-v19-18]
Numbers 19:18
And a clean man shall take hyssop, dip it in the water, and sprinkle it around the house, the vessels, and the people who were there, and on whoever touched the human bone, the slain person, the dead person, or the tomb.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-19-v19-19]
Numbers 19:19
And the clean person shall sprinkle the unclean person on the third day and on the seventh day. He shall be purified on the seventh day, wash his clothes, and bathe in water, and he shall be unclean until evening.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-19-v19-20]
Numbers 19:20
And if a man is defiled, and is not purified, that soul shall be destroyed from the midst of the congregation, because he has defiled the holy things of the Lord; because water of sprinkling was not sprinkled upon him, he is unclean.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-19-v19-21]
Numbers 19:21
And this shall be an everlasting ordinance for you. The one who sprinkles the water of sprinkling shall wash his clothes, and whosoever touches the water of sprinkling shall be unclean until evening.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-19-v19-22]
Numbers 19:22
And whatever the unclean person touches shall be unclean, and the person who touches it shall be unclean until evening.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-35-v35-14]

You shall provide three towns across the Jordan, and you shall provide three towns in the land of Canaan.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-35-v35-15]
Numbers 35:15
There shall be a refuge for the sons of Israel; for the sojourner and the resident stranger among you, these towns shall also be refuges, so that anyone who strikes a person unintentionally may flee there.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-35-v35-16]
Numbers 35:16
But if he strikes someone with an iron object and that person dies, he is a murderer. Let the murderer surely be put to death.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-35-v35-17]
Numbers 35:17
If he strikes someone with a stone from his hand capable of causing death and that person dies, he is a murderer. Let the murderer surely be put to death.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-35-v35-18]
Numbers 35:18
If he strikes someone with a wooden object from his hand capable of causing death and that person dies, he is a murderer. Let the murderer surely be put to death.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-35-v35-19]
Numbers 35:19
The kinsman who avenges blood shall himself kill the murderer. When he encounters him, he shall kill him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-35-v35-20]
Numbers 35:20
If he pushes someone out of enmity and throws an object at him from ambush and that person dies,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-35-v35-21]
Numbers 35:21
or strikes him with his hand out of wrath and he dies, let the one who struck him surely be put to death; he is a murderer. Let the murderer surely be put to death. The kinsman who avenges blood shall kill the murderer when he encounters him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-35-v35-22]
Numbers 35:22
But if he suddenly pushes someone without enmity, or throws any object at him without ambush,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-35-v35-23]
Numbers 35:23
or, without his knowing, a stone capable of causing death falls upon him and he dies, though he was not his enemy and was not seeking to harm him,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-35-v35-24]
Numbers 35:24
And then the congregation shall judge between the one who struck him and the kinsman who avenges blood according to these judgments.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-35-v35-25]
Numbers 35:25
And the congregation shall rescue the killer from the kinsman who avenges blood and restore him to the city of refuge to which he fled. He shall live there until the high priest dies, whom they anointed with the holy oil.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-35-v35-26]
Numbers 35:26
But if the killer goes outside the boundaries of the city to which he fled,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-35-v35-27]
Numbers 35:27
and the kinsman who avenges blood finds him outside the boundaries of his city of refuge and kills the killer, the avenger is not liable.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-35-v35-28]
Numbers 35:28
For he must live in the city of refuge until the high priest dies. After the death of the high priest, the killer may return to the land of his possession.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-35-v35-29]
Numbers 35:29
And these shall be an ordinance of judgment for you throughout your generations in all your settlements.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-35-v35-30]
Numbers 35:30
In every case of a person being struck down, you shall put the killer to death through witnesses. A single witness shall not testify against a person so as to cause his death.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-35-v35-31]
Numbers 35:31
And you shall not accept a ransom for a life from the killer who is guilty and liable to be killed; he shall surely be put to death.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-35-v35-32]
Numbers 35:32
You shall not accept a ransom concerning flight to a city of refuge, allowing him to live in the land again before the high priest dies.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-35-v35-33]
Numbers 35:33
And you shall in no wise stain with murder the land wherein you dwell; for this blood stains the land with murder, and atonement shall not be made for the land for the blood shed upon it, except by the blood of him who shed it.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-35-v35-34]
Numbers 35:34
And you shall not defile the land in which you dwell, in which I will dwell among you, for I am the Lord, dwelling among the sons of Israel.
[/UNIT]

--- Numbers 36 ---
