Numbers 36:1
And the rulers of the tribe of the descendants of Gilead son of Machir, son of Manasseh, from the tribe of Joseph’s descendants, approached and spoke before Moses, Eleazar the priest, and the rulers of the ancestral houses of the sons of Israel.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-36-v36-2]
Numbers 36:2
And they said: The Lord commanded our lord to distribute the inherited land by lot to the sons of Israel, and the Lord instructed the lord to give the inheritance of our brother Zelophehad to his daughters.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-36-v36-3]
Numbers 36:3
And if they become wives in one of the Israelite tribes, their allotment will be taken from our fathers’ possession and added to the inheritance of the tribe into which they marry. It will be taken from our inherited allotment.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-36-v36-4]
Numbers 36:4
If the release comes for the sons of Israel, their inheritance will be added to the inheritance of the tribe into which they marry, and their inheritance will be taken from the inheritance of our ancestral tribe.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-36-v36-5]
Numbers 36:5
And Moses commanded the sons of Israel by the Lord’s instruction, saying: Thus speaks the tribe of Joseph’s descendants.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-36-v36-6]
Numbers 36:6
This is the word that the Lord prescribed concerning Zelophehad’s daughters: Let them marry whom they please, but they shall marry from their father’s clan.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-36-v36-7]
Numbers 36:7
And no inheritance among the sons of Israel shall pass from tribe to tribe, for each Israelite shall hold fast to the inheritance of his ancestral tribe.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-36-v36-8]
Numbers 36:8
And every daughter who succeeds as next of kin to an inheritance among the Israelite tribes shall marry someone from her father’s clan, so that each Israelite may succeed as next of kin to his paternal inheritance.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-36-v36-9]
Numbers 36:9
And no allotment shall pass from one tribe to another; rather, the sons of Israel shall each hold fast to their own inheritance.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-36-v36-10]
Numbers 36:10
Zelophehad’s daughters did as the Lord had prescribed unto Moses.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-36-v36-11]
Numbers 36:11
And Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, Noah, and Mahlah, the daughters of Zelophehad, married their cousins.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-36-v36-12]
Numbers 36:12
They married within the clan of Manasseh, of Joseph’s descendants, and their inheritance remained with the tribe of their father’s clan.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT numbers-section-36-v36-13]
Numbers 36:13
These are the commandments, ordinances, and judgments that the Lord commanded through Moses on the western side of Moab, by the Jordan opposite Jericho.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-11-v11-17]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-11-v11-18]
Deuteronomy 11:18

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-11-v11-19]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-11-v11-20]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-11-v11-21]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-11-v11-22]
Deuteronomy 11:22

[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-11-v11-23]
Deuteronomy 11:23

[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-11-v11-24]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-11-v11-25]
Deuteronomy 11:25
None shall stand before you; the Lord your God shall lay the dread of you and the fear of you upon all the land whereon you shall tread, as the Lord has spoken unto you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-11-v11-26]
Deuteronomy 11:26
Behold, I set before you this day a blessing and a curse:
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-11-v11-27]
Deuteronomy 11:27

[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-11-v11-28]
Deuteronomy 11:28
and the curses, if you do not hearken unto the commandments of the Lord your God, which I command you this day, and wander from the way which I commanded you, going to serve other gods which you have not known.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-11-v11-29]
Deuteronomy 11:29
And it shall be, when the Lord your God brings you into the land whither you pass over to inherit it, that you shall set the blessing upon Mount Gerizim, and the curse upon Mount Ebal.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-11-v11-30]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-11-v11-31]
Deuteronomy 11:31
For you pass over the Jordan, to enter and inherit the land which the Lord your God gives you for a possession for ever; and you shall inherit it, and dwell therein.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-11-v11-32]

And you shall take heed to do all His ordinances and these judgments, which I set before you this day.

--- Deuteronomy 12 ---

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-12-v12-1]
Deuteronomy 12:1
And these are the ordinances and judgments which you shall take heed to do in the land which the Lord, the God of your fathers, gives you for a possession, all the days that you live upon the earth.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-12-v12-2]
Deuteronomy 12:2
You shall utterly destroy all the places wherein the nations whose possession you inherit served their gods, upon the high mountains, and upon the hills, and under the leafy tree.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-12-v12-3]
Deuteronomy 12:3
And you shall pull down their altars, and break their pillars, and cut down their sacred groves, and burn the graven images of their gods with fire; and their name shall perish from that place.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-12-v12-4]
Deuteronomy 12:4
You shall not do so unto the Lord your God,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-12-v12-5]
Deuteronomy 12:5

[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-12-v12-6]
Deuteronomy 12:6
And you shall bring thither your whole burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, and your firstfruits, and your vowed offerings, and your freewill offerings, and the firstborn of your cattle and of your sheep.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-12-v12-7]
Deuteronomy 12:7
And you shall eat there before the Lord your God, and rejoice in all that you put your hand unto, you and your houses, because the Lord your God has blessed you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-12-v12-8]
Deuteronomy 12:8
You shall not do all that we do here this day, every man that which is pleasing in his own sight;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-12-v12-9]
Deuteronomy 12:9
for you have not yet come unto the rest and unto the inheritance which the Lord your God gives you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-12-v12-10]
Deuteronomy 12:10
And you shall pass over the Jordan, and dwell in the land which the Lord your God gives you to inherit; and He shall give you rest from all your enemies round about, and you shall dwell in safety.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-12-v12-11]
Deuteronomy 12:11
And it shall be, at the place which the Lord your God shall choose for His name to be called upon there, you shall bring thither all that I command you this day: your whole burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, and your tithes, and the firstfruits of your hands, and your gifts, and all the choice gifts which you shall vow unto your God.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-12-v12-12]
Deuteronomy 12:12
And you shall rejoice before the Lord your God, you, and your sons, and your daughters, and your male slaves, and your female slaves, and the Levite within your gates; for he has neither portion nor inheritance with you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-12-v12-13]
Deuteronomy 12:13
Take heed unto yourself, that you do not offer your whole burnt offerings in every place that you see,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-12-v12-14]
Deuteronomy 12:14

[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-12-v12-15]
Deuteronomy 12:15
Nevertheless, you may slaughter and eat flesh according to all your desire, according to the blessing of the Lord your God which He has given you in every city. The unclean among you and the clean may eat it together, as the gazelle or the deer.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-12-v12-16]
Deuteronomy 12:16
Only you shall not eat the blood; you shall pour it upon the earth as water.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-12-v12-17]
Deuteronomy 12:17
You may not eat within your cities the tithe of your grain, or of your wine, or of your oil, nor the firstborn of your cattle or of your sheep, nor any of the vows which you shall vow, nor your pledged offerings, nor the firstfruits of your hands;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-12-v12-18]
Deuteronomy 12:18
but you shall eat them before the Lord your God, in the place which the Lord your God shall choose for Himself, you, and your son, and your daughter, and your male slave, and your female slave, and the sojourner within your cities. And you shall rejoice before the Lord your God in all that you put your hand unto.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-12-v12-19]
Deuteronomy 12:19
Take heed unto yourself, that you do not forsake the Levite all the time that you live upon the land.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-12-v12-20]
Deuteronomy 12:20
And if the Lord your God enlarges your borders, as He has spoken unto you, and you say: I will eat flesh, because your soul desires to eat flesh, you may eat flesh according to all the desire of your soul.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-12-v12-21]
Deuteronomy 12:21
And if the place which the Lord your God shall choose for His name to be called upon there is too far from you, you shall slaughter of your cattle and of your sheep which God has given you, as I commanded you, and eat within your cities according to the desire of your soul.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-12-v12-22]
Deuteronomy 12:22
As the gazelle and the deer are eaten, so you shall eat it; the unclean among you and the clean shall eat it alike.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-12-v12-23]
Deuteronomy 12:23
Take diligent heed that you do not eat blood; for its blood is life, and the life shall not be eaten with the flesh.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-12-v12-24]
Deuteronomy 12:24
You shall not eat it; you shall pour it upon the earth as water.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-12-v12-25]
Deuteronomy 12:25
You shall not eat it, that it may be well with you and with your sons after you, if you do that which is good and pleasing before the Lord your God.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-12-v12-26]
Deuteronomy 12:26
Only your holy things which you have, and your vowed offerings, you shall take, and come unto the place which the Lord your God shall choose for His name to be called upon there.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-12-v12-27]
Deuteronomy 12:27
And you shall prepare your whole burnt offerings; you shall offer the flesh upon the altar of the Lord your God, and you shall pour the blood of your sacrifices against the base of the altar of the Lord your God; and you shall eat the flesh.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-12-v12-28]
Deuteronomy 12:28
Keep and hear and do all the words which I command you, that it may be well with you and with your sons for ever, if you do that which is good and pleasing before the Lord your God.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-12-v12-29]
Deuteronomy 12:29
And if the Lord your God destroys from before you the nations whither you go to inherit their land, and you inherit their possession and dwell in their land,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-12-v12-30]
Deuteronomy 12:30
take heed unto yourself, that you do not seek to follow them after they have been destroyed from before you. You shall not inquire after their gods, saying: How do these nations serve their gods? I also will do so.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-12-v12-31]
Deuteronomy 12:31
You shall not do so unto the Lord your God; for the abominations which the Lord hated they did unto their gods, for they burn their sons and their daughters with fire unto their gods.
[/UNIT]

--- Deuteronomy 13 ---

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-13-v13-1]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-13-v13-2]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-13-v13-6]
Deuteronomy 13:6
And that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, shall die; for he spoke to lead you astray from the Lord your God, who brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you from bondage, to thrust you out of the way wherein the Lord your God commanded you to walk. And you shall remove the evil one from among yourselves.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-13-v13-7]
Deuteronomy 13:7
And if your brother, the son of your father or of your mother, or your son, or your daughter, or the wife of your bosom, or your friend who is as your own soul, entices you secretly, saying: Let us go and serve other gods, which you have not known, you nor your fathers,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-13-v13-8]
Deuteronomy 13:8

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-13-v13-9]
Deuteronomy 13:9
you shall not consent unto him, neither shall you hearken unto him; neither shall your eye spare him, nor shall you yearn for him, nor conceal him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-13-v13-10]
Deuteronomy 13:10
You shall surely report him; your hands shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterward the hands of all the people.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-13-v13-11]
Deuteronomy 13:11
And they shall stone him with stones, and he shall die; for he sought to turn you away from the Lord your God, who brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-13-v13-12]
Deuteronomy 13:12
And all Israel shall hear and fear, and shall no more do such an evil thing among you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-13-v13-13]
Deuteronomy 13:13

[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-13-v13-14]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-13-v13-15]
Deuteronomy 13:15

[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-13-v13-16]
Deuteronomy 13:16
you shall surely slay all the inhabitants of that city with the sword; you shall utterly devote it to destruction, and all that is therein.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-13-v13-17]
Deuteronomy 13:17
And you shall gather all its spoil into its streets, and burn the city with fire, and all its spoil, all together before the Lord your God; and it shall be uninhabited for ever, and shall not be built again.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-13-v13-18]
Deuteronomy 13:18
And nothing of that which is devoted to destruction shall cleave to your hand, that the Lord may turn from the fierceness of His wrath, and grant you mercy, and have mercy upon you, and multiply you, as the Lord sware unto your fathers,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-13-v13-19]
Deuteronomy 13:19

--- Deuteronomy 14 ---

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-14-v14-1]
Deuteronomy 14:1
You are sons of the Lord your God; you shall not perform purification rites, neither shall you make a bald place between your eyes for the dead.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-14-v14-2]
Deuteronomy 14:2
For you are a holy people unto the Lord your God; and the Lord your God has chosen you to be unto Him a people for His own possession, out of all the nations upon the face of the earth.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-14-v14-3]
Deuteronomy 14:3
You shall eat no abominable thing.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-14-v14-4]

These are the beasts which you may eat: a calf of the cattle, and a lamb of the sheep, and a young male goat of the goats,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-14-v14-5]
Deuteronomy 14:5

[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-14-v14-6]
Deuteronomy 14:6
Every beast that divides the hoof, and cleaves its hoof into two parts, and brings up the cud among the beasts, these you may eat.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-14-v14-7]
Deuteronomy 14:7
And these you shall not eat of those that bring up the cud, and of those that divide the hoof and cleave its parts: the camel, and the hare, and the rock hyrax; for they bring up the cud, but do not divide the hoof; they are unclean unto you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-14-v14-8]
Deuteronomy 14:8
And the swine, for it divides the hoof and cleaves its parts, but does not chew the cud, is unclean unto you. Of their flesh you shall not eat, neither shall you touch their carcasses.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-14-v14-9]
Deuteronomy 14:9
And these you may eat of all that are in the waters: whatsoever has fins and scales, you may eat.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-14-v14-10]
Deuteronomy 14:10
And whatsoever does not have fins and scales, you shall not eat; they are unclean unto you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-14-v14-11]
Deuteronomy 14:11
Every clean bird you may eat.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-14-v14-12]
Deuteronomy 14:12
And these you shall not eat of them: the eagle, and the griffon vulture, and the sea-eagle,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-14-v14-13]
Deuteronomy 14:13
and the vulture, and the kite, and those like it,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-14-v14-14]
Deuteronomy 14:14
and every raven, and those like it,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-14-v14-15]
Deuteronomy 14:15
and the ostrich, and the owl, and the gull,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-14-v14-16]
Deuteronomy 14:16
and the heron, and the swan, and the ibis,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-14-v14-17]
Deuteronomy 14:17
and the diving bird, and the hawk, and those like it, and the hoopoe, and the night-raven,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-14-v14-18]
Deuteronomy 14:18
and the pelican, and the plover, and those like it, and the purple swamphen, and the bat.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-14-v14-19]
Deuteronomy 14:19
All creeping things among the flying creatures are unclean unto you; you shall not eat of them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-14-v14-20]
Deuteronomy 14:20
Every clean flying creature you may eat.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-14-v14-21]
Deuteronomy 14:21
You shall not eat anything that dies of itself; it shall be given unto the resident alien within your cities, and he shall eat it, or you may sell it unto a foreigner; for you are a holy people unto the Lord your God. You shall not boil a lamb in its mother’s milk.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-14-v14-22]
Deuteronomy 14:22
You shall surely tithe all the produce of your seed, the yield of your field, year by year.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-14-v14-23]

And you shall eat it before the Lord your God, in the place which the Lord your God shall choose for His name to be called upon there. You shall bring the tithes of your grain, and of your wine, and of your oil, and the firstborn of your cattle and of your sheep, that you may learn to fear the Lord your God all your days.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-14-v14-24]
Deuteronomy 14:24
And if the way is too long for you, so that you cannot carry them, because the place which the Lord your God shall choose for His name to be called upon there is far from you, when the Lord your God has blessed you,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-14-v14-25]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-14-v14-26]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-14-v14-27]
Deuteronomy 14:27
and the Levite within your cities; for he has neither portion nor inheritance with you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-14-v14-28]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-14-v14-29]
Deuteronomy 14:29
And the Levite, for he has neither portion nor inheritance with you, and the sojourner, and the orphan, and the widow within your cities shall come, and eat, and be filled; that the Lord your God may bless you in all the works which you do.

--- Deuteronomy 15 ---

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-15-v15-1]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-15-v15-2]
Deuteronomy 15:2

[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-15-v15-3]
Deuteronomy 15:3
Of a foreigner you may exact whatsoever he owes you; but you shall release your brother’s debt unto you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-15-v15-4]
Deuteronomy 15:4
For there shall be none in need among you; for the Lord your God shall surely bless you in the land which the Lord your God gives you for a possession, to inherit it,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-15-v15-5]
Deuteronomy 15:5
if you diligently hearken unto the voice of the Lord your God, to keep and do all these commandments which I command you this day.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-15-v15-6]
Deuteronomy 15:6
For the Lord your God has blessed you, as He has spoken unto you; and you shall lend unto many nations, but you shall not borrow; and you shall rule over many nations, but they shall not rule over you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-15-v15-7]
Deuteronomy 15:7
And if there is among you one of your brethren in need, within any of your cities in the land which the Lord your God gives you, you shall not withhold the affection of your heart, neither shall you close your hand against your needy brother.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-15-v15-8]
Deuteronomy 15:8
You shall freely open your hands unto him, and shall surely lend him as much as he needs, according to his want.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-15-v15-9]
Deuteronomy 15:9
Take heed unto yourself, lest there be a hidden, lawless thought in your heart, saying: The seventh year, the year of release, draws near; and your eye be evil toward your needy brother, and you give him nothing, and he cry against you unto the Lord, and there be great sin upon you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-15-v15-10]
Deuteronomy 15:10
You shall freely give unto him, and shall surely lend him as much as he needs; and your heart shall not be grieved when you give unto him. For because of this the Lord your God shall bless you in all your works, and in all that you put your hand unto.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-15-v15-11]
Deuteronomy 15:11
For the needy shall never cease out of the land; therefore I command you to do this thing, saying: You shall freely open your hands unto your poor brother and unto the needy in your land.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-15-v15-12]
Deuteronomy 15:12
And if your brother, a Hebrew man or a Hebrew woman, is sold unto you, he shall serve you six years; and in the seventh year you shall send him forth free from you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-15-v15-13]
Deuteronomy 15:13
And when you send him forth free from you, you shall not send him away empty.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-15-v15-14]
Deuteronomy 15:14
You shall furnish him generously out of your sheep, and out of your grain, and out of your winepress; as the Lord your God has blessed you, you shall give unto him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-15-v15-15]
Deuteronomy 15:15
And you shall remember that you were a household slave in the land of Egypt, and the Lord your God redeemed you thence; therefore I command you to do this thing.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-15-v15-16]
Deuteronomy 15:16
And if he says unto you: I will not go forth from you, because he loves you and your house, and because it is well with him beside you,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-15-v15-17]
Deuteronomy 15:17
then you shall take an awl, and pierce his ear against the door, and he shall be your household slave for ever; and unto your female slave you shall do likewise.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-15-v15-18]
Deuteronomy 15:18
It shall not seem hard unto you when they are sent forth free from you, for he served you six years for the yearly wage of a hired worker; and the Lord your God shall bless you in all that you do.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-15-v15-19]
Deuteronomy 15:19
Every firstborn male that is born among your cattle and among your sheep you shall sanctify unto the Lord your God. You shall do no work with your firstborn calf, neither shall you shear the firstborn of your sheep.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-15-v15-20]
Deuteronomy 15:20
You shall eat it before the Lord, year by year, in the place which the Lord your God shall choose, you and your house.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-15-v15-21]
Deuteronomy 15:21
And if there is a blemish in it, lameness or blindness or any grievous blemish, you shall not sacrifice it unto the Lord your God.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-15-v15-22]
Deuteronomy 15:22
You shall eat it within your cities; the unclean among you and the clean shall eat it alike, as the gazelle or the deer.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-15-v15-23]
Deuteronomy 15:23
Only you shall not eat the blood; you shall pour it upon the earth as water.
[/UNIT]

--- Deuteronomy 16 ---

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-16-v16-1]
Deuteronomy 16:1
Keep the month of new produce, and observe the Passover unto the Lord your God; for in the month of new produce you came forth out of Egypt by night.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-16-v16-2]
Deuteronomy 16:2
And you shall sacrifice the Passover unto the Lord your God, sheep and cattle, in the place which the Lord your God shall choose for His name to be called upon there.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-16-v16-3]
Deuteronomy 16:3
You shall eat no leaven with it; you shall eat unleavened bread with it for seven days, the bread of affliction, for you came forth out of Egypt in haste; that you may remember the day of your departure out of the land of Egypt all the days of your life.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-16-v16-4]
Deuteronomy 16:4
No leaven shall be seen with you in all your borders seven days; neither shall any of the flesh which you sacrifice in the evening of the first day remain overnight until the morning.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-16-v16-5]
Deuteronomy 16:5
You may not sacrifice the Passover in any of your cities which the Lord your God gives you,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-16-v16-6]
Deuteronomy 16:6
but in the place which the Lord your God shall choose for His name to be called upon there, you shall sacrifice the Passover in the evening, at the setting of the sun, at the time when you came forth out of Egypt.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-16-v16-7]
Deuteronomy 16:7
And you shall boil it, and roast it, and eat it in the place which the Lord your God shall choose; and in the morning you shall turn and go unto your houses.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-16-v16-8]
Deuteronomy 16:8
You shall eat unleavened bread for six days; and on the seventh day shall be a concluding feast, a feast unto the Lord your God. You shall do no work therein, save that which is done for a person’s needs.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-16-v16-9]
Deuteronomy 16:9
You shall count seven complete weeks unto yourself; when you begin to put the sickle to the harvest, you shall begin to count seven weeks.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-16-v16-10]
Deuteronomy 16:10
And you shall keep the Feast of Weeks unto the Lord your God, according to the ability of your hand, of that which He gives you, as the Lord your God has blessed you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-16-v16-11]
Deuteronomy 16:11
And you shall rejoice before the Lord your God, you, and your son, and your daughter, and your male slave, and your female slave, and the Levite within your cities, and the sojourner, and the orphan, and the widow among you, in the place which the Lord your God shall choose for His name to be called upon there.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-16-v16-12]
Deuteronomy 16:12
And you shall remember that you were a household slave in the land of Egypt; and you shall keep and do these commandments.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-16-v16-13]
Deuteronomy 16:13
You shall keep the Feast of Tents seven days, when you have gathered in from your threshing floor and from your winepress.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-16-v16-14]
Deuteronomy 16:14
And you shall rejoice in your feast, you, and your son, and your daughter, and your male slave, and your female slave, and the Levite, and the sojourner, and the orphan, and the widow within your cities.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-16-v16-15]
Deuteronomy 16:15
You shall keep a feast for seven days unto the Lord your God, in the place which the Lord your God shall choose for Himself; and if the Lord your God blesses you in all your produce and in all the work of your hands, you shall rejoice.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-16-v16-16]
Deuteronomy 16:16
Three times in the year shall every male among you appear before the Lord your God, in the place which the Lord shall choose: in the Feast of Unleavened Bread, and in the Feast of Weeks, and in the Feast of the Pitching of Tents. You shall not appear before the Lord your God empty,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-16-v16-17]
Deuteronomy 16:17
but every man according to the ability of your hands, according to the blessing of the Lord your God which He has given you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-16-v16-18]
Deuteronomy 16:18
You shall appoint judges and recording officers for yourself in all your cities which the Lord your God gives you, according to your tribes; and they shall judge the people with righteous judgment.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-16-v16-19]
Deuteronomy 16:19
They shall not pervert judgment, neither shall they show partiality, nor take a bribe; for bribes blind the eyes of the wise, and overthrow the words of the righteous.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-16-v16-20]
Deuteronomy 16:20
You shall pursue justly that which is just, that you may live, and enter and inherit the land which the Lord your God gives you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-16-v16-21]
Deuteronomy 16:21
You shall not plant for yourself a sacred grove, any tree, beside the altar of the Lord your God which you shall make for yourself.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-16-v16-22]
Deuteronomy 16:22
You shall not set up for yourself a pillar, which the Lord your God has hated.
[/UNIT]

--- Deuteronomy 17 ---

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-17-v17-1]
Deuteronomy 17:1
You shall not sacrifice unto the Lord your God a calf or a sheep wherein is a blemish, any evil defect; for it is an abomination unto the Lord your God.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-17-v17-2]
Deuteronomy 17:2
And if there is found among you, within any of your cities which the Lord your God gives you, a man or a woman who does evil before the Lord your God, transgressing His covenant,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-17-v17-3]
Deuteronomy 17:3
and they go and serve other gods, and bow down unto them, unto the sun, or unto the moon, or unto any of the array of heaven, which He has not commanded,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-17-v17-4]
Deuteronomy 17:4
and it is told you, you shall inquire diligently; and behold, if the matter is true, and this abomination has been done in Israel,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-17-v17-5]
Deuteronomy 17:5
then you shall bring forth that man or that woman, and you shall stone them with stones, and they shall die.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-17-v17-6]
Deuteronomy 17:6
Upon the testimony of two witnesses or three witnesses shall he who is condemned to death be put to death; he shall not die upon the testimony of one witness.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-17-v17-7]
Deuteronomy 17:7
And the hand of the witnesses shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterward the hand of all the people; and you shall remove the evil one from among yourselves.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-17-v17-8]
Deuteronomy 17:8
And if a matter in judgment is too hard for you, between blood and blood, and between judgment and judgment, and between injury and injury, and between dispute and dispute, matters of judgment within your cities, you shall arise and go up unto the place which the Lord your God shall choose for His name to be called upon there.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-17-v17-9]
Deuteronomy 17:9
And you shall come unto the Levitical priests, and unto the judge who shall be in those days; and they shall inquire, and declare unto you the judgment.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-17-v17-10]
Deuteronomy 17:10
And you shall do according to the matter which they declare unto you from the place which the Lord your God shall choose for His name to be called upon there; and you shall take diligent heed to do according to all that is laid down for you as law.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-17-v17-11]
Deuteronomy 17:11
You shall do according to the law and according to the judgment which they tell you; you shall not turn aside from the word which they declare unto you, to the right hand or to the left.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-17-v17-12]
Deuteronomy 17:12
And the man who acts presumptuously, and will not hearken unto the priest who stands to minister in the name of the Lord your God, or unto the judge who shall be in those days, that man shall die; and you shall remove the evil one from Israel.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-17-v17-13]
Deuteronomy 17:13
And all the people shall hear and fear, and shall act ungodly no more.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-17-v17-14]
Deuteronomy 17:14
And if you enter the land which the Lord your God gives you for a possession, and inherit it, and dwell therein, and say: I will set a ruler over me, as do the other nations round about me,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-17-v17-15]
Deuteronomy 17:15
you shall surely set over yourself a ruler whom the Lord your God shall choose. You shall set a ruler over yourself from among your brethren; you may not set a foreign man over yourself, for he is not your brother.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-17-v17-16]
Deuteronomy 17:16
For he shall not multiply horses unto himself, neither shall he cause the people to return unto Egypt, that he may multiply horses unto himself; for the Lord has said: You shall not return by this way again.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-17-v17-17]
Deuteronomy 17:17
And he shall not multiply wives unto himself, neither shall his heart turn aside; and he shall not greatly multiply silver and gold unto himself.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-17-v17-18]
Deuteronomy 17:18
And it shall be, when he sits in his rule, that he shall write for himself this second law in a scroll, from the Levitical priests.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-17-v17-19]
Deuteronomy 17:19
And it shall be with him, and he shall read therein all the days of his life, that he may learn to fear the Lord his God, to keep all these commandments and these ordinances, to do them,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-17-v17-20]
Deuteronomy 17:20
that his heart may not be lifted up above his brethren, and that he may not turn aside from the commandments, to the right hand or to the left; that he may prolong his days in his rule, he and his sons, among the sons of Israel.
[/UNIT]

--- Deuteronomy 18 ---

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-18-v18-1]
Deuteronomy 18:1
The Levitical priests, the whole tribe of Levi, shall have neither portion nor inheritance with Israel. The offerings of the Lord are their inheritance; they shall eat them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-18-v18-2]
Deuteronomy 18:2
And they shall have no inheritance among their brethren; the Lord Himself is his inheritance, as He spoke unto him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-18-v18-3]
Deuteronomy 18:3
And this shall be the priests’ due from the people, from them that sacrifice a sacrifice, whether a calf or a sheep: they shall give unto the priest the foreleg, and the cheeks, and the stomach.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-18-v18-4]
Deuteronomy 18:4
And you shall give unto him the firstfruits of your grain, and of your wine, and of your oil, and the first of the fleece of your sheep.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-18-v18-5]
Deuteronomy 18:5
For the Lord your God has chosen him out of all your tribes, to stand before the Lord your God, to minister and to bless in His name, he and his sons among the sons of Israel.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-18-v18-6]
Deuteronomy 18:6
And if a Levite comes from any of your cities, from among all the sons of Israel where he sojourns, according to the desire of his soul, unto the place which the Lord shall choose,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-18-v18-7]
Deuteronomy 18:7
then he shall minister in the name of the Lord his God, as do all his brethren the Levites who stand there before the Lord.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-18-v18-8]
Deuteronomy 18:8
He shall eat an allotted portion, apart from the sale according to his ancestral family.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-18-v18-9]
Deuteronomy 18:9
And when you enter the land which the Lord your God gives you, you shall not learn to do after the abominations of those nations.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-18-v18-10]
Deuteronomy 18:10
There shall not be found among you one who purifies his son or his daughter by fire, or practises divination, or interprets spoken omens, or observes auguries, or works sorcery,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-18-v18-11]
Deuteronomy 18:11
or chants spells, or is a medium, or observes portents, or inquires of the dead.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-18-v18-12]
Deuteronomy 18:12
For everyone who does these things is an abomination unto the Lord your God; for because of these abominations the Lord shall destroy them from before you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-18-v18-13]
Deuteronomy 18:13
You shall be perfect before the Lord your God.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-18-v18-14]
Deuteronomy 18:14
For these nations whose possession you inherit hearken unto omens and divinations; but the Lord your God has not granted you so to do.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-18-v18-15]
Deuteronomy 18:15
The Lord your God shall raise up unto you a prophet from among your brethren, like unto me; you shall hearken unto him,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-18-v18-16]
Deuteronomy 18:16
according to all that you asked of the Lord your God in Horeb, in the day of the assembly, saying: We will no more hear the voice of the Lord our God, neither will we see this great fire any more, lest we die.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-18-v18-17]
Deuteronomy 18:17
And the Lord said unto me: All that they have spoken is right.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-18-v18-18]
Deuteronomy 18:18
I will raise up for them a prophet from among their brethren, like unto you, and will put My word in his mouth; and he shall speak unto them all that I command him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-18-v18-19]
Deuteronomy 18:19
And the man who will not hearken unto whatsoever the prophet shall speak in My name, I will exact retribution from him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-18-v18-20]
Deuteronomy 18:20
But the prophet who shall act ungodly, speaking in My name a word which I commanded him not to speak, or who shall speak in the name of other gods, that prophet shall die.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-18-v18-21]
Deuteronomy 18:21
And if you say in your heart: How shall we know the word which the Lord has not spoken?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-18-v18-22]
Deuteronomy 18:22
Whatsoever the prophet speaks in the name of the Lord, if the word does not come to pass, nor is fulfilled, that is the word which the Lord has not spoken. That prophet has spoken in ungodliness; you shall not spare him.
[/UNIT]

--- Deuteronomy 19 ---

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-19-v19-1]
Deuteronomy 19:1
And when the Lord your God destroys the nations whose land your God gives you, and you inherit their possession, and dwell in their cities and in their houses,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-19-v19-2]
Deuteronomy 19:2
you shall set apart three cities for yourself in the midst of your land which the Lord your God gives you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-19-v19-3]
Deuteronomy 19:3
Mark out the way for yourself, and divide into three parts the territory of your land which the Lord your God apportions unto you; and there shall be a refuge there for every slayer.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-19-v19-4]
Deuteronomy 19:4
And this shall be the ordinance for the slayer who shall flee thither and live: whosoever strikes his neighbour unintentionally, having borne him no hatred aforetime,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-19-v19-5]
Deuteronomy 19:5
as when a man goes with his neighbour into the forest to gather wood, and his hand is jolted with the axe as he cuts the wood, and the iron slips from the wood and strikes his neighbour, so that he dies, he shall flee unto one of these cities and live;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-19-v19-6]
Deuteronomy 19:6
lest the kinsman who avenges blood pursue the slayer while his heart is hot, and overtake him, if the way is long, and strike him mortally, so that he dies, though no sentence of death is due unto him, for he bore his neighbour no hatred aforetime.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-19-v19-7]
Deuteronomy 19:7
Therefore I command you this thing, saying: You shall set apart three cities for yourself.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-19-v19-8]
Deuteronomy 19:8
And if the Lord your God enlarges your borders, as He sware unto your fathers, and the Lord gives you all the land which He promised to give unto your fathers,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-19-v19-9]
Deuteronomy 19:9
if you hearken to do all these commandments which I command you this day, to love the Lord your God, and to walk in all His ways all your days, then you shall add three cities more unto these three,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-19-v19-10]
Deuteronomy 19:10
that innocent blood may not be shed in your land which the Lord your God gives you for a possession, and that there may be none guilty of blood among you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-19-v19-11]
Deuteronomy 19:11
But if a man hates his neighbour, and lies in wait for him, and rises up against him, and strikes him mortally, so that he dies, and flees unto one of these cities,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-19-v19-12]
Deuteronomy 19:12
then the elders of his city shall send and take him thence, and deliver him into the hands of the kinsman who avenges blood, and he shall die.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-19-v19-13]
Deuteronomy 19:13
Your eye shall not spare him; and you shall cleanse the guilt of innocent blood from Israel, and it shall be well with you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-19-v19-14]
Deuteronomy 19:14
You shall not remove your neighbour’s boundaries, which your fathers set in your inheritance, which was allotted unto you in the land which the Lord your God gives you for a possession.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-19-v19-15]
Deuteronomy 19:15
One witness shall not suffice to testify against a man concerning any injustice, or any trespass, or any sin which he sins. At the mouth of two witnesses, and at the mouth of three witnesses, shall every matter be established.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-19-v19-16]
Deuteronomy 19:16
And if an unrighteous witness rises up against a man, accusing him of ungodliness,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-19-v19-17]
Deuteronomy 19:17
then the two men between whom is the dispute shall stand before the Lord, and before the priests, and before the judges who shall be in those days.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-19-v19-18]
Deuteronomy 19:18
And the judges shall inquire diligently; and behold, if the unrighteous witness has testified falsely, and has stood against his brother,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-19-v19-19]
Deuteronomy 19:19
then you shall do unto him as he wickedly purposed to do unto his brother; and you shall remove the evil one from among yourselves.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-19-v19-20]
Deuteronomy 19:20
And those who remain shall hear and fear, and shall no more do such an evil thing among you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-19-v19-21]
Deuteronomy 19:21
Your eye shall not spare him: life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.
[/UNIT]

--- Deuteronomy 20 ---

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-20-v20-1]
Deuteronomy 20:1
And when you go forth unto war against your enemies, and see horse and rider and a people more numerous than you, you shall not fear them; for the Lord your God is with you, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-20-v20-2]
Deuteronomy 20:2
And it shall be, when you draw near unto battle, that the priest shall draw near and speak unto the people,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-20-v20-3]
Deuteronomy 20:3
and shall say unto them: Hear, O Israel; you draw near this day unto battle against your enemies. Let not your heart faint; fear not, neither be broken, nor turn aside from before them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-20-v20-4]
Deuteronomy 20:4
For the Lord your God goes before you and with you, to fight with you against your enemies, to save you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-20-v20-5]
Deuteronomy 20:5
And the scribes shall speak unto the people, saying: What man has built a new house, and has not dedicated it? Let him go and return unto his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man dedicate it.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-20-v20-6]
Deuteronomy 20:6
And what man has planted a vineyard, and has not enjoyed its fruit? Let him go and return unto his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man enjoy its fruit.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-20-v20-7]
Deuteronomy 20:7
And what man has betrothed a wife, and has not taken her? Let him go and return unto his house, lest he die in the battle, and another man take her.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-20-v20-8]
Deuteronomy 20:8
And the scribes shall speak further unto the people, and say: What man is fearful and faint of heart? Let him go and return unto his house, lest he make the heart of his brother faint, as his own.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-20-v20-9]
Deuteronomy 20:9
And it shall be, when the scribes have finished speaking unto the people, that they shall appoint captains of the host to lead the people.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-20-v20-10]
Deuteronomy 20:10
And when you draw near unto a city to fight against it, you shall call its people forth with an offer of peace.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-20-v20-11]
Deuteronomy 20:11
And if they answer you peaceably, and open unto you, then all the people found therein shall pay you tribute, and be subject unto you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-20-v20-12]
Deuteronomy 20:12
But if they will not hearken unto you, and make war against you, you shall besiege it.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-20-v20-13]
Deuteronomy 20:13
And the Lord your God shall deliver it into your hands, and you shall slay every male therein with the sword,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-20-v20-14]
Deuteronomy 20:14
save the women and the dependent households. And you shall take as spoil unto yourself all the cattle, and all that is in the city, and all its goods; and you shall eat all the spoil of your enemies which the Lord your God gives you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-20-v20-15]
Deuteronomy 20:15
Thus you shall do unto all the cities which are very far from you, which are not of the cities of these nations.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-20-v20-16]
Deuteronomy 20:16
But behold, of the cities of these nations, whose land the Lord your God gives you to inherit, you shall save alive nothing that breathes.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-20-v20-17]
Deuteronomy 20:17
But you shall utterly devote them to destruction, the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, and the Girgashites, as the Lord your God commanded you,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-20-v20-18]
Deuteronomy 20:18
lest they teach you to do all their abominations which they did unto their gods, and you sin before the Lord your God.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-20-v20-19]
Deuteronomy 20:19
And if you besiege a city many days, to fight against it and take it, you shall not destroy its trees by laying iron against them; for you may eat of them, and shall not cut them down. Is the tree of the field a man, that it should enter the siege before you?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-20-v20-20]
Deuteronomy 20:20
But the tree which you know bears no fruit for food, you may destroy and cut down, and build siegeworks against the city which makes war with you, until it is delivered up.
[/UNIT]

--- Deuteronomy 21 ---

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-21-v21-1]
Deuteronomy 21:1
And if one is found slain in the land which the Lord your God gives you to inherit, lying in the field, and it is not known who smote him,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-21-v21-2]
Deuteronomy 21:2
your elders and your judges shall go forth, and measure unto the cities round about the slain man.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-21-v21-3]
Deuteronomy 21:3
And it shall be, that the elders of the city nearest unto the slain man shall take a heifer of the herd, which has not been worked, and which has not drawn in the yoke.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-21-v21-4]
Deuteronomy 21:4
And the elders of that city shall bring down the heifer unto a rough ravine, which has not been tilled nor sown, and shall cut the sinews of the heifer in the ravine.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-21-v21-5]
Deuteronomy 21:5
And the Levitical priests shall draw near, for the Lord your God has chosen them to stand before Him, and to bless in His name; and by their mouth shall every dispute and every injury be decided.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-21-v21-6]
Deuteronomy 21:6
And all the elders of that city nearest unto the slain man shall wash their hands over the head of the heifer whose sinews were cut in the ravine,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-21-v21-7]
Deuteronomy 21:7
and shall answer and say: Our hands have not shed this blood, neither have our eyes seen it.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-21-v21-8]
Deuteronomy 21:8
Be merciful unto Thy people Israel, whom Thou hast redeemed, O Lord, out of the land of Egypt, that there be no guilt of innocent blood among Thy people Israel. And atonement shall be made for the blood on their behalf.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-21-v21-9]
Deuteronomy 21:9
And you shall remove the guilt of innocent blood from among yourselves, if you do that which is good and pleasing before the Lord your God.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-21-v21-10]
Deuteronomy 21:10
And when you go forth unto war against your enemies, and the Lord your God delivers them into your hands, and you take their spoil,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-21-v21-11]
Deuteronomy 21:11

[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-21-v21-12]
Deuteronomy 21:12

[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-21-v21-13]
Deuteronomy 21:13
And you shall take from her the garments of her captivity; and she shall dwell in your house, and mourn her father and her mother a full month. And afterward you shall go in unto her, and dwell with her as husband, and she shall be your wife.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-21-v21-14]
Deuteronomy 21:14
And it shall be, if you do not desire her, that you shall send her forth free; and she shall not be sold for silver. You shall not treat her with contempt, because you have humbled her.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-21-v21-15]
Deuteronomy 21:15

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-21-v21-16]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-21-v21-17]
Deuteronomy 21:17

[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-21-v21-18]
Deuteronomy 21:18

[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-21-v21-19]
Deuteronomy 21:19

[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-21-v21-20]
Deuteronomy 21:20

[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-21-v21-21]
Deuteronomy 21:21
And the men of his city shall stone him with stones, and he shall die; and you shall remove the evil one from among yourselves, and those who remain shall hear and fear.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-21-v21-22]
Deuteronomy 21:22
And if there is in a man a sin deserving judgment of death, and he dies, and you hang him upon a tree,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-21-v21-23]

--- Deuteronomy 22 ---

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-22-v22-1]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-22-v22-2]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-22-v22-3]

So you shall do with his donkey, and so you shall do with his garment, and so you shall do with every lost thing of your brother, whatsoever he has lost and you have found; you may not disregard it.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-22-v22-4]
Deuteronomy 22:4
You shall not see your brother’s donkey or his calf fallen in the way, and disregard them; you shall surely raise them up with him.
[/UNIT]

A woman shall not have a man’s equipment upon her, neither shall a man put on a woman’s robe; for everyone who does these things is an abomination unto the Lord your God.

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-22-v22-6]
Deuteronomy 22:6
And if you come upon a bird’s nest before you in the way, in any tree or upon the ground, with young birds or eggs, and the mother sitting upon the young or upon the eggs, you shall not take the mother with the young.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-22-v22-7]
Deuteronomy 22:7
You shall surely let the mother go, but the young you may take unto yourself, that it may be well with you, and that your days may be long.

[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-22-v22-9]

You shall not sow your vineyard with a different crop, lest the produce and the seed which you sow, together with the produce of your vineyard, become consecrated.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-22-v22-10]
Deuteronomy 22:10
You shall not plough with a calf and a donkey together.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-22-v22-11]
Deuteronomy 22:11
You shall not wear a mingled fabric, wool and linen together.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-22-v22-12]
Deuteronomy 22:12
You shall make twisted tassels upon the four edges of your outer garments wherewith you cover yourself.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-22-v22-13]
Deuteronomy 22:13
And if a man takes a wife, and dwells with her as husband, and hates her,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-22-v22-14]
Deuteronomy 22:14

[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-22-v22-15]
Deuteronomy 22:15
then the father of the young woman and her mother shall take and bring forth the tokens of her virginity unto the elders at the gate.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-22-v22-16]
Deuteronomy 22:16
And the father of the young woman shall say unto the elders: I gave this my daughter unto this man for a wife, and he has hated her;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-22-v22-17]
Deuteronomy 22:17
and behold, he brings charges against her as a pretext, saying: I did not find the tokens of your daughter’s virginity. Yet these are the tokens of my daughter’s virginity. And they shall spread the garment before the elders of the city.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-22-v22-18]
Deuteronomy 22:18
And the elders of that city shall take that man and chasten him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-22-v22-19]
Deuteronomy 22:19
And they shall fine him a hundred shekels, and give them unto the father of the young woman, because he has brought an evil name upon a virgin of Israel; and she shall be his wife, and he may not put her away all his days.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-22-v22-20]
Deuteronomy 22:20
But if this matter is true, and the tokens of the young woman’s virginity are not found,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-22-v22-21]
Deuteronomy 22:21
then they shall bring forth the young woman unto the doors of her father’s house, and the men of her city shall stone her with stones, and she shall die; for she has wrought folly among the sons of Israel, bringing harlotry into her father’s house. And you shall remove the evil one from among yourselves.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-22-v22-22]
Deuteronomy 22:22
And if a man is found lying with a woman married unto a husband, you shall put both of them to death, the man who lay with the woman, and the woman; and you shall remove the evil one from Israel.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-22-v22-23]
Deuteronomy 22:23
And if a young woman, a virgin, is betrothed unto a man, and a man finds her in the city and lies with her,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-22-v22-24]
Deuteronomy 22:24
you shall bring both of them forth unto the gate of their city, and they shall be stoned with stones and shall die: the young woman, because she did not cry out in the city, and the man, because he violated his neighbour’s wife. And you shall remove the evil one from among yourselves.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-22-v22-25]
Deuteronomy 22:25
But if a man finds the betrothed young woman in the field, and forces her and lies with her, you shall put to death only the man who lay with her.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-22-v22-26]
Deuteronomy 22:26
And unto the young woman you shall do nothing; there is in her no sin deserving death. For as when a man rises against his neighbour and slays him, so is this matter.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-22-v22-27]
Deuteronomy 22:27
For he found her in the field; the betrothed young woman cried out, and there was none to help her.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-22-v22-28]
Deuteronomy 22:28
And if a man finds a young woman, a virgin who is not betrothed, and forces her and lies with her, and he is found out,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-22-v22-29]
Deuteronomy 22:29
the man who lay with her shall give unto the father of the young woman fifty silver didrachmas, and she shall be his wife, because he violated her; he may not put her away all his days.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-23-v23-1]

[/UNIT]

The sons born unto them shall enter the assembly of the Lord in the third generation.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-23-v23-10]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-23-v23-11]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-23-v23-12]
Deuteronomy 23:12
And it shall be, toward evening, that he shall wash his body with water; and when the sun is set, he shall enter the camp.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-23-v23-13]
Deuteronomy 23:13
And you shall have a place outside the camp, whither you shall go forth.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-23-v23-14]
Deuteronomy 23:14

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-23-v23-15]
Deuteronomy 23:15
For the Lord your God walks in the midst of your camp, to deliver you, and to give your enemy before you; therefore your camp shall be holy, that no indecent thing be seen among you, and He turn away from you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-23-v23-16]

You shall not deliver unto his master a slave who has come unto you from his master.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-23-v23-17]
Deuteronomy 23:17
He shall dwell with you; he shall dwell among you in any place that pleases him. You shall not afflict him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-23-v23-18]
Deuteronomy 23:18
There shall be no prostitute among the daughters of Israel, neither shall there be one who practises prostitution among the sons of Israel. There shall be no woman who performs initiation rites among the daughters of Israel, neither shall there be an initiated man among the sons of Israel.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-23-v23-19]
Deuteronomy 23:19
You shall not bring the hire of a prostitute, nor the price of a dog, into the house of the Lord your God for any vow; for both are an abomination unto the Lord your God.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-23-v23-20]
Deuteronomy 23:20
You shall not charge your brother interest on silver, nor interest on food, nor interest on anything which you lend.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-23-v23-21]
Deuteronomy 23:21
Unto a foreigner you may lend at interest, but unto your brother you shall not lend at interest; that the Lord your God may bless you in all your works upon the land whither you go to inherit it.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-23-v23-22]
Deuteronomy 23:22
And if you vow a vow unto the Lord your God, you shall not delay to pay it; for the Lord your God shall surely require it of you, and there shall be sin upon you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-23-v23-23]
Deuteronomy 23:23
But if you do not desire to vow, there is no sin upon you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-23-v23-24]
Deuteronomy 23:24
That which proceeds through your lips you shall keep and do, as you have vowed a gift unto the Lord your God, which you have spoken with your mouth.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-23-v23-25]
Deuteronomy 23:25
And if you enter your neighbour’s harvest, you may gather heads of grain with your hands; but you shall not put a sickle unto your neighbour’s harvest.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-23-v23-26]
Deuteronomy 23:26
And if you enter your neighbour’s vineyard, you may eat grapes until your soul is filled; but you shall put none in a vessel.
[/UNIT]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-24-v24-20]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-24-v24-21]

And you shall remember that you were a household slave in the land of Egypt; therefore I command you to do this thing.

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-29-v29-18]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-29-v29-19]

[UNIT deuteronomy-section-29-v29-23]
Deuteronomy 29:23

[UNIT joshua-section-23-v23-12]
Joshua 23:12
For if you turn back and cling to these nations that remain with you, and intermarry with them, and mingle with them and they with you,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT joshua-section-23-v23-13]
Joshua 23:13
know that the Lord shall surely no longer destroy these nations before you. They shall be traps and stumbling blocks to you, and nails in your heels and darts in your eyes, until you perish from this good land which the Lord your God has given you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT joshua-section-23-v23-14]
Joshua 23:14
I am departing on the way of all who are upon the earth. You shall know in your heart and soul that not one word has failed of all the words which the Lord your God spoke concerning all that belongs to you; not one has proved untrue.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT joshua-section-23-v23-15]
Joshua 23:15
As all the good words which the Lord spoke to you have come upon you, so the Lord God shall bring upon you all the harmful words, until He destroys you from this good land which the Lord gave you,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT joshua-section-23-v23-16]
Joshua 23:16
when you transgress the covenant of the Lord your God which He commanded you, and go and serve other gods and bow down to them.”
[/UNIT]

--- Joshua 24 ---

[UNIT joshua-section-24-v24-1]
Joshua 24:1
Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shiloh. He summoned their elders, scribes, and judges and made them stand before God.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT joshua-section-24-v24-2]
Joshua 24:2
Joshua said to all the people, “Thus says the Lord, the God of Israel: ‘From the beginning your fathers lived beyond the River—Terah, the father of Abraham and the father of Nahor—and they served other gods.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT joshua-section-24-v24-3]
Joshua 24:3
I took your father Abraham from beyond the River, led him through all the land, multiplied his offspring, and gave him Isaac,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT joshua-section-24-v24-4]
Joshua 24:4
and to Isaac, Jacob and Esau. I gave Mount Seir to Esau as his inheritance, and Jacob and his sons went down to Egypt and there became a great, numerous, and mighty nation.’
[/UNIT]

[UNIT joshua-section-24-v24-5]
Joshua 24:5
The Egyptians afflicted them, and the Lord struck Egypt by what He did to them; afterward He brought you
[/UNIT]

[UNIT joshua-section-24-v24-6]
Joshua 24:6
out of Egypt, and you entered the Red Sea. And the Egyptians pursued your fathers with chariots and horses into the Red Sea,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT joshua-section-24-v24-7]
Joshua 24:7
and we cried to the Lord. And He set a cloud and thick darkness between us and the Egyptians, and brought the sea upon them and covered them. And your eyes saw all that the Lord did in the land of Egypt. And you were in the wilderness many days.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT joshua-section-24-v24-8]
Joshua 24:8
And He brought you into the land of the Amorites dwelling beyond the Jordan. And they arrayed themselves against you, and the Lord delivered them into your hands. And you inherited their land and destroyed them before you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT joshua-section-24-v24-9]
Joshua 24:9
Balak son of Zippor, king of Moab, arose and arrayed himself against Israel. He sent and called Balaam to curse you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT joshua-section-24-v24-10]
Joshua 24:10
But the Lord your God was unwilling to destroy you. He blessed you abundantly, rescued you from their hands, and handed them over.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT joshua-section-24-v24-11]
Joshua 24:11
And you crossed the Jordan and came to Jericho. And the inhabitants of Jericho fought against you, the Amorites, Canaanites, Perizzites, Hivites, Jebusites, Hittites, and Girgashites; and the Lord delivered them into your hands.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT joshua-section-24-v24-12]
Joshua 24:12
He sent the swarm of wasps before you, and it drove them out from before you, twelve kings of the Amorites, not by your sword or by your bow.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT joshua-section-24-v24-13]
Joshua 24:13
He gave you a land for which you did not labour, and cities which you did not build, and you were settled in them. You shall eat of vineyards and olive groves which you did not plant.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT joshua-section-24-v24-14]
Joshua 24:14
Now fear the Lord and serve Him with uprightness and righteousness. Remove the foreign gods your fathers served beyond the River and in Egypt, and serve the Lord.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT joshua-section-24-v24-15]
Joshua 24:15
But if it does not please you to serve the Lord, choose for yourselves today whom you will serve: the gods of your fathers beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites in whose land you dwell. But I and my house will serve the Lord, for He is holy.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT joshua-section-24-v24-16]
Joshua 24:16
The people answered and said, “May it never be that we abandon the Lord to serve other gods.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT joshua-section-24-v24-17]
Joshua 24:17
The Lord our God—He is God. He brought us and our fathers up from Egypt and guarded us on all the way we travelled and among all the nations through whom we passed.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT joshua-section-24-v24-18]
Joshua 24:18
The Lord drove out before us the Amorites and all the nations living in the land. We too will serve the Lord, for He is our God.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT joshua-section-24-v24-19]
Joshua 24:19
Joshua said to the people, “You cannot serve the Lord, for He is a holy God; and being jealous, He will not forgive your sins and your lawless deeds.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT joshua-section-24-v24-20]
Joshua 24:20
Whenever you forsake the Lord and serve other gods, He shall come upon you and afflict you and consume you in return for the good He has done you.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT joshua-section-24-v24-21]
Joshua 24:21
The people said to Joshua, “No! We will serve the Lord.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT joshua-section-24-v24-22]
Joshua 24:22
And Joshua said to the people, “You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen the Lord to serve Him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT joshua-section-24-v24-23]
Joshua 24:23
Now remove the foreign gods among you and direct your heart to the Lord, the God of Israel.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT joshua-section-24-v24-24]
Joshua 24:24
The people said to Joshua, “The Lord we will serve, and His voice we will obey.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT joshua-section-24-v24-25]
Joshua 24:25
Joshua made a covenant with the people on that day and gave them law and judgment at Shiloh before the tent of the God of Israel.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT joshua-section-24-v24-26]
Joshua 24:26
He wrote these words in a scroll, the law of God. Joshua took a great stone and set it beneath the terebinth before the Lord.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT joshua-section-24-v24-27]
Joshua 24:27
Joshua said to the people, “Behold, this stone shall be among you as a testimony, for it has heard all that was spoken to it by the Lord, what He spoke to us today. It shall be among you as a testimony at the last of the days, whenever you deal falsely with the Lord my God.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT joshua-section-24-v24-28]
Joshua 24:28
Joshua sent the people away, and each went to his own place.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT joshua-section-24-v24-29]
Joshua 24:29
Israel served the Lord all the days of Joshua and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua and saw all the works the Lord had done for Israel.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT joshua-section-24-v24-30]
Joshua 24:30
After those things Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the Lord, died at the age of one hundred ten years.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT joshua-section-24-v24-31]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT joshua-section-24-v24-31a]
Joshua 24:31a
There they placed with him in the tomb in which they buried him the stone knives with which he circumcised the sons of Israel at Gilgal, when he brought them out of Egypt, as the Lord commanded them. They are there to this very day.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT joshua-section-24-v24-32]
Joshua 24:32
The sons of Israel brought Joseph’s bones up from Egypt and buried them at Shechem in the portion of the field that Jacob acquired from the Amorites living at Shechem for one hundred ewe lambs; he gave it to Joseph as a portion.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT joshua-section-24-v24-33]
Joshua 24:33
After these things Eleazar son of Aaron, the high priest, died and was buried at Gabaath of Phinehas his son, which he had given him in the mountain of Ephraim.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT joshua-section-24-v24-33a]
Joshua 24:33a
On that day the sons of Israel took the ark of God and carried it about among themselves. Phinehas served as priest in place of Eleazar his father until he died and was buried at his own Gabaath.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT joshua-section-24-v24-33b]

The sons of Israel went away, each to his own place and his own city. The sons of Israel revered Astarte and Ashtaroth and the gods of the nations around them. The Lord handed them into the hands of Eglom king of Moab, and he ruled over them for eighteen years.
[/UNIT]

=== Judges ===

--- Judges 1 ---

[UNIT judges-section-1-v1-1]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-1-v1-2]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-1-v1-3]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-1-v1-4]

[/UNIT]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-1-v1-7]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-1-v1-8]

The sons of Judah fought against Jerusalem and captured it. They struck it with the edge of the sword and burned the city with fire.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-1-v1-11]

[UNIT judges-section-1-v1-14]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-1-v1-15]
Judges 1:15
And Achsah said to him, “Give me a blessing; for you have given me away into a southern land. Give me a redemption of water.” And Caleb gave her, according to her heart, the redemption of the heights and the redemption of the low places.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-1-v1-16]
Judges 1:16
The descendants of Jobab the Kenite, Moses’ father-in-law, went up from the City of Palms to the sons of Judah, into the wilderness in the south, on the descent to Arad. He went and dwelt with the people.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-1-v1-17]
Judges 1:17
Judah went with Simeon his brother. They struck the Canaanites dwelling in Sepheth, placed it under the ban, and destroyed it. They called the city’s name Destruction.

[UNIT judges-section-1-v1-18]

[UNIT judges-section-1-v1-23]

[UNIT judges-section-1-v1-24]

The Canaanites began to dwell in this land.

[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-1-v1-30]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-1-v1-31]

[UNIT judges-section-1-v1-32]

Asher dwelt among the Canaanites inhabiting the land, because he was unable to remove them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-1-v1-33]

Naphtali did not remove the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh or the inhabitants of Beth-anath. Israel dwelt among the Canaanites inhabiting the land, but the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh and Beth-anath became subject to their tribute.

[UNIT judges-section-1-v1-34]

The Amorites pressed the sons of Dan into the mountain, for they did not allow them to come down into the valley.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-1-v1-35]
Judges 1:35
The Amorites began to dwell on the Mountain of the Myrtle Grove, where the bears and the foxes are. The hand of the house of Joseph became heavy upon the Amorites, and they became subject to tribute.

[UNIT judges-section-1-v1-36]
Judges 1:36

--- Judges 2 ---

[UNIT judges-section-2-v2-1]
Judges 2:1
The messenger of the Lord went up from Gilgal to the Place of Weeping, to Bethel, and to the house of Israel. He said to them, “The Lord, the Lord brought you up from Egypt and brought you into the land that He swore to your fathers to give you. He said to you, ‘I will never scatter My covenant with you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-2-v2-2]
Judges 2:2
You shall make no covenant with those dwelling in this land, nor shall you bow down to their gods; but you shall shatter their graven images and pull down their altars.’ Yet you did not obey My voice when you did these things.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-2-v2-3]
Judges 2:3
And I said, ‘I will no longer remove the people whom I said I would destroy before you. They shall become constraints upon you, and their gods shall become a stumbling block to you.’”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-2-v2-4]
Judges 2:4
When the messenger of the Lord spoke these words to all Israel, the people raised their voice and wept.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-2-v2-5]
Judges 2:5
For this reason that place was called the Place of Weeping, and there they sacrificed to the Lord.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-2-v2-6]
Judges 2:6
Joshua sent the people away, and the sons of Israel went, each to his house and his inheritance, to inherit the land.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-2-v2-7]
Judges 2:7
The people served the Lord all the days of Joshua and all the days of the elders who outlived Joshua, who knew all the great work the Lord had done for Israel.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-2-v2-8]
Judges 2:8
Joshua son of Nun, the servant of the Lord, died at the age of one hundred ten years.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-2-v2-9]
Judges 2:9
They buried him within the territory of his inheritance at Timnath-heres, in the mountain of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-2-v2-10]
Judges 2:10
That whole generation too was added to its fathers. Another generation arose after them, who did not know the Lord or the work He had done for Israel.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-2-v2-11]
Judges 2:11
The sons of Israel did evil before the Lord and served the Baalim.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-2-v2-12]
Judges 2:12
They forsook the Lord, the God of their fathers, who had brought them out of the land of Egypt. They followed other gods from among the gods of the peoples around them, bowed down to them, and provoked the Lord.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-2-v2-13]
Judges 2:13
They forsook the Lord and served Baal and the Astartes.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-2-v2-14]
Judges 2:14
The Lord was greatly angered against Israel. He delivered them into the hand of plunderers, who plundered them; and He sold them into the hand of their enemies all around, so they could not stand before their enemies.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-2-v2-15]
Judges 2:15
In everything in which they prostituted themselves, the Lord’s hand was against them for harm, as the Lord had spoken and as the Lord had sworn. He greatly afflicted them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-2-v2-16]
Judges 2:16
The Lord raised up judges for them and saved them from the hand of their plunderers.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-2-v2-17]
Judges 2:17
Yet they did not listen even to their judges, for they prostituted themselves after other gods, bowed down to them, and provoked the Lord. They quickly turned aside from the way their fathers had walked in obeying the Lord’s commandments. They did not do as their fathers had done.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-2-v2-18]
Judges 2:18
Whenever the Lord raised up judges for them, the Lord was with the judge and saved them from the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge. For the Lord was moved by their groaning before those who besieged and harmed them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-2-v2-19]
Judges 2:19
When the judge died, they turned back and again acted more corruptly than their fathers, following other gods to serve them and bow down to them. They did not cast away their practices or depart from their hard way.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-2-v2-20]
Judges 2:20
And the Lord was greatly angered against Israel, and said, “Because this nation has forsaken My covenant which I commanded their fathers, and has not obeyed My voice,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-2-v2-21]
Judges 2:21
I too will no longer remove before them anyone from the nations that Joshua left and let remain.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-2-v2-22]
Judges 2:22
This was to test Israel through them: would they keep the way of the Lord and walk in it as their fathers had kept it, or not?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-2-v2-23]
Judges 2:23
The Lord left these nations, not removing them quickly, and did not give them into Joshua’s hand.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-3-v3-7]

[UNIT judges-section-3-v3-9]

[UNIT judges-section-3-v3-10]

[UNIT judges-section-3-v3-12]

[UNIT judges-section-3-v3-13]

[UNIT judges-section-3-v3-14]

The sons of Israel served Eglon king of Moab for eighteen years.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-3-v3-15]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-3-v3-16]
Judges 3:16
Ehud made himself a double-edged dagger, a span long, and strapped it beneath his cloak upon his right thigh.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-3-v3-17]
Judges 3:17
He presented the gifts to Eglon king of Moab. Eglon was a very handsome man.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-3-v3-18]
Judges 3:18
When Ehud finished presenting the gifts, he sent away those who had carried them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-3-v3-19]
Judges 3:19
Eglon returned from the graven images near Gilgal. And Ehud said, “I have a secret word for you, O king.” And Eglon said to all, “Depart!” And all his attendants went out from him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-3-v3-20]
Judges 3:20
Ehud went in to him as he sat all alone in his summer upper room, and said, “I have a word from God for you, O king.” And Eglon rose from his throne near him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-3-v3-21]
Judges 3:21
As he rose, Ehud stretched out his left hand, took the dagger from his right thigh, and drove it into Eglon’s belly,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-3-v3-22]
Judges 3:22
and drove even the handle in after the blade, and the fat closed over the blade, because he did not pull the dagger out of his belly.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-3-v3-23]
Judges 3:23
Ehud went out into the vestibule, closed the upper-room doors upon him, and fastened them,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-3-v3-24]
Judges 3:24
and he went out. The king’s attendants entered, saw that the upper-room doors were closed, and said, “Perhaps he is sitting on the privy in the bedroom’s retreat?”
[/UNIT]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-14-v14-17]

[UNIT judges-section-16-v16-14]

And she said to him, “The foreigners are upon you, Samson!” And he awoke from his sleep, and tore the pegs with the woven fabric from the wall, and the warp; and his strength was not known.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-16-v16-15]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-16-v16-16]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-16-v16-18]
Judges 16:18

[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-16-v16-19]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-16-v16-20]
Judges 16:20
Delilah said to him, “The foreigners are upon you, Samson!” He awoke from his sleep and said, “I will go out as at other times and shake myself free.” But he did not know that the Lord had departed from him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-16-v16-21]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-16-v16-22]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-16-v16-23]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-16-v16-24]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-16-v16-25]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-16-v16-26]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-16-v16-27]

The house was full of men and women, and all the foreigners’ satraps were there. On the roof were about three thousand men and women watching Samson being mocked.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-16-v16-28]
Judges 16:28

[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-16-v16-29]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-16-v16-30]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-16-v16-31]

--- Judges 17 ---

[UNIT judges-section-17-v17-1]

[UNIT judges-section-17-v17-2]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-17-v17-3]
Judges 17:3

[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-17-v17-4]

He returned the silver to his mother. His mother took two hundred pieces of silver and gave it to the caster, who made it into a carved image and a cast image. It was in Micah’s house.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-17-v17-5]
Judges 17:5
The man Micah had a house of God. He made an ephod and teraphim, filled the hand of one of his sons, and the son became his priest.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-17-v17-6]

In those days there was no king in Israel. Each did what was good in his own eyes.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT judges-section-17-v17-7]
