=== Ecclesiastes ===

--- Ecclesiastes 1 ---

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-1-v1-1]
Ecclesiastes 1:1
The words of Ecclesiastes, son of David, king of Israel in Jerusalem.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-1-v1-2]
Ecclesiastes 1:2
Futility of futilities, said Ecclesiastes; futility of futilities, everything is futility.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-1-v1-3]
Ecclesiastes 1:3
What surplus has a person in all his toil at which he toils beneath the sun?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-1-v1-4]
Ecclesiastes 1:4
A generation goes, and a generation comes, but the earth stands for ever.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-1-v1-5]
Ecclesiastes 1:5
The sun rises, and the sun sets, and draws toward its place.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-1-v1-6]
Ecclesiastes 1:6
Rising there, it goes toward the south and circles toward the north. Round and round the wind goes, and on its circuits the wind returns.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-1-v1-7]
Ecclesiastes 1:7
All the streams go to the sea, yet the sea will not be filled. To the place where the streams go, there they return to go again.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-1-v1-8]
Ecclesiastes 1:8
All words are wearisome; a man will not be able to speak. The eye will not be filled with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-1-v1-9]
Ecclesiastes 1:9
What has come to be is what will come to be, and what has been done is what will be done; there is nothing fresh beneath the sun.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-1-v1-10]
Ecclesiastes 1:10
If anyone speaks and says, “Behold, this is new,” it has already come to be in the ages that were before us.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-1-v1-11]
Ecclesiastes 1:11
There is no remembrance of the first ones, nor will the last ones who have come to be have remembrance among those who will come at the end.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-1-v1-12]
Ecclesiastes 1:12
I, Ecclesiastes, became king over Israel in Jerusalem.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-1-v1-13]
Ecclesiastes 1:13
I set my heart to seek out and examine by wisdom everything that happens beneath heaven, for God gave human beings a grievous distraction to be distracted by.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-1-v1-14]
Ecclesiastes 1:14
I saw all the works done beneath the sun, and behold, everything is futility and resolve of spirit.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-1-v1-15]
Ecclesiastes 1:15
What is twisted cannot be put in order, and what is lacking cannot be counted.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-1-v1-16]
Ecclesiastes 1:16
I spoke in my heart, saying: Behold, I became great and added wisdom beyond everyone who was in Jerusalem before me, and my heart saw much—wisdom and knowledge.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-1-v1-17]
Ecclesiastes 1:17
I set my heart to know wisdom and knowledge; I came to know comparisons and understanding, for this too is resolve of spirit.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-1-v1-18]
Ecclesiastes 1:18
For in much wisdom is much knowledge, and whoever increases knowledge will increase pain.
[/UNIT]

--- Ecclesiastes 2 ---

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-2-v2-1]
Ecclesiastes 2:1
I said in my heart: Come now, I will test you with gladness; experience good. But behold, this too was futility.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-2-v2-2]
Ecclesiastes 2:2
Of laughter I said, “Delirium!” And to gladness, “What are you doing?”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-2-v2-3]
Ecclesiastes 2:3
I examined in my heart how to draw my flesh toward wine—while my heart guided me with wisdom—and how to take hold of folly, until I might see what good human beings should do beneath the sun during the numbered days of their lives.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-2-v2-4]
Ecclesiastes 2:4
I enlarged my work; I built houses for myself and planted vineyards for myself,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-2-v2-5]
Ecclesiastes 2:5
I made gardens and parks for myself and planted in them every kind of fruit tree.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-2-v2-6]
Ecclesiastes 2:6
I made pools of water for myself to irrigate from them a woodland sprouting trees.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-2-v2-7]
Ecclesiastes 2:7
I acquired male and female slaves, and I had slaves born in my house. I also had a great possession of herds and flocks, beyond everyone who was before me in Jerusalem.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-2-v2-8]
Ecclesiastes 2:8
I also gathered silver and gold for myself, and the riches of kings and regions. I provided male and female singers for myself, and human delights—a male cupbearer and female cupbearers.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-2-v2-9]
Ecclesiastes 2:9
I grew great and surpassed everyone who was before me in Jerusalem; my wisdom also remained with me.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-2-v2-10]
Ecclesiastes 2:10
Whatever my eyes asked for, I did not withhold from them. I did not keep my heart from any gladness, for my heart rejoiced in all my toil, and this was my portion from all my toil.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-2-v2-11]
Ecclesiastes 2:11
Then I looked upon all my works that my hands had done and the toil with which I had labored to do them, and behold, everything was futility and resolve of spirit, with no surplus beneath the sun.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-2-v2-12]
Ecclesiastes 2:12
Then I looked to consider wisdom, delirium and folly. For who is the person who will come after the counsel—all the things with which he made it?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-2-v2-13]
Ecclesiastes 2:13
I saw that wisdom has an advantage over folly, like the advantage light has over darkness.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-2-v2-14]
Ecclesiastes 2:14
The wise person’s eyes are in his head, but the fool walks in darkness. Yet I too knew that one event will happen to them all.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-2-v2-15]
Ecclesiastes 2:15
I said in my heart: The fool’s fate will happen to me too. Why have I been wise? Then I spoke excessively in my heart, because a fool speaks from excess, for this too is futility.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-2-v2-16]
Ecclesiastes 2:16
For there is no enduring remembrance of the wise person along with the fool; in the coming days everything will already be forgotten. How will the wise person die along with the fool?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-2-v2-17]
Ecclesiastes 2:17
I hated life, because the work done beneath the sun was grievous to me, for everything is futility and resolve of spirit.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-2-v2-18]
Ecclesiastes 2:18
I hated all my toil with which I toil beneath the sun, because I leave it to the person who comes after me.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-2-v2-19]
Ecclesiastes 2:19
Who knows whether he will be wise or foolish? Yet he has authority over all the toil with which I labored and acted wisely beneath the sun. This too is futility.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-2-v2-20]
Ecclesiastes 2:20
I turned to bid my heart farewell concerning all the toil with which I had labored beneath the sun,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-2-v2-21]
Ecclesiastes 2:21
for a person may toil with wisdom, knowledge and courage, yet will give his portion to someone who did not toil for it. This too is futility and a great evil.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-2-v2-22]
Ecclesiastes 2:22
For what comes to a person from all his toil and the resolve of his heart with which he toils beneath the sun?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-2-v2-23]
Ecclesiastes 2:23
For all his days are pain, and his distraction is anger; even at night his heart does not sleep. This too is futility.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-2-v2-24]
Ecclesiastes 2:24
There is no good in a person. What he will eat and drink and let his soul see as good in his toil—I saw that this too is from the hand of God.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-2-v2-25]
Ecclesiastes 2:25
For who will eat, and who will abstain, apart from Him?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-2-v2-26]
Ecclesiastes 2:26
For to the person who is good before Him He gave wisdom, knowledge and gladness; but to the sinner He gave the distraction of adding and gathering, to give to the one who is good before God. This too is futility and resolve of spirit.
[/UNIT]

--- Ecclesiastes 3 ---

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-3-v3-1]
Ecclesiastes 3:1
For all things there is a time, and a season for every matter beneath heaven.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-3-v3-2]
Ecclesiastes 3:2
a time to give birth and a time to die, a time to plant and a time to uproot what is planted,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-3-v3-3]
Ecclesiastes 3:3
a time to kill and a time to heal, a time to pull down and a time to build,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-3-v3-4]
Ecclesiastes 3:4
a time to weep and a time to laugh, a time to beat the breast in mourning and a time to dance,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-3-v3-5]
Ecclesiastes 3:5
a time to throw stones and a time to gather stones, a time to embrace and a time to keep far from embracing,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-3-v3-6]
Ecclesiastes 3:6
a time to seek and a time to lose, a time to keep and a time to throw away,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-3-v3-7]
Ecclesiastes 3:7
a time to tear and a time to sew, a time to be silent and a time to speak,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-3-v3-8]
Ecclesiastes 3:8
a time to love and a time to hate, a time of war and a time of peace.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-3-v3-9]
Ecclesiastes 3:9
What surplus does the worker gain from the things for which he toils?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-3-v3-10]
Ecclesiastes 3:10
I saw the distraction God has given human beings to be distracted by.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-3-v3-11]
Ecclesiastes 3:11
He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also put the age in their hearts, so that human beings may not find out the work God has done from beginning to end.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-3-v3-12]
Ecclesiastes 3:12
I knew that there is no good for them except to rejoice and do good during one’s life.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-3-v3-13]
Ecclesiastes 3:13
Moreover, whenever a person eats and drinks and sees good in all his toil, this is God’s gift.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-3-v3-14]
Ecclesiastes 3:14
I knew that everything God has done will endure for ever. Nothing can be added to it, and nothing taken from it; God has done this so that people may fear before Him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-3-v3-15]
Ecclesiastes 3:15
What has come to be already is, and whatever is to come has already come to be; God will seek the one who is pursued.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-3-v3-16]
Ecclesiastes 3:16
Again I saw beneath the sun: in the place of judgment, the ungodly person was there; in the righteous person’s place, the ungodly person was there.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-3-v3-17]
Ecclesiastes 3:17
I said in my heart: God will judge the righteous and the ungodly, for there is a time for every matter and for every work.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-3-v3-18]
Ecclesiastes 3:18
There I said in my heart concerning human beings’ speech: God will distinguish them and show that they themselves are beasts, even to themselves.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-3-v3-19]
Ecclesiastes 3:19
For the fate of human beings and the fate of the beast is one fate for them: as one dies, so the other dies, and all have one breath. What advantage has a human being over the beast? None, for everything is futility.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-3-v3-20]
Ecclesiastes 3:20
All go to one place; all came from dust, and all return to dust.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-3-v3-21]
Ecclesiastes 3:21
Who knows whether the spirit of human beings goes upward, and whether the spirit of the beast goes down into the earth?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-3-v3-22]
Ecclesiastes 3:22
I saw that there is no good except for a person to rejoice in his works, for that is his portion. For who will bring him to see what may happen after him?
[/UNIT]

--- Ecclesiastes 4 ---

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-4-v4-1]
Ecclesiastes 4:1
Again I turned and saw all the extortions committed beneath the sun. Behold, the tears of those being extorted, with no one to comfort them! Power was in their extorters’ hands, and they had no one to comfort them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-4-v4-2]
Ecclesiastes 4:2
I praised the dead, who had already died, above the living, who are alive until now.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-4-v4-3]
Ecclesiastes 4:3
Better than these two is the one who has not yet come to be, who has not seen the evil work done beneath the sun.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-4-v4-4]
Ecclesiastes 4:4
I saw all toil and all courage in work: it is a person’s rivalry with his companion. This too is futility and resolve of spirit.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-4-v4-5]
Ecclesiastes 4:5
The fool folded his hands and ate his own flesh.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-4-v4-6]
Ecclesiastes 4:6
Better a handful of rest than two handfuls of toil and resolve of spirit.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-4-v4-7]
Ecclesiastes 4:7
Again I turned and saw futility beneath the sun.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-4-v4-8]
Ecclesiastes 4:8
There is one person with no second, with neither son nor brother. There is no end to all his toil, and his eye is not filled with wealth. For whom am I toiling and depriving my soul of goodness? This too is futility and a grievous distraction.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-4-v4-9]
Ecclesiastes 4:9
Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their toil.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-4-v4-10]
Ecclesiastes 4:10
For if they fall, one will lift his partner. But woe to the one who falls with no second person to lift him!
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-4-v4-11]
Ecclesiastes 4:11
Also, if two lie down, they have warmth; but how can one be warm alone?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-4-v4-12]
Ecclesiastes 4:12
If the one gains strength, the two will stand against him; a threefold cord is not quickly torn apart.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-4-v4-13]
Ecclesiastes 4:13
Better a poor and wise youth than an older and foolish king who no longer knows how to pay attention,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-4-v4-14]
Ecclesiastes 4:14
for he will come from the prisoners’ house to reign, though he was born poor in his kingdom.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-4-v4-15]
Ecclesiastes 4:15
I saw all the living who walk beneath the sun with the second young man who will stand in his place,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-4-v4-16]
Ecclesiastes 4:16
there was no end to all the people, all who came before them; yet those who come last will not rejoice in him. This too is futility and resolve of spirit.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-4-v4-17]
Ecclesiastes 4:17
Guard your foot when you go to God’s house, and be near to listen. Your sacrifice is better than the fools’ gift, for they do not know how to do evil.
[/UNIT]

--- Ecclesiastes 5 ---

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-5-v5-1]
Ecclesiastes 5:1
Do not be hasty with your mouth, and do not let your heart hurry to bring out a word before God, for God is in heaven and you are on earth. Therefore let your words be few.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-5-v5-2]
Ecclesiastes 5:2
For a dream comes with much distraction, and a fool’s voice with many words.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-5-v5-3]
Ecclesiastes 5:3
Whenever you vow a vow to God, do not delay paying it, for there is no delight in fools. Pay whatever you vow.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-5-v5-4]
Ecclesiastes 5:4
Better that you do not vow than that you vow and do not pay.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-5-v5-5]
Ecclesiastes 5:5
Do not let your mouth cause your flesh to sin, and do not say before God, “It was ignorance,” lest God become angry at your voice and destroy the works of your hands.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-5-v5-6]
Ecclesiastes 5:6
For with many dreams come futilities and many words; therefore fear God.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-5-v5-7]
Ecclesiastes 5:7
If you see extortion of the poor and robbery of judgment and righteousness in a region, do not be astonished at the matter, for a high official is above another to keep watch, and higher ones are above them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-5-v5-8]
Ecclesiastes 5:8
The land’s surplus is in everything—a king of a cultivated field.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-5-v5-9]
Ecclesiastes 5:9
Whoever loves silver will not be filled with silver; and who has loved a yield in their abundance? This too is futility.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-5-v5-10]
Ecclesiastes 5:10
When goodness increased, those who consumed it multiplied. What strength has its possessor except to look at it with his eyes?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-5-v5-11]
Ecclesiastes 5:11
Sweet is the slave’s sleep, whether he eats little or much; but being filled with riches does not let him sleep.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-5-v5-12]
Ecclesiastes 5:12
There is a sickness I have seen beneath the sun: wealth kept by its possessor to his harm,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-5-v5-13]
Ecclesiastes 5:13
and that wealth will be lost through a grievous distraction, and he fathered a son with nothing in his hand.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-5-v5-14]
Ecclesiastes 5:14
As he came naked from his mother’s womb, he will return to depart as he came. He will take nothing from his toil to carry in his hand.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-5-v5-15]
Ecclesiastes 5:15
This too is a grievous sickness: just as he came, so he will depart. What surplus has he from toiling for the wind?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-5-v5-16]
Ecclesiastes 5:16
All his days are in darkness and mourning, with much anger, sickness and wrath.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-5-v5-17]
Ecclesiastes 5:17
Behold, what I have seen to be good and fitting is to eat and drink and see goodness in all one’s toil beneath the sun during the numbered days of life God has given, for that is one’s portion.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-5-v5-18]
Ecclesiastes 5:18
Moreover, every person to whom God has given wealth and possessions, and whom He has empowered to eat from them, take his portion and rejoice in his toil—this is God’s gift.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-5-v5-19]
Ecclesiastes 5:19
For he will not often remember the days of his life, because God distracts him with the gladness of his heart.
[/UNIT]

--- Ecclesiastes 6 ---

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-6-v6-1]
Ecclesiastes 6:1
There is an evil I have seen beneath the sun, and it is great upon human beings:
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-6-v6-2]
Ecclesiastes 6:2
a person to whom God will give wealth, possessions and glory, so that his soul lacks nothing it desires, yet God will not empower him to eat from it, for a stranger will eat it. This is futility and a grievous sickness.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-6-v6-3]
Ecclesiastes 6:3
If a man fathers a hundred children and lives many years, however numerous the days of his years, but his soul is not filled with goodness and he has no burial, I said a stillborn child is better off than he,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-6-v6-4]
Ecclesiastes 6:4
for it came in futility and goes in darkness, and in darkness its name will be covered,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-6-v6-5]
Ecclesiastes 6:5
and though it has not seen the sun or known anything, it has more rest than he.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-6-v6-6]
Ecclesiastes 6:6
Even if he lived through courses of a thousand years but saw no goodness, do not all go to one place?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-6-v6-7]
Ecclesiastes 6:7
All a person’s toil is for his mouth, yet his appetite will not be filled.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-6-v6-8]
Ecclesiastes 6:8
For what advantage has the wise person over the fool? For the poor person knows how to walk before life.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-6-v6-9]
Ecclesiastes 6:9
Better a sight for the eyes than wandering in appetite. This too is futility and resolve of spirit.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-6-v6-10]
Ecclesiastes 6:10
Whatever has come to be has already been named, and it is known what a human being is; he will not be able to contend in judgment with one stronger than himself.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-6-v6-11]
Ecclesiastes 6:11
For many words increase futility; what advantage has a person?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-6-v6-12]
Ecclesiastes 6:12
For who knows what is good for a person in life, during the numbered days of his life of futility? He has spent them in a shadow. Who will tell a person what will be after him beneath the sun?
[/UNIT]

--- Ecclesiastes 7 ---

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-7-v7-1]
Ecclesiastes 7:1
A name is better than good oil, and the day of death than the day of one’s birth.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-7-v7-2]
Ecclesiastes 7:2
Better to go to a house of mourning than to a house of drinking, for this is the end of every human being, and the living will take it to heart.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-7-v7-3]
Ecclesiastes 7:3
Anger is better than laughter, for through a troubled face the heart will become better.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-7-v7-4]
Ecclesiastes 7:4
The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning, but the heart of fools is in the house of gladness.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-7-v7-5]
Ecclesiastes 7:5
Better to hear a wise person’s rebuke than to be someone listening to the song of fools,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-7-v7-6]
Ecclesiastes 7:6
for like the sound of thorns beneath a cauldron, so is the laughter of fools. This too is futility.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-7-v7-7]
Ecclesiastes 7:7
For extortion drives a wise person astray and destroys the heart of his vigor.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-7-v7-8]
Ecclesiastes 7:8
The end of words is better than their beginning; a patient person is better than one high in spirit.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-7-v7-9]
Ecclesiastes 7:9
Do not be hasty in your spirit to become angry, for anger will rest in the bosom of fools.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-7-v7-10]
Ecclesiastes 7:10
Do not say, “What happened that the former days were better than these?” For it was not in wisdom that you asked about this.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-7-v7-11]
Ecclesiastes 7:11
Wisdom is good with an inheritance, and an advantage to those who behold the sun.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-7-v7-12]
Ecclesiastes 7:12
For wisdom in its shade is like the shade of silver, and the advantage of the knowledge of wisdom will give life to its possessor.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-7-v7-13]
Ecclesiastes 7:13
Consider God’s works, for who can put in order the one whom God has twisted?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-7-v7-14]
Ecclesiastes 7:14
On a day of goodness, live in good; on a day of evil, consider: God has made this in accord with that concerning speech, so that human beings may find out nothing that comes after them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-7-v7-15]
Ecclesiastes 7:15
I have seen everything in my days of futility: a righteous person perishing in his righteousness, and an ungodly person remaining in his evil.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-7-v7-16]
Ecclesiastes 7:16
Do not become overly righteous, and do not be excessively wise, lest you be bewildered.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-7-v7-17]
Ecclesiastes 7:17
Do not be greatly ungodly, and do not become harsh, lest you die before your time.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-7-v7-18]
Ecclesiastes 7:18
It is good for you to hold to this and also not release your hand from that, for the one who fears God will come through them all.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-7-v7-19]
Ecclesiastes 7:19
Wisdom will help the wise person more than ten rulers who are in the city,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-7-v7-20]
Ecclesiastes 7:20
for there is no righteous person on earth who will do good and not sin.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-7-v7-21]
Ecclesiastes 7:21
Also, do not set your heart upon every word people speak, so that you may not hear your slave cursing you,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-7-v7-22]
Ecclesiastes 7:22
for very often he will wrong you, and many times he will hurt your heart, just as you too have cursed others.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-7-v7-23]
Ecclesiastes 7:23
All this I tested by wisdom. I said, “I will be wise,”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-7-v7-24]
Ecclesiastes 7:24
but it moved far away from me, farther than it was; and depth is deep—who can find it?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-7-v7-25]
Ecclesiastes 7:25
I turned, I and my heart, to know, examine and seek wisdom and a reckoning, and to know an ungodly person’s folly, harshness and delirium.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-7-v7-26]
Ecclesiastes 7:26
I find more bitter than death the woman who is traps, whose heart is nets and whose hands are bonds. The one who is good before God will be rescued from her, but the sinner will be caught by her.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-7-v7-27]
Ecclesiastes 7:27
Behold, this I found, said Ecclesiastes, one thing alongside another, to find a reckoning,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-7-v7-28]
Ecclesiastes 7:28
which my soul still sought but I did not find. One man among a thousand I found, but a woman among all these I did not find.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-7-v7-29]
Ecclesiastes 7:29
Only behold, this I found: God made humankind upright, but they sought many reasonings.
[/UNIT]

--- Ecclesiastes 8 ---

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-8-v8-1]
Ecclesiastes 8:1
Who knows wise people, and who knows the solution of a saying? A person’s wisdom will light up his face, but one with a shameless face will be hated.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-8-v8-2]
Ecclesiastes 8:2
Guard the king’s mouth; and concerning the word of an oath of God, do not hurry.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-8-v8-3]
Ecclesiastes 8:3
You will go from his presence. Do not stand in an evil matter, for he will do whatever he pleases,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-8-v8-4]
Ecclesiastes 8:4
just as a king with authority speaks; and who will say to him, “What will you do?”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-8-v8-5]
Ecclesiastes 8:5
Whoever keeps a command will know no evil word, and a wise heart knows a time of judgment.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-8-v8-6]
Ecclesiastes 8:6
For every matter has a time and judgment, because a person’s knowledge is great upon him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-8-v8-7]
Ecclesiastes 8:7
For he does not know what will be; who will tell him how it will be?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-8-v8-8]
Ecclesiastes 8:8
No human being has authority over the spirit to restrain the spirit, and there is no authority over the day of death. There is no discharge in war, and ungodliness will not rescue the one who possesses it.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-8-v8-9]
Ecclesiastes 8:9
All this I saw, and I set my heart upon every deed done under the sun, all the things in which one person had authority over another to his harm.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-8-v8-10]
Ecclesiastes 8:10
Then I saw ungodly people brought into tombs; they went from the holy place and were praised in the city because they had acted so. This too is futility.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-8-v8-11]
Ecclesiastes 8:11
Because no prompt contradiction comes from those who do evil, the heart of human beings therefore became fully assured in them to do evil.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-8-v8-12]
Ecclesiastes 8:12
The sinner has done evil from then, and there is length for him; for I know that it will be good for those who fear God, so that they may fear before Him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-8-v8-13]
Ecclesiastes 8:13
But it will not be good for the ungodly, and he will not prolong his days in a shadow, because he does not fear before God.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-8-v8-14]
Ecclesiastes 8:14
There is a futility that occurs on earth: there are righteous people to whom things happen as the deeds of the ungodly deserve, and ungodly people to whom things happen as the deeds of the righteous deserve. I said that this too is futility.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-8-v8-15]
Ecclesiastes 8:15
So I praised gladness, because a person has no good under the sun except to eat, drink and rejoice; this will accompany him in his toil through the days of his life that God gave him under the sun.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-8-v8-16]
Ecclesiastes 8:16
When I set my heart to know wisdom and to see the distraction carried on upon the earth, because neither by day nor by night does one see sleep with one’s eyes,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-8-v8-17]
Ecclesiastes 8:17
then I saw all God’s works: a person cannot find the work done under the sun. However much a person toils to seek it, he will not find it; even if the wise person says he knows, he will not be able to find it.
[/UNIT]

--- Ecclesiastes 9 ---

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-9-v9-1]
Ecclesiastes 9:1
For I set all this upon my heart, and my heart saw all this: the righteous, the wise and their works are in God’s hand. A person knows neither love nor hatred; everything lies before them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-9-v9-2]
Ecclesiastes 9:2
There is futility in everything: one event comes to the righteous and the ungodly, to the good and the bad, to the clean and the unclean, to the one who sacrifices and the one who does not sacrifice. As the good person, so the sinner; as the one who swears, so the one who fears an oath.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-9-v9-3]
Ecclesiastes 9:3
This is an evil in all that is done under the sun: one event comes to everyone. Moreover, the heart of human beings is full of evil, and delirium is in their heart during their lives; afterward they go to the dead.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-9-v9-4]
Ecclesiastes 9:4
Who shares with all the living? There is hope, for a living dog is better than a dead lion.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-9-v9-5]
Ecclesiastes 9:5
For the living will know that they will die, but the dead know nothing; they have no further reward, for their memory is forgotten.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-9-v9-6]
Ecclesiastes 9:6
Their love, their hatred and their envy have already perished; they have no further share for ever in anything done under the sun.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-9-v9-7]
Ecclesiastes 9:7
Come, eat your bread with gladness and drink your wine with a good heart, for God has already favored your deeds.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-9-v9-8]
Ecclesiastes 9:8
Let your garments be white at all times, and let oil not be lacking on your head.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-9-v9-9]
Ecclesiastes 9:9
Enjoy life with the woman whom you have loved, all the days of your futile life that have been given you under the sun, all your futile days; for this is your share in life and in your toil at which you toil under the sun.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-9-v9-10]
Ecclesiastes 9:10
Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your strength, for there is no deed, reckoning, knowledge or wisdom in Hades, where you are going.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-9-v9-11]
Ecclesiastes 9:11
Again I saw under the sun that the race is not to the swift, nor battle to the mighty, nor bread to the wise, nor wealth to those with understanding, nor favor to those with knowledge; for time and encounter will happen to them all.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-9-v9-12]
Ecclesiastes 9:12
For a person does not know his time: like fish caught in an evil net, and birds caught in a snare, so human beings are trapped at an evil time when it falls upon them suddenly.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-9-v9-13]
Ecclesiastes 9:13
This too I saw as wisdom under the sun, and it seemed great to me:
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-9-v9-14]
Ecclesiastes 9:14
There was a small city with few people in it; a great king might come against it, surround it and build great siegeworks against it,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-9-v9-15]
Ecclesiastes 9:15
and he might find in it a poor wise man, who will deliver the city by his wisdom; yet no one remembered that poor man.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-9-v9-16]
Ecclesiastes 9:16
I said, Wisdom is better than strength; yet the poor man’s wisdom is despised, and his words are not heard.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-9-v9-17]
Ecclesiastes 9:17
The words of the wise, heard quietly, are better than the shouting of rulers in follies.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-9-v9-18]
Ecclesiastes 9:18
Wisdom is better than weapons of war, but one sinner will destroy much good.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-10-v10-1]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-10-v10-2]

A wise person’s heart is toward his right, but a fool’s heart is toward his left.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-10-v10-3]

Even when the fool walks along the road, his heart will be lacking, and everything he considers is folly.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-10-v10-4]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-10-v10-5]

[/UNIT]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-10-v10-8]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-10-v10-9]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-10-v10-10]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-10-v10-11]
Ecclesiastes 10:11

[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-10-v10-12]
Ecclesiastes 10:12
The words of a wise person’s mouth are gracious, but a fool’s lips will drown him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-10-v10-13]
Ecclesiastes 10:13
The beginning of his mouth’s words is folly, and the end of his speech is evil wandering.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-10-v10-14]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-10-v10-15]
Ecclesiastes 10:15
The toil of fools will weary them, the one who did not know how to go to the city.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-10-v10-16]
Ecclesiastes 10:16

[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-10-v10-17]
Ecclesiastes 10:17
Blessed are you, land, whose king is a son of free people and whose rulers will eat at the proper time in strength and will not be ashamed!
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-10-v10-18]
Ecclesiastes 10:18
Through laziness the roof beams will sink, and through idle hands the house will leak.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-10-v10-19]

They make bread for laughter, and wine gladdens the living, and everything will listen to money.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-10-v10-20]
Ecclesiastes 10:20
Even in your conscience do not curse a king, and in the inner rooms of your bedchambers do not curse a rich person, for a bird of the heavens will carry the sound, and one with wings will report the word.
[/UNIT]

--- Ecclesiastes 11 ---

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-11-v11-1]

Send forth your bread upon the face of the water, for after many days you will find it.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-11-v11-2]
Ecclesiastes 11:2
Give a share to seven, and also to eight, for you do not know what evil will occur upon the earth.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-11-v11-3]
Ecclesiastes 11:3
If the clouds are full of rain, they pour it upon the earth; and if a tree falls to the south or to the north, in the place where the tree falls, there it will be.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-11-v11-4]
Ecclesiastes 11:4
Whoever watches the wind will not sow, and whoever looks at the clouds will not reap,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-11-v11-5]
Ecclesiastes 11:5
among which no one knows the way of the spirit. As with bones in the womb of the pregnant woman, so you will not know God’s works, all that He will make.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-11-v11-6]
Ecclesiastes 11:6
In the morning sow your seed, and toward evening do not let your hand rest, for you do not know which will proceed, this or that, or whether both together will be good.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-11-v11-7]
Ecclesiastes 11:7
Light is sweet, and it is good for the eyes to see the sun.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-11-v11-8]
Ecclesiastes 11:8
For even if a person lives many years, he will rejoice in them all and remember the days of darkness, for they will be many. All that comes is futility.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-11-v11-9]
Ecclesiastes 11:9
Rejoice, young man, in your youth, and let your heart make you glad in the days of your youth. Walk in the ways of your heart and in the sight of your eyes, and know that for all these God will bring you into judgment.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-11-v11-10]
Ecclesiastes 11:10
Remove anger from your heart and put away evil from your flesh, for youth and lack of understanding are futility.
[/UNIT]

--- Ecclesiastes 12 ---

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-12-v12-1]
Ecclesiastes 12:1
Remember the One who created you in the days of your youth, before the days of evil come and the years arrive in which you will say, “I have no desire in them”;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-12-v12-2]
Ecclesiastes 12:2
before the sun, the light, the moon and the stars grow dark, and the clouds return after the rain;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-12-v12-3]
Ecclesiastes 12:3
on the day when the keepers of the house are shaken and the men of strength are bent, when the grinding women have ceased because they have become few and the women looking through the openings grow dark;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-12-v12-4]
Ecclesiastes 12:4
when they shut doors in the marketplace as the grinding woman’s voice weakens, and one rises at the sound of a sparrow, and all the daughters of song are brought low;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT ecclesiastes-section-12-v12-5]
Ecclesiastes 12:5
when they look from a height and terrors are on the road, when the almond blossoms, the locust grows fat and the caperberry is scattered; for the human being went to his everlasting home, and mourners circled in the marketplace;
[/UNIT]

=== Lamentations ===

--- Lamentations 1 ---

[UNIT lamentations-section-1-v1-1]
Lamentations 1:1
After Israel was taken captive and Jerusalem laid waste, Jeremiah sat weeping and lamented this lament over Jerusalem, saying:
How the city once full of peoples sat alone!
She has become like a widow, she who was populous among the nations.
A ruler among the regions has become subject to tribute.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT lamentations-section-1-v1-2]
Lamentations 1:2
Weeping, she wept in the night, her tears upon her cheeks.
Among all those who love her there is no one to comfort her.
All her friends have dealt faithlessly with her; they have become her enemies.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT lamentations-section-1-v1-3]
Lamentations 1:3
Judea was deported because of her humiliation and her great slavery.
She dwelt among the nations; she found no rest.
All her pursuers overtook her among those who afflicted her.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT lamentations-section-1-v1-4]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT lamentations-section-1-v1-5]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT lamentations-section-1-v1-6]
Lamentations 1:6
All her beauty has departed from Daughter Zion.

[UNIT lamentations-section-1-v1-7]
Lamentations 1:7
Jerusalem remembered the days of her humiliation and rejection,

[/UNIT]

[UNIT lamentations-section-1-v1-8]
Lamentations 1:8
Jerusalem has sinned grievously; therefore she has come into upheaval.
All who glorified her humbled her, for they saw her shame.
She too groaned and turned backward.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT lamentations-section-1-v1-9]
Lamentations 1:9
Her uncleanness is at her feet; she did not remember her last things.

[/UNIT]

[UNIT lamentations-section-1-v1-10]
Lamentations 1:10

[/UNIT]

[UNIT lamentations-section-1-v1-11]

All her people groan, seeking bread.

[/UNIT]

[UNIT lamentations-section-1-v1-12]
Lamentations 1:12
Not to you, all who pass along the road!

[/UNIT]

[UNIT lamentations-section-1-v1-13]
Lamentations 1:13
From His height He sent fire; He brought it down into my bones.
He spread a net for my feet; He turned me backward.
He made me desolate, suffering pain all day long.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT lamentations-section-1-v1-14]
Lamentations 1:14
A watch was kept over my acts of ungodliness;
they were intertwined in my hands and rose upon my neck.
My strength weakened, because the Lord put pains into my hands; I will not be able to stand.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT lamentations-section-1-v1-15]
Lamentations 1:15
The Lord removed all my strong men from my midst.
He called a time against me to crush my chosen men.
The Lord trod a winepress for the virgin Daughter Judah; for these things I weep.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT lamentations-section-1-v1-16]
Lamentations 1:16
My eye brought down water,
for the one who comforts me, who restores my life, is far from me.
My sons have been destroyed, for the enemy has grown strong.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT lamentations-section-1-v1-17]
Lamentations 1:17
Zion spread out her hands; there is no one to comfort her.

Jerusalem has become like a woman sitting apart among them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT lamentations-section-1-v1-18]
Lamentations 1:18

[/UNIT]

[UNIT lamentations-section-1-v1-19]
Lamentations 1:19

[UNIT lamentations-section-1-v1-20]
Lamentations 1:20
See, Lord, how I am afflicted! My belly is troubled,

[/UNIT]

[UNIT lamentations-section-1-v1-21]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT lamentations-section-1-v1-22]

[UNIT lamentations-section-2-v2-10]

Daughter Zion’s elders sat on the ground in silence.

[/UNIT]

[UNIT lamentations-section-2-v2-11]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT lamentations-section-2-v2-12]
Lamentations 2:12

[/UNIT]

[UNIT lamentations-section-2-v2-13]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT lamentations-section-2-v2-14]
Lamentations 2:14

[/UNIT]

[UNIT lamentations-section-2-v2-15]
Lamentations 2:15
All who pass along the road clapped their hands at you.

[/UNIT]

[UNIT lamentations-section-2-v2-16]
Lamentations 2:16
All your enemies opened their mouths against you.

[/UNIT]

[UNIT lamentations-section-2-v2-17]
Lamentations 2:17
The Lord did what He intended; He fulfilled His words,

[/UNIT]

[UNIT lamentations-section-2-v2-18]
Lamentations 2:18

Walls of Zion, bring down tears like torrents day and night!

[/UNIT]

[UNIT lamentations-section-2-v2-19]
Lamentations 2:19
Rise, exult in the night at the beginning of your watch!
Pour out your heart like water before the Lord.
Lift your hands to Him for the lives of your infants,
who weaken with hunger at the head of every way out.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT lamentations-section-2-v2-20]
Lamentations 2:20
See, Lord, and look: whom hast Thou gleaned in this way?

[/UNIT]

[UNIT lamentations-section-2-v2-21]
Lamentations 2:21

[/UNIT]

[UNIT lamentations-section-2-v2-22]
Lamentations 2:22

The joy of our heart ended;

[/UNIT]

[UNIT lamentations-section-5-v5-16]

The crown fell from our head;

[/UNIT]

[UNIT lamentations-section-5-v5-17]

[/UNIT]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT lamentations-section-5-v5-19]

But Thou, Lord, wilt dwell for ever;

[/UNIT]

[UNIT lamentations-section-5-v5-20]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT lamentations-section-5-v5-21]

[/UNIT]

=== Wisdom of Solomon ===

--- Wisdom of Solomon — Chapter 1 ---

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-1-v1-1]
Wisdom of Solomon 1:1
Love righteousness, you who judge the earth;
think of the Lord in goodness,
and seek Him in simplicity of heart.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-1-v1-2]
Wisdom of Solomon 1:2
For He is found by those who do not put Him to the test,
and He makes Himself known to those who do not distrust Him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-1-v1-3]
Wisdom of Solomon 1:3
For crooked reasonings separate from God,
and power, when put to the test, exposes the foolish.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-1-v1-4]
Wisdom of Solomon 1:4
For wisdom will not enter a soul that devises evil,
nor will she dwell in a body indebted to sin.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-1-v1-5]
Wisdom of Solomon 1:5
For a holy spirit of discipline will flee deceit
and depart from senseless reasonings,
and will be put to shame when injustice comes upon it.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-1-v1-6]
Wisdom of Solomon 1:6
For wisdom is a spirit that loves humanity,
and she will not acquit a blasphemer of what his lips have said;
for God is a witness of his kidneys,
a true overseer of his heart,
and a hearer of his tongue.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-1-v1-7]
Wisdom of Solomon 1:7
For the Spirit of the Lord has filled the inhabited world,
and that which holds all things together has knowledge of utterance.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-1-v1-8]
Wisdom of Solomon 1:8
Therefore no one who speaks unjust things will escape notice,
nor will convicting justice pass him by.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-1-v1-9]
Wisdom of Solomon 1:9
For there will be an examination of the ungodly person’s deliberations,
and the report of his words will come to the Lord
to expose his lawless deeds.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-1-v1-10]
Wisdom of Solomon 1:10
For an ear of jealousy listens to all things,
and the murmur of grumblings is not hidden.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-1-v1-11]
Wisdom of Solomon 1:11
Therefore guard yourselves against useless grumbling,
and restrain your tongue from slander;
for a secret utterance will not pass away without effect,
and a lying mouth destroys a soul.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-1-v1-12]
Wisdom of Solomon 1:12
Do not pursue death through the wandering of your life,
nor draw destruction upon yourselves through the works of your hands;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-1-v1-13]
Wisdom of Solomon 1:13
For God did not make death,
neither does He delight in the destruction of the living.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-1-v1-14]
Wisdom of Solomon 1:14
For He created all things that they might exist,
and the created things of the world are life-preserving;
there is no poison of destruction in them,
nor is Hades’ dominion upon the earth.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-1-v1-15]
Wisdom of Solomon 1:15
For righteousness is immortal.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-1-v1-16]
Wisdom of Solomon 1:16
But the ungodly summoned him by their hands and words;
considering him a friend, they wasted away,
and they made a covenant with him,
because they are worthy to belong to his portion.
[/UNIT]

--- Wisdom of Solomon — Chapter 2 ---

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-2-v2-1]
Wisdom of Solomon 2:1
For they said among themselves, reasoning wrongly:
“Our life is short and sorrowful,
and there is no healing when a human being dies,
and no one has been known to return from Hades.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-2-v2-2]
Wisdom of Solomon 2:2
For we came into being by chance,
and afterward we will be as though we had not existed;
for the breath in our nostrils is smoke,
and reason is a spark in the movement of our heart;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-2-v2-3]
Wisdom of Solomon 2:3
when it is extinguished, the body will become ashes,
and the spirit will disperse like insubstantial air.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-2-v2-4]
Wisdom of Solomon 2:4
And our name will be forgotten in time,
and no one will remember our works;
our life will pass like the traces of a cloud,
and will disperse like mist,
driven away by the sun’s rays
and weighed down by its heat.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-2-v2-5]
Wisdom of Solomon 2:5
For our allotted time is the passing of a shadow,
and there is no turning back from our end,
because it has been sealed, and no one returns.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-2-v2-6]
Wisdom of Solomon 2:6
Come, then, and let us enjoy the good things that exist,
and eagerly make use of creation as in youth.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-2-v2-7]
Wisdom of Solomon 2:7
Let us fill ourselves with costly wine and perfumes,
and let no spring blossom pass us by.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-2-v2-8]
Wisdom of Solomon 2:8
Let us crown ourselves with rosebuds before they wither.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-2-v2-9]
Wisdom of Solomon 2:9
Let none of us be without a share in our revelry;
let us leave tokens of our enjoyment everywhere,
for this is our portion, and this our lot.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-2-v2-10]
Wisdom of Solomon 2:10
Let us oppress the poor righteous person;
let us not spare a widow,
nor show regard for an old man’s many years of gray hair.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-2-v2-11]
Wisdom of Solomon 2:11
Let our strength be the law of righteousness,
for what is weak is shown to be useless.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-2-v2-12]
Wisdom of Solomon 2:12
Let us lie in wait for the righteous person, because he is troublesome to us
and opposes our works;
he reproaches us for sins against law
and charges us with sins against our upbringing.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-2-v2-13]
Wisdom of Solomon 2:13
He professes to have knowledge of God
and calls himself a child of the Lord.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-2-v2-14]
Wisdom of Solomon 2:14
He has become a reproach to our thoughts;
even the sight of him weighs upon us,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-2-v2-15]
Wisdom of Solomon 2:15
because his life is unlike that of others,
and his paths are different.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-2-v2-16]
Wisdom of Solomon 2:16
He has reckoned us counterfeit,
and keeps away from our ways as from impurities;
he calls the final lot of the righteous blessed,
and boasts that God is his father.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-2-v2-17]
Wisdom of Solomon 2:17
Let us see whether his words are true,
and test what will happen at his departure.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-2-v2-18]
Wisdom of Solomon 2:18
For if the righteous person is a son of God, He will help him
and rescue him from the hand of his opponents.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-2-v2-19]
Wisdom of Solomon 2:19
Let us examine him with insult and torture,
so that we may know his gentleness
and test his endurance of wrong.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-2-v2-20]
Wisdom of Solomon 2:20
Let us condemn him to a shameful death,
for, according to his words, he will be visited with care.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-2-v2-21]
Wisdom of Solomon 2:21
They reasoned these things and went astray,
for their wickedness blinded them;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-2-v2-22]
Wisdom of Solomon 2:22
they did not know the mysteries of God,
nor hope for a reward of holiness,
nor recognize a prize for blameless souls.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-2-v2-23]
Wisdom of Solomon 2:23
For God created the human being for incorruption
and made him an image of His own eternity;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-2-v2-24]
Wisdom of Solomon 2:24
but through the devil’s envy death entered the world,
and those who belong to his portion experience it.
[/UNIT]

--- Wisdom of Solomon — Chapter 3 ---

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-3-v3-1]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-3-v3-2]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-3-v3-3]

and their going away from us a destruction;

[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-3-v3-4]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-3-v3-5]

and found them worthy of Himself.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-3-v3-6]

Like gold in a crucible He tested them,
and like a sacrificial whole burnt offering He accepted them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-3-v3-7]
Wisdom of Solomon 3:7
And at the time of their visitation they will shine out,
and like sparks among stubble they will dart about.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-3-v3-8]
Wisdom of Solomon 3:8
They will judge nations and rule over peoples,
and the Lord will reign over them unto the ages.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-3-v3-9]
Wisdom of Solomon 3:9
Those who trust in Him will understand truth,
and the faithful will remain with Him in love,
for grace and mercy are for His chosen ones.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-3-v3-10]
Wisdom of Solomon 3:10
But the ungodly will have punishment in keeping with their reasoning—
those who neglected what is righteous and departed from the Lord.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-3-v3-11]
Wisdom of Solomon 3:11
For the one who despises wisdom and discipline is wretched;
their hope is empty, their labors unprofitable,
and their works useless.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-3-v3-12]
Wisdom of Solomon 3:12
Their wives are foolish,
and their children wicked;
their offspring is accursed.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-3-v3-13]
Wisdom of Solomon 3:13
For blessed is the undefiled barren woman,
who has not known a bed of transgression;
she will have fruit at the visitation of souls,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-3-v3-14]
Wisdom of Solomon 3:14
and the eunuch who has done no lawless deed with his hand
and has not conceived evil against the Lord;
for a choice favor will be given him for his faithfulness,
and a more delightful portion in the Lord’s temple.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-3-v3-15]
Wisdom of Solomon 3:15
For the fruit of good labors is glorious,
and the root of understanding does not fail.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-3-v3-16]
Wisdom of Solomon 3:16
But the children of adulterers will not reach fulfillment,
and offspring from an unlawful bed will disappear.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-3-v3-17]
Wisdom of Solomon 3:17
For even if they become long-lived, they will be reckoned as nothing,
and their old age will be without honor at the end;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-3-v3-18]
Wisdom of Solomon 3:18
and if they die quickly, they will have no hope,
nor consolation on the day of decision.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-3-v3-19]
Wisdom of Solomon 3:19
For the ends of an unrighteous generation are harsh.
[/UNIT]

--- Wisdom of Solomon — Chapter 4 ---

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-4-v4-1]
Wisdom of Solomon 4:1
Childlessness with virtue is better,
for immortality is in its remembrance,
because it is recognized both by God and by human beings.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-4-v4-2]
Wisdom of Solomon 4:2
When it is present, people imitate it,
and when it has departed, they long for it;
throughout the age it marches crowned in triumph,
having won the contest for undefiled prizes.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-4-v4-3]
Wisdom of Solomon 4:3
But the prolific multitude of the ungodly will be of no use;
from illegitimate shoots it will not send a root deep down,
nor establish a secure foundation.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-4-v4-4]
Wisdom of Solomon 4:4
For even if it flourishes in branches for a time,
standing insecurely, it will be shaken by wind
and uprooted by the force of winds.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-4-v4-5]
Wisdom of Solomon 4:5
Unfulfilled branches will be broken off,
and their fruit will be useless, unripe for eating,
and fit for nothing.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-4-v4-6]
Wisdom of Solomon 4:6
For children born from unlawful unions
are witnesses of wickedness against their parents at their examination.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-4-v4-7]
Wisdom of Solomon 4:7
But if a righteous person dies early, he will be at rest.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-4-v4-8]
Wisdom of Solomon 4:8
For honorable old age is not length of time,
nor is it measured by a number of years;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-4-v4-9]
Wisdom of Solomon 4:9
rather, understanding is gray hair for human beings,
and an unstained life is the maturity of old age.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-4-v4-10]
Wisdom of Solomon 4:10
Having become pleasing to God, he was loved,
and while living among sinners he was transferred.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-4-v4-11]
Wisdom of Solomon 4:11
He was snatched away, lest evil change his understanding
or deceit mislead his soul;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-4-v4-12]
Wisdom of Solomon 4:12
for the fascination of wickedness obscures what is good,
and the wandering of desire alters an innocent mind.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-4-v4-13]
Wisdom of Solomon 4:13
Having been brought to completion in a short time, he fulfilled long years;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-4-v4-14]
Wisdom of Solomon 4:14
for his soul was pleasing to the Lord;
therefore he hastened from the midst of wickedness.
Yet the peoples saw and did not understand,
nor set such a thing in their minds:
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-4-v4-15]
Wisdom of Solomon 4:15
that grace and mercy are among His chosen ones,
and visitation among His holy ones.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-4-v4-16]
Wisdom of Solomon 4:16
But a righteous person who has died will condemn the living ungodly,
and youth brought swiftly to completion will condemn the many years of an unrighteous person’s old age.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-4-v4-17]
Wisdom of Solomon 4:17
For they will see a wise person’s end
and will not understand what the Lord planned concerning him
or for what purpose He kept him safe.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-4-v4-18]
Wisdom of Solomon 4:18
They will see and despise,
but the Lord will laugh them to scorn.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-4-v4-19]
Wisdom of Solomon 4:19
And afterward they will become a dishonored corpse
and an object of outrage among the dead for ever;
for He will dash them down headlong, speechless,
and shake them from their foundations;
they will be laid utterly waste,
and will be in anguish,
and their remembrance will perish.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-4-v4-20]
Wisdom of Solomon 4:20
They will come in dread at the reckoning of their sins,
and their lawless deeds will confront and convict them.
[/UNIT]

--- Wisdom of Solomon — Chapter 5 ---

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-5-v5-1]
Wisdom of Solomon 5:1
Then the righteous person will stand with great boldness
before those who afflicted him
and those who disregarded his labors.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-5-v5-2]
Wisdom of Solomon 5:2
When they see him, they will be troubled with terrible fear
and astonished at his unexpected salvation.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-5-v5-3]
Wisdom of Solomon 5:3
They will speak among themselves in repentance,
and in anguish of spirit they will groan and say:
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-5-v5-4]
Wisdom of Solomon 5:4
“This was the one whom we fools once made a laughingstock
and a byword of reproach.
We reckoned his life madness
and his end dishonorable.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-5-v5-5]
Wisdom of Solomon 5:5
How was he counted among the sons of God,
and how is his portion among the saints?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-5-v5-6]
Wisdom of Solomon 5:6
So we strayed from the way of truth,
and the light of righteousness did not shine upon us,

[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-5-v5-7]
Wisdom of Solomon 5:7
We were filled with paths of lawlessness and destruction,
and traveled through trackless deserts,
but the way of the Lord we did not know.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-5-v5-8]
Wisdom of Solomon 5:8
What did arrogance profit us?
And what did wealth with boasting contribute to us?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-5-v5-9]
Wisdom of Solomon 5:9
All those things passed like a shadow
and like a report rushing by;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-5-v5-10]
Wisdom of Solomon 5:10

[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-5-v5-11]
Wisdom of Solomon 5:11
or like a bird that has flown through the air:

It crossed the light air,
lashed by the beat of its pinions
and split by the force of its rushing wings;
and afterward no sign of its passage was found in it;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-5-v5-12]
Wisdom of Solomon 5:12
or like an arrow shot at a target:
the air it cut immediately flowed back into itself,
so that its course could not be known:
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-5-v5-13]
Wisdom of Solomon 5:13
so we also were born and vanished,
and had no sign of virtue to show,
but were consumed in our wickedness.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-5-v5-14]
Wisdom of Solomon 5:14
For the hope of an ungodly person is like dust borne by wind,
and like fine frost driven by a storm;
like smoke it was dispersed by wind,
and like the memory of a guest who stayed one day it passed away.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-5-v5-15]
Wisdom of Solomon 5:15
But the righteous live for ever,
and their reward is with the Lord,
and the Most High takes care of them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-5-v5-16]
Wisdom of Solomon 5:16
Therefore they will receive the royal crown of splendor
and the diadem of beauty from the Lord’s hand,
because with His right hand He will cover them
and with His arm He will shield them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-5-v5-17]
Wisdom of Solomon 5:17
He will take His zeal as full armor
and make creation into weapons to repel His enemies;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-5-v5-18]
Wisdom of Solomon 5:18
He will put on righteousness as a breastplate,
and put on unfeigned judgment as a helmet;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-5-v5-19]
Wisdom of Solomon 5:19
He will take holiness as an invincible shield,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-5-v5-20]
Wisdom of Solomon 5:20
and sharpen stern wrath into a sword;
the world will fight together with Him against the senseless.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-5-v5-21]
Wisdom of Solomon 5:21
Well-aimed bolts of lightning will go forth,
and from the clouds, as from a well-curved bow, they will leap at the target;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-5-v5-22]
Wisdom of Solomon 5:22
and hailstones full of fury will be hurled from a catapult;
the water of the sea will rage against them,
and rivers will flood over them relentlessly.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-5-v5-23]
Wisdom of Solomon 5:23
A mighty wind will oppose them
and winnow them away like a storm;
lawlessness will lay the whole earth waste,

[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-6-v6-2]

[/UNIT]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-6-v6-8]
Wisdom of Solomon 6:8

[/UNIT]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-6-v6-10]

For those who keep holy things in holiness will be made holy,

[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-6-v6-11]
Wisdom of Solomon 6:11

long for them, and you will be instructed.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-6-v6-12]
Wisdom of Solomon 6:12
Wisdom is radiant and unfading;

and found by those who seek her.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-6-v6-13]
Wisdom of Solomon 6:13
She goes ahead of those who desire her, making herself known first.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-6-v6-14]
Wisdom of Solomon 6:14

for he will find her sitting beside his gates.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-6-v6-15]
Wisdom of Solomon 6:15
For to reflect upon her is the perfection of understanding,
and the one who keeps watch for her will soon be free from care;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-6-v6-16]
Wisdom of Solomon 6:16
for she herself goes about seeking those worthy of her,
appears graciously to them on their paths,
and meets them in every thought.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-6-v6-17]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-11-v11-18]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-11-v11-19]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-11-v11-21]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-11-v11-22]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-11-v11-23]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-11-v11-24]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-11-v11-25]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-11-v11-26]
Wisdom of Solomon 11:26
But Thou sparest all things, because they are Thine, Master who loves life.
