[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-12-v12-2]
Wisdom of Solomon 12:2
Therefore Thou reprovest those who fall away little by little,
and admonishest them by reminding them of the things in which they sin,
so that, freed from evil, they may believe in Thee, Lord.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-12-v12-3]
Wisdom of Solomon 12:3
For the ancient inhabitants of Thy holy land,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-12-v12-4]
Wisdom of Solomon 12:4
whom Thou didst hate for practicing the most detestable things—
works of sorcery and unholy rites,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-12-v12-5]
Wisdom of Solomon 12:5
merciless murders of children,
and an entrail-devouring feast of human flesh and blood—
initiates from the midst of a ritual company,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-12-v12-6]
Wisdom of Solomon 12:6
and parents who were murderers of helpless lives,
Thou didst will to destroy by the hands of our fathers,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-12-v12-7]
Wisdom of Solomon 12:7
so that the land most precious to Thee of all
might receive a worthy settlement of God’s children.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-12-v12-8]
Wisdom of Solomon 12:8
Yet even these Thou didst spare as human beings,
and send hornets as forerunners of Thine army,
so that they might destroy them little by little.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-12-v12-9]
Wisdom of Solomon 12:9
Thou wast not unable to give the ungodly into the hands of the righteous in battle,
or to crush them all at once with terrifying beasts or a stern word;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-12-v12-10]
Wisdom of Solomon 12:10
but judging them little by little, Thou didst give room for repentance,
not unaware that their origin was wicked,
and their evil ingrained,
and that their reasoning would never change.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-12-v12-11]
Wisdom of Solomon 12:11
For they were an accursed offspring from the beginning;
nor was it out of fear of anyone that Thou didst grant them respite for their sins.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-12-v12-12]
Wisdom of Solomon 12:12
For who will say, ‘What hast Thou done?’
Or who will oppose Thy judgment?
Who will accuse Thee concerning destroyed nations that Thou didst make?
Or who will come to confront Thee as an avenger concerning unrighteous human beings?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-12-v12-13]
Wisdom of Solomon 12:13
For there is no god besides Thee, who cares for all,
so that Thou shouldst have to show that Thou hast not judged unjustly;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-12-v12-14]
Wisdom of Solomon 12:14
nor will a king or ruler be able to face Thee concerning those Thou didst punish.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-12-v12-15]
Wisdom of Solomon 12:15
But being righteous, Thou administerest all things righteously,
regarding it as alien to Thy power
to condemn anyone who does not deserve punishment.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-12-v12-16]
Wisdom of Solomon 12:16
For Thy strength is the beginning of righteousness,
and Thy mastery over all makes Thee spare all.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-12-v12-17]
Wisdom of Solomon 12:17
For Thou displayest strength when the completeness of Thy power is disbelieved,
and among those who know, Thou exposest their audacity.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-12-v12-18]
Wisdom of Solomon 12:18
But Thou, master of strength, judgest with gentleness
and governest us with great forbearance;
for the ability to act is at Thy disposal whenever Thou wilt.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-12-v12-19]
Wisdom of Solomon 12:19
Through such works Thou didst teach Thy people
that the righteous person must love humanity,
and make Thy sons hopeful,
because Thou givest repentance for sins.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-12-v12-20]
Wisdom of Solomon 12:20
For if Thou didst punish the enemies of Thy children, who were liable to death,
with such attention and leniency,
giving times and room through which they might be freed from evil,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-12-v12-21]
Wisdom of Solomon 12:21
with how much care didst Thou judge Thy sons,
to whose fathers Thou didst give oaths and covenants of good promises?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-12-v12-22]
Wisdom of Solomon 12:22
Therefore, while disciplining us, Thou scourgest our enemies with myriad blows,
so that when judging we may consider Thy goodness,
and when judged we may expect mercy.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-12-v12-23]
Wisdom of Solomon 12:23
Therefore those who lived unrighteously in a foolish way of life
Thou didst also torment through their own abominations.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-12-v12-24]
Wisdom of Solomon 12:24
For they wandered even farther than the paths of error,
supposing that creatures despised even among shameful animals were gods,
deceived like senseless infants.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-12-v12-25]
Wisdom of Solomon 12:25
Therefore, as to children without reason,
Thou didst send judgment in mockery.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-12-v12-26]
Wisdom of Solomon 12:26
But those who were not admonished by playful reproofs
will experience a judgment worthy of God.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-12-v12-27]
Wisdom of Solomon 12:27
For as they suffered punishment through the very creatures
they had supposed to be gods, they grew indignant at them,
and saw and recognized as the true God the One they had long refused to know;
therefore the final condemnation also came upon them.
[/UNIT]

--- Wisdom of Solomon — Chapter 13 ---

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-13-v13-1]
Wisdom of Solomon 13:1
For all human beings in whom ignorance of God was present were futile by nature;
from the good things seen they could not know the One who is,
nor, attending to the works, did they recognize the Artisan.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-13-v13-2]
Wisdom of Solomon 13:2
Instead, they supposed fire or wind or swift-moving air,
or the circuit of stars or violent water,
or the lights of heaven to be gods, rulers of the world.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-13-v13-3]
Wisdom of Solomon 13:3
If, delighted by their beauty, they supposed these things to be gods,
let them know how much better than these their Master is;
for the Originator of beauty created them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-13-v13-4]
Wisdom of Solomon 13:4
And if they were astonished at their power and activity,
let them understand from these how much more powerful the One who fashioned them is.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-13-v13-5]
Wisdom of Solomon 13:5
For from the greatness and beauty of created things
their Maker is seen by analogy.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-13-v13-6]
Wisdom of Solomon 13:6
Yet the blame upon these is small,
for perhaps they themselves go astray
while seeking God and wishing to find Him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-13-v13-7]
Wisdom of Solomon 13:7
For living among His works, they search them out
and are persuaded by their appearance, because the things seen are beautiful.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-13-v13-8]
Wisdom of Solomon 13:8
But again, even they are not excusable;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-13-v13-9]
Wisdom of Solomon 13:9
for if they were able to know so much
that they could investigate the world,
how did they not more quickly find the Master of these things?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-13-v13-10]
Wisdom of Solomon 13:10
But wretched are those whose hopes rest in dead things,
who called the works of human hands gods:
gold and silver, exercises of craftsmanship,
likenesses of living creatures,
or a useless stone, the work of an ancient hand.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-13-v13-11]
Wisdom of Solomon 13:11
Suppose a woodcutting craftsman sawed down a manageable tree,
skillfully scraped off all its bark,
and, working it handsomely,
fashioned a useful vessel for the service of life,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-13-v13-12]
Wisdom of Solomon 13:12
and burned the scraps from the work
to prepare food and ate his fill,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-13-v13-13]
Wisdom of Solomon 13:13
then took the scrap left from these, useful for nothing,
a crooked piece of wood grown full of knots,
and carved it with the care of his leisure,
shaped it with practiced understanding,
and made it resemble a human image,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-13-v13-14]
Wisdom of Solomon 13:14
or made it like some worthless animal,
coating it with red ocher and reddening its surface with paint,
and covering every blemish in it,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-13-v13-15]
Wisdom of Solomon 13:15
and made for it a dwelling worthy of it,
set it in a wall, and secured it with iron.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-13-v13-16]
Wisdom of Solomon 13:16
He took care that it would not fall,
knowing that it cannot help itself;
for it is an image and needs help.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-13-v13-17]
Wisdom of Solomon 13:17
Yet when praying concerning his possessions, marriage, and children,
he is not ashamed to address what has no soul;
for health he calls upon what is weak,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-13-v13-18]
Wisdom of Solomon 13:18
for life he petitions what is dead,
for assistance he begs what is utterly inexperienced,
for a journey what cannot even use its feet,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-13-v13-19]
Wisdom of Solomon 13:19
and for gain, work, and success of his hands,
he asks vigor of what is most powerless with its hands.
[/UNIT]

--- Wisdom of Solomon — Chapter 14 ---

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-14-v14-1]
Wisdom of Solomon 14:1
Again, someone preparing for a voyage and about to traverse wild waves
calls upon a piece of wood more rotten than the ship carrying him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-14-v14-2]
Wisdom of Solomon 14:2
For the desire for gain devised that ship,
and wisdom, the artisan, fashioned it;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-14-v14-3]
Wisdom of Solomon 14:3
but Thy providence, Father, steers it,
for Thou didst give a way even in the sea
and a safe path among the waves,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-14-v14-4]
Wisdom of Solomon 14:4
showing that Thou canst save from every danger,
so that even someone without skill may embark.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-14-v14-5]
Wisdom of Solomon 14:5
Thou wilt that the works of Thy wisdom should not be idle;
therefore human beings entrust their lives even to a very small piece of wood,
and, crossing the surge on a raft, they were brought safely through.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-14-v14-6]
Wisdom of Solomon 14:6
For even at the beginning, when arrogant giants were perishing,
the hope of the world took refuge on a raft
and left to the age a seed for generation, steered by Thy hand.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-14-v14-7]
Wisdom of Solomon 14:7
For blessed is wood through which righteousness comes about;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-14-v14-8]
Wisdom of Solomon 14:8
but the handmade object is accursed, both it and its maker:
the one because he made it,
and the other because, though corruptible, it was named a god.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-14-v14-9]
Wisdom of Solomon 14:9
For equally hateful to God are the ungodly person and his ungodliness;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-14-v14-10]
Wisdom of Solomon 14:10
for what was done will be punished together with the one who did it.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-14-v14-11]
Wisdom of Solomon 14:11
Therefore there will also be a visitation upon the nations’ idols,
because within God’s creation they became an abomination,
stumbling blocks to human souls,
and a snare for the feet of fools.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-14-v14-12]
Wisdom of Solomon 14:12
For the devising of idols is the beginning of sexual immorality,
and their invention the corruption of life.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-14-v14-13]
Wisdom of Solomon 14:13
For they did not exist from the beginning,
nor will they exist for ever;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-14-v14-14]
Wisdom of Solomon 14:14
through human vainglory they entered the world,
and therefore a swift end was planned for them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-14-v14-15]
Wisdom of Solomon 14:15
For a father worn down by untimely grief,
having made an image of a child swiftly taken away,
now honored as a god the one who had once been a dead human being,
and handed on mysteries and rites to those under him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-14-v14-16]
Wisdom of Solomon 14:16
Then, strengthened over time, the ungodly custom was kept as law.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-14-v14-17]
Wisdom of Solomon 14:17
And carved images were worshiped at rulers’ commands;
when people could not honor them face to face because they lived far away,
they reproduced their distant appearance
and made a visible image of the honored king,
so that by their zeal they might flatter the absent one as though present.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-14-v14-18]
Wisdom of Solomon 14:18
The artist’s ambition urged even those who did not know the king
toward still greater worship;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-14-v14-19]
Wisdom of Solomon 14:19
for, perhaps wishing to please the ruler,
he used his art to force the likeness toward greater beauty.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-14-v14-20]
Wisdom of Solomon 14:20
The multitude, drawn by the charm of the workmanship,
now reckoned as an object of worship the human being whom they had honored a little before.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-14-v14-21]
Wisdom of Solomon 14:21
And this became an ambush for life,
because human beings, enslaved either to misfortune or to royal power,
bestowed upon stones and pieces of wood the name that cannot be shared.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-14-v14-22]
Wisdom of Solomon 14:22
Then it was not enough to go astray about the knowledge of God;
living in the great war of ignorance,
they also call such great evils peace.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-14-v14-23]
Wisdom of Solomon 14:23
For while celebrating rites that murder children, or secret mysteries,
or frenzied revelries with strange customs,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-14-v14-24]
Wisdom of Solomon 14:24
they no longer keep either lives or marriages pure;
one kills another by ambush or grieves him by adultery.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-14-v14-25]
Wisdom of Solomon 14:25
Bloodshed and murder, theft and deceit, hold everything in confusion,
corruption, unfaithfulness, disturbance, perjury,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-14-v14-26]
Wisdom of Solomon 14:26
confusion of good things, forgetfulness of favor,
defilement of souls, alteration of natural relations,
disorder in marriages, adultery, and licentiousness.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-14-v14-27]
Wisdom of Solomon 14:27
For worship of nameless idols
is the beginning, cause, and end of every evil.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-14-v14-28]
Wisdom of Solomon 14:28
For they either go mad in their merrymaking, or prophesy lies,
or live unjustly, or readily swear falsely.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-14-v14-29]
Wisdom of Solomon 14:29
For trusting in lifeless idols,
they do not expect to be harmed when they swear wrongly.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-14-v14-30]
Wisdom of Solomon 14:30
But just consequences will pursue them for both things:
because they thought wrongly about God by attending to idols,
and swore unjustly in deceit, despising holiness.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-14-v14-31]
Wisdom of Solomon 14:31
For it is not the power of those by whom they swear,
but the justice due to sinners,
that always pursues the transgression of the unrighteous.
[/UNIT]

--- Wisdom of Solomon — Chapter 15 ---

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-15-v15-1]
Wisdom of Solomon 15:1
But Thou, our God, art good and true,
patient, and governing all things in mercy.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-15-v15-2]
Wisdom of Solomon 15:2
For even if we sin, we are Thine, knowing Thy might;
but we will not sin, knowing that we have been reckoned as Thine.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-15-v15-3]
Wisdom of Solomon 15:3
For to know Thee is complete righteousness,
and to know Thy might is the root of immortality.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-15-v15-4]
Wisdom of Solomon 15:4
For neither the evil-devising invention of human beings misled us,
nor the fruitless labor of painters,
a form stained with varied colors,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-15-v15-5]
Wisdom of Solomon 15:5
the sight of which stirs desire in fools,
and one longs for the breathless form of a dead image.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-15-v15-6]
Wisdom of Solomon 15:6
Lovers of evil and worthy of such hopes
are those who make them, those who desire them, and those who worship them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-15-v15-7]
Wisdom of Solomon 15:7
For a potter, laboriously kneading soft earth,
shapes each object for our service;
from the same clay he fashioned alike
vessels serving clean purposes
and those serving the opposite;
and the clay-worker decides the use of each kind.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-15-v15-8]
Wisdom of Solomon 15:8
With evil labor he also shapes a futile god from the same clay,
though he himself, having come from earth a little before,
will shortly go back to that from which he was taken,
when the debt of his soul is demanded.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-15-v15-9]
Wisdom of Solomon 15:9
But his concern is not that he is about to die,
nor that his life is short;
instead, he competes with goldsmiths and silver-workers,
imitates bronze-workers,
and considers it glory that he fashions counterfeits.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-15-v15-10]
Wisdom of Solomon 15:10
His heart is ashes, and his hope more worthless than earth,
and his life more dishonorable than clay,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-15-v15-11]
Wisdom of Solomon 15:11
because he did not know the One who formed him,
who breathed into him an active soul
and breathed in a life-giving spirit.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-15-v15-12]
Wisdom of Solomon 15:12
Instead, they reckoned our life a plaything
and our existence a profitable fair;
for he says that one must make gain from whatever source, even evil.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-15-v15-13]
Wisdom of Solomon 15:13
For this man knows better than everyone that he is sinning,
when he crafts fragile vessels and carved images from earthy material.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-15-v15-14]
Wisdom of Solomon 15:14
But all the enemies of Thy people who oppressed them
are most foolish and more wretched than an infant’s soul,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-15-v15-15]
Wisdom of Solomon 15:15
because they also reckoned all the nations’ idols gods,
though these have neither use of eyes for sight,
nor nostrils for drawing in air,
nor ears to hear,
nor fingers of their hands to feel,
and their feet are idle for walking.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-15-v15-16]
Wisdom of Solomon 15:16
For a human being made them,
and one who had borrowed his spirit fashioned them;
for no human being can shape a god like himself.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-15-v15-17]
Wisdom of Solomon 15:17
Being mortal, he makes a dead thing with lawless hands;
for he is better than the objects he worships:
he at least has lived, but they never have.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-15-v15-18]
Wisdom of Solomon 15:18
They also worship the most hateful animals,
for compared in senselessness with the others, these are worse;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-15-v15-19]
Wisdom of Solomon 15:19
Nor, in their appearance as animals, are they beautiful enough to be desired,
and they have escaped both God’s praise and His blessing.
[/UNIT]

--- Wisdom of Solomon — Chapter 16 ---

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-16-v16-1]
Wisdom of Solomon 16:1
Therefore they were deservedly punished through similar creatures
and tormented by a multitude of beasts.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-16-v16-2]
Wisdom of Solomon 16:2
In contrast to that punishment, Thou didst benefit Thy people:
to meet their eager appetite Thou didst prepare quail as food,
a novel taste,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-16-v16-3]
Wisdom of Solomon 16:3
so that those, though desiring food,
would turn away even from their necessary appetite
because of the loathsomeness of the creatures sent upon them,
while these, after a brief lack,
would share in a novel taste.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-16-v16-4]
Wisdom of Solomon 16:4
For unavoidable need had to come upon those who oppressed,
but these only had to be shown how their enemies were tormented.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-16-v16-5]
Wisdom of Solomon 16:5
For even when the terrible fury of beasts came upon them,
and they were being destroyed by the bites of twisting snakes,
Thy wrath did not remain to the end;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-16-v16-6]
Wisdom of Solomon 16:6
they were troubled for a short time as an admonition,
having a symbol of salvation to remind them of the commandment of Thy law.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-16-v16-7]
Wisdom of Solomon 16:7
For the one who turned toward it was saved not through what was seen,
but through Thee, the Savior of all.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-16-v16-8]
Wisdom of Solomon 16:8
Through this Thou didst also convince our enemies
that Thou art the One who rescues from every evil.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-16-v16-9]
Wisdom of Solomon 16:9
For the bites of locusts and flies killed those others,
and no cure was found for their lives,
because they deserved to be punished by such creatures;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-16-v16-10]
Wisdom of Solomon 16:10
but even the teeth of venom-spitting serpents did not conquer Thy sons,
for Thy mercy came to meet them and healed them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-16-v16-11]
Wisdom of Solomon 16:11
For they were stung as a reminder of Thine oracles
and swiftly brought safely through,
so that they would not fall into deep forgetfulness
and become inattentive to Thy beneficence.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-16-v16-12]
Wisdom of Solomon 16:12
For neither herb nor poultice healed them,
but Thy word, Lord, which heals all.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-16-v16-13]
Wisdom of Solomon 16:13
For Thou hast authority over life and death,
and Thou bringest down to the gates of Hades and bringest up again;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-16-v16-14]
Wisdom of Solomon 16:14
but a human being kills by his wickedness,
and does not bring back a spirit that has gone out,
nor release a soul that has been taken.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-16-v16-15]
Wisdom of Solomon 16:15
But it is impossible to escape Thy hand.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-16-v16-16]
Wisdom of Solomon 16:16
For the ungodly, refusing to know Thee,
were scourged by the strength of Thine arm,
pursued by strange rains, hail, and relentless showers,
and consumed by fire.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-16-v16-17]
Wisdom of Solomon 16:17
Most astonishingly, in water that quenches everything,
the fire worked still more strongly,
for the world fights for the righteous.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-16-v16-18]
Wisdom of Solomon 16:18
At one time the flame was tamed,
so that it would not burn up the animals sent against the ungodly,
but they themselves, seeing, would know that they were being driven by God’s judgment;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-16-v16-19]
Wisdom of Solomon 16:19
at another time, even amid water, it burns beyond fire’s own power,
so that it may destroy the produce of an unrighteous land.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-16-v16-20]
Wisdom of Solomon 16:20
In contrast, Thou didst feed Thy people with angels’ food
and supply them ready bread from heaven without toil,
capable of every delight and suited to every taste.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-16-v16-21]
Wisdom of Solomon 16:21
For Thy sustenance manifested Thy sweetness toward Thy children;
serving the desire of the one who received it,
it was transformed into whatever that person wished.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-16-v16-22]
Wisdom of Solomon 16:22
Snow and ice endured fire and did not melt,
so that they might know that the enemies’ fruits
were destroyed by fire blazing in the hail
and flashing in the rains;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-16-v16-23]
Wisdom of Solomon 16:23
yet again, so that the righteous might be nourished,
this fire has even forgotten its own power.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-16-v16-24]
Wisdom of Solomon 16:24
For creation, serving Thee who made it,
strains itself for punishment against the unrighteous
and relaxes itself for benefit on behalf of those who trust in Thee.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-16-v16-25]
Wisdom of Solomon 16:25
Therefore at that time also, changing into all things,
it served Thy gift that nourishes all,
according to the desire of those in need,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-16-v16-26]
Wisdom of Solomon 16:26
so that Thy sons whom Thou didst love, Lord, might learn
that it is not the production of fruits that nourishes a human being,
but Thine utterance that preserves those who trust in Thee.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-16-v16-27]
Wisdom of Solomon 16:27
For what was not destroyed by fire
melted when merely warmed by a brief ray of the sun,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-16-v16-28]
Wisdom of Solomon 16:28
so that it might be known that one must rise before the sun to give Thee thanks
and appeal to Thee at the rising of the light.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-16-v16-29]
Wisdom of Solomon 16:29
For the hope of an ungrateful person will melt like wintry frost
and flow away like useless water.
[/UNIT]

--- Wisdom of Solomon — Chapter 17 ---

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-17-v17-1]
Wisdom of Solomon 17:1
For Thy judgments are great and hard to recount;
therefore uninstructed souls went astray.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-17-v17-2]
Wisdom of Solomon 17:2
For lawless people, supposing they could oppress a holy nation,
lay as prisoners of darkness and captives of a long night,
shut under their roofs, fugitives from eternal providence.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-17-v17-3]
Wisdom of Solomon 17:3
For thinking they could escape notice in secret sins,
under a lightless covering of forgetfulness,
they were scattered, terribly astonished
and shaken by apparitions.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-17-v17-4]
Wisdom of Solomon 17:4
For not even the recess that held them kept them free from fear;
terrifying sounds rang around them,
and gloomy specters with unsmiling faces appeared.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-17-v17-5]
Wisdom of Solomon 17:5
No force of fire could give light,
nor could the bright flames of stars
endure to illuminate that hateful night.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-17-v17-6]
Wisdom of Solomon 17:6
Only a self-kindled fire
full of fear shone through to them;
terrified by that unseen sight,
they reckoned what they saw still worse.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-17-v17-7]
Wisdom of Solomon 17:7
The delusions of magical art lay prostrate,
and its boasting of understanding suffered a scornful exposure;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-17-v17-8]
Wisdom of Solomon 17:8
for those who promised to drive away the terrors and disturbances of a sick soul
were themselves sick with a ridiculous fear.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-17-v17-9]
Wisdom of Solomon 17:9
For even if nothing disturbing frightened them,
startled by the passing of beasts and the hissing of creeping things,
they perished trembling,
refusing even to look at the air, which cannot be escaped anywhere.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-17-v17-10]
Wisdom of Solomon 17:10
For wickedness is a cowardly thing, condemned by its own witness;
pressed by conscience, it always imagines grievous things.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-17-v17-11]
Wisdom of Solomon 17:11
For fear is nothing but a betrayal of the aids that come from reasoning;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-17-v17-12]
Wisdom of Solomon 17:12
and as expectation within grows weaker,
it reckons ignorance more fearful than the cause that produces the torment.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-17-v17-13]
Wisdom of Solomon 17:13
But they, sleeping the same sleep during that truly powerless night,
which had come upon them from the recesses of powerless Hades,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-17-v17-14]
Wisdom of Solomon 17:14
were at one moment driven by monstrous apparitions,
at another paralyzed by their soul’s betrayal;
for a sudden and unexpected fear poured over them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-17-v17-15]
Wisdom of Solomon 17:15
Then whoever it might be who fell there
was held under guard, shut in a prison without iron bars.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-17-v17-16]
Wisdom of Solomon 17:16
For whether someone was a farmer or shepherd
or a laborer toiling in the wilderness,
once overtaken, he endured the inescapable compulsion;
for all were bound by one chain of darkness.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-17-v17-17]
Wisdom of Solomon 17:17
Whether a whistling wind,
or the melodious sound of birds among spreading branches,
or the rhythm of water rushing violently,
or the harsh crash of falling rocks,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-17-v17-18]
Wisdom of Solomon 17:18
or the unseen running of leaping animals,
or the voice of the fiercest roaring beasts,
or an echo rebounding from the hollows of mountains,
these terrified and paralyzed them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-17-v17-19]
Wisdom of Solomon 17:19
For the whole world was illuminated by brilliant light
and occupied with unhindered works;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-17-v17-20]
Wisdom of Solomon 17:20
but over those alone a heavy night was spread,
an image of the darkness that was to receive them;
yet they were heavier to themselves than the darkness.
[/UNIT]

--- Wisdom of Solomon — Chapter 18 ---

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-18-v18-1]
Wisdom of Solomon 18:1
But for Thy holy ones there was very great light;
hearing their voices but not seeing their forms,
the others called them blessed because they had not suffered likewise,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-18-v18-2]
Wisdom of Solomon 18:2
and thanked them because, though previously wronged, they did not harm them,
and begged pardon for their quarrel.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-18-v18-3]
Wisdom of Solomon 18:3
In contrast, Thou didst supply a fire-blazing pillar,
a guide for an unknown journey,
and a harmless sun for a glorious sojourn abroad.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-18-v18-4]
Wisdom of Solomon 18:4
For those deserved to be deprived of light and imprisoned in darkness
who had kept Thy sons shut up,
through whom the incorruptible light of law was to be given to the world.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-18-v18-5]
Wisdom of Solomon 18:5
When they planned to kill the infants of the holy ones,
and one child had been exposed and saved,
Thou didst take away their multitude of children as a rebuke
and destroy them together in violent water.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-18-v18-6]
Wisdom of Solomon 18:6
That night was known beforehand to our fathers,
so that, knowing securely the oaths in which they trusted, they might take courage.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-18-v18-7]
Wisdom of Solomon 18:7
Thy people awaited
the salvation of the righteous and the destruction of enemies;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-18-v18-8]
Wisdom of Solomon 18:8
for by the very means through which Thou didst punish the opponents,
Thou didst glorify us, calling us to Thyself.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-18-v18-9]
Wisdom of Solomon 18:9
For in secret the holy children of good ancestors offered sacrifice,
and in unity established the divine law:
that the saints would share alike in the same good things and dangers,
already singing beforehand the praises of the fathers.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-18-v18-10]
Wisdom of Solomon 18:10
But the discordant cry of enemies echoed back,
and a pitiful sound spread abroad as children were mourned.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-18-v18-11]
Wisdom of Solomon 18:11
Slave and master were punished together by the same judgment,
and the commoner suffered the same things as the king;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-18-v18-12]
Wisdom of Solomon 18:12
all together, under one name of death,
they had countless dead;
for the living were not even sufficient to bury them,
since in a single moment their most honored offspring had been destroyed.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-18-v18-13]
Wisdom of Solomon 18:13
For though they disbelieved everything because of their sorceries,
at the destruction of the firstborn they acknowledged that the people were God’s son.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-18-v18-14]
Wisdom of Solomon 18:14
For while quiet silence surrounded all things
and night was midway through its swift course,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-18-v18-15]
Wisdom of Solomon 18:15
Thine all-powerful word leaped from heaven, from royal thrones,
a stern warrior, into the midst of the doomed land,
carrying Thine unfeigned command as a sharp sword;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-18-v18-16]
Wisdom of Solomon 18:16
standing there, it filled all things with death;
it touched heaven while standing upon the earth.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-18-v18-17]
Wisdom of Solomon 18:17
Then at once apparitions of dreadful dreams disturbed them,
and unexpected fears came upon them;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-18-v18-18]
Wisdom of Solomon 18:18
one here and another there, hurled down half-dead,
made known the reason why they were dying.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-18-v18-19]
Wisdom of Solomon 18:19
For the dreams that troubled them had announced this beforehand,
so that they would not perish without knowing why they suffered.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-18-v18-20]
Wisdom of Solomon 18:20
But a trial of death touched the righteous too,
and a breaking of the multitude occurred in the wilderness;
yet the wrath did not remain long.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-18-v18-21]
Wisdom of Solomon 18:21
For a blameless man hastened to fight for them,
bringing the weapon of his own ministry:
prayer and propitiation by incense.
He opposed the wrath and put an end to the calamity,
showing that he was Thy servant.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-18-v18-22]
Wisdom of Solomon 18:22
He conquered the anger, not by bodily strength,
not by the activity of weapons,
but by a word he subdued the punisher,
reminding him of the fathers’ oaths and covenants.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-18-v18-23]
Wisdom of Solomon 18:23
For when the dead had already fallen in heaps upon one another,
he stood between them and checked the wrath,
and cut off the path to the living.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-18-v18-24]
Wisdom of Solomon 18:24
For upon his ankle-length garment was the whole world,
and the glories of the fathers upon the engraving of four rows of stones,
and Thy majesty upon the diadem of his head.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-18-v18-25]
Wisdom of Solomon 18:25
To these the destroyer yielded, and these he feared;
for the trial of wrath alone was enough.
[/UNIT]

--- Wisdom of Solomon — Chapter 19 ---

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-19-v19-1]
Wisdom of Solomon 19:1
But merciless fury came upon the ungodly to the end,
for He knew beforehand even what they would do,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-19-v19-2]
Wisdom of Solomon 19:2
that after permitting the people to depart
and sending them on their way with haste,
they would change their minds and pursue them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-19-v19-3]
Wisdom of Solomon 19:3
For while their griefs were still at hand
and they were lamenting beside the graves of the dead,
they drew upon themselves another senseless plan,
and pursued as fugitives those whom they had begged to leave.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-19-v19-4]
Wisdom of Solomon 19:4
For the compulsion they deserved drew them toward this end
and cast upon them forgetfulness of what had happened,
so that they might fill up the punishment still lacking in their torments,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-19-v19-5]
Wisdom of Solomon 19:5
and Thy people might experience an astonishing journey,
while those others found an extraordinary death.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-19-v19-6]
Wisdom of Solomon 19:6
For the whole creation, in its own kind, was being fashioned anew from the beginning,
serving Thy commands,
so that Thy children might be guarded unharmed.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-19-v19-7]
Wisdom of Solomon 19:7
The cloud overshadowing the camp was seen,
and dry land rising from water that had existed before,
an unobstructed way out of the Red Sea,
and a grass-bearing plain out of the violent surge;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-19-v19-8]
Wisdom of Solomon 19:8
through it those sheltered by Thy hand passed as an entire nation,
having seen marvelous wonders.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-19-v19-9]
Wisdom of Solomon 19:9
For they grazed like horses
and leaped like lambs, praising Thee, Lord, who rescued them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-19-v19-10]
Wisdom of Solomon 19:10
For they still remembered the things from their sojourn:
how, instead of producing animals, the earth brought forth gnats,
and instead of aquatic creatures the river disgorged a multitude of frogs.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-19-v19-11]
Wisdom of Solomon 19:11
Later they also saw a new production of birds,
when, urged on by desire, they asked for luxurious foods;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-19-v19-12]
Wisdom of Solomon 19:12
for as a consolation quail came up to them from the sea.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-19-v19-13]
Wisdom of Solomon 19:13
Punishments also came upon the sinners,
not without earlier signs in the violence of thunderbolts;
for they suffered justly for their own wickedness,
since they had practiced a harsher hatred of strangers.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-19-v19-14]
Wisdom of Solomon 19:14
For the former did not receive unfamiliar visitors when they came,
but these enslaved strangers who had benefited them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-19-v19-15]
Wisdom of Solomon 19:15
And not only that: there will be a visitation upon the former,
since they received foreigners with hostility;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-19-v19-16]
Wisdom of Solomon 19:16
but the latter, after receiving with celebrations
those who had already shared in the same rights,
afflicted them with terrible labors.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-19-v19-17]
Wisdom of Solomon 19:17
They were also struck with blindness,
like those at the righteous man’s doors,
when, surrounded by yawning darkness,
each sought the passage through his own doors.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-19-v19-18]
Wisdom of Solomon 19:18
For the elements were being rearranged among themselves,
as notes on a harp change the pattern of the rhythm,
while always retaining their sound;
this can be inferred precisely from observing what happened.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-19-v19-19]
Wisdom of Solomon 19:19
For land creatures were changed into water creatures,
and swimming creatures moved onto land;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-19-v19-20]
Wisdom of Solomon 19:20
fire in water exceeded its own power,
and water forgot its nature of extinguishing;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-19-v19-21]
Wisdom of Solomon 19:21
flames, conversely, did not wither the flesh
of perishable animals walking among them,
nor the meltable, crystal-like kind of heavenly food that readily melts.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT wisdom-of-solomon-section-19-v19-22]
Wisdom of Solomon 19:22
For in every way, Lord, Thou didst magnify and glorify Thy people,
and didst not disregard them, standing beside them at every time and place.
[/UNIT]

=== Sirach ===

--- Sirach — Translator’s Prologue ---

[UNIT sirach-section-1-vPrologue-1]
Sirach Prologue 1
Since many great things have been given to us through the law, the prophets, and the others who followed after them, for which Israel ought to be praised for instruction and wisdom, and since the readers themselves ought not only to become knowledgeable,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-1-vPrologue-1a]
Sirach Prologue 1a
but lovers of learning should also be able to benefit those outside, both by speaking and by writing, my grandfather Jesus, having devoted himself extensively to reading the law and the prophets
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-1-vPrologue-1b]
Sirach Prologue 1b
and the other ancestral books, and having acquired considerable familiarity with them, was himself moved to write something concerning instruction and wisdom, so that lovers of learning, by becoming engaged with these things too, might advance much further through a life according to the law.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-1-vPrologue-1c]
Sirach Prologue 1c
You are therefore urged to read with goodwill and attention, and to be forgiving wherever we may seem
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-1-vPrologue-1d]
Sirach Prologue 1d
to fall short in some expressions despite the labor devoted to translation. For things expressed in Hebrew in their own form do not have equal force when transferred into another language. Not only these things, but even the law itself, the prophecies,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-1-vPrologue-1e]
Sirach Prologue 1e
and the remaining books show no small difference when expressed in their own form. For in the thirty-eighth year, under King Euergetes, I arrived in Egypt and stayed for some time; finding a likeness of no small learning,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-1-vPrologue-1f]
Sirach Prologue 1f
I myself considered it most necessary to contribute some diligence and hard work toward translating this book. During that time I devoted many wakeful hours and much skill to completing the book and publishing it also for those living abroad who wish to learn,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-1-vPrologue-1g]
Sirach Prologue 1g
preparing their character to live according to the law.
[/UNIT]

--- Sirach — Chapter 1 ---

[UNIT sirach-section-2-v1-1]
Sirach 1:1
All wisdom is from the Lord and is with Him for ever.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-2-v1-2]
Sirach 1:2
Who can count the sand of the seas, the drops of rain, and the days of eternity?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-2-v1-3]
Sirach 1:3
Who can trace the height of heaven, the breadth of the earth, the abyss, and wisdom?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-2-v1-4]
Sirach 1:4
Wisdom was created before all things, and discerning understanding from eternity.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-2-v1-6]
Sirach 1:6
To whom was the root of wisdom revealed? Who knew her skillful works?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-2-v1-8]
Sirach 1:8
There is One who is wise, greatly to be feared, seated upon His throne,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-2-v1-9]
Sirach 1:9
the Lord Himself. He created her, saw her, counted her out, and poured her upon all His works,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-2-v1-10]
Sirach 1:10
with all flesh according to His giving; He supplied her to those who love Him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-2-v1-11]
Sirach 1:11
The fear of the Lord is glory and a boast, gladness and a crown of rejoicing.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-2-v1-12]
Sirach 1:12
The fear of the Lord will delight the heart and give gladness, joy, and length of days.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-2-v1-13]
Sirach 1:13
It will go well at the end with the one who fears the Lord, and on the day of his death he will be blessed.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-2-v1-14]
Sirach 1:14
To fear the Lord is the beginning of wisdom; she was created together with the faithful in the womb.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-2-v1-15]
Sirach 1:15
Among human beings she nested on an eternal foundation, and among their offspring she will be trusted.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-2-v1-16]
Sirach 1:16
To fear the Lord is the fullness of wisdom, and she intoxicates them with her fruits.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-2-v1-17]
Sirach 1:17
She will fill their whole house with desirable things and their storehouses with her produce.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-2-v1-18]
Sirach 1:18
The fear of the Lord is the crown of wisdom, making peace and the health of healing flourish.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-2-v1-19]
Sirach 1:19
He saw her and counted her out; He rained down skill and discerning knowledge and raised high the glory of those who hold her fast.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-2-v1-20]
Sirach 1:20
To fear the Lord is the root of wisdom, and her branches are length of days.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-2-v1-22]
Sirach 1:22
Unjust anger cannot be justified, for the weight of a man’s anger brings about his fall.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-2-v1-23]
Sirach 1:23
A patient person will hold out until the right time, and afterward gladness will spring up for him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-2-v1-24]
Sirach 1:24
Until the right time he will conceal his words, and the lips of many will recount his understanding.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-2-v1-25]
Sirach 1:25
In wisdom’s treasuries are sayings of knowledge, but reverence for God is an abomination to a sinner.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-2-v1-26]
Sirach 1:26
If you desire wisdom, keep the commandments, and the Lord will supply her to you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-2-v1-27]
Sirach 1:27
For wisdom and instruction are the fear of the Lord, and faithfulness and gentleness are His good pleasure.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-2-v1-28]
Sirach 1:28
Do not disobey the fear of the Lord, and do not approach Him with a divided heart.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-2-v1-29]
Sirach 1:29
Do not play the hypocrite in people’s talk, and keep watch over your lips.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-2-v1-30]
Sirach 1:30
Do not exalt yourself, lest you fall and bring dishonor upon your soul. The Lord will uncover your hidden things and cast you down in the midst of the assembly, because you did not approach the fear of the Lord and your heart is full of deceit.
[/UNIT]

--- Sirach — Chapter 2 ---

[UNIT sirach-section-3-v2-1]
Sirach 2:1
Child, if you come to serve the Lord, prepare your soul for testing.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-3-v2-2]
Sirach 2:2
Set your heart straight and endure; do not rush in a time of calamity.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-3-v2-3]
Sirach 2:3
Cling to Him and do not withdraw, so that you may grow in your last days.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-3-v2-4]
Sirach 2:4
Accept whatever is brought upon you, and be patient amid the changes of your humiliation.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-3-v2-5]
Sirach 2:5
For gold is tested in fire, and acceptable people in the furnace of humiliation.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-3-v2-6]
Sirach 2:6
Trust Him, and He will support you. Set your ways straight and hope in Him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-3-v2-7]
Sirach 2:7
You who fear the Lord, wait for His mercy, and do not turn aside, lest you fall.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-3-v2-8]
Sirach 2:8
You who fear the Lord, trust Him, and your reward will certainly not fail.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-3-v2-9]
Sirach 2:9
You who fear the Lord, hope for good things, for eternal gladness and mercy.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-3-v2-10]
Sirach 2:10
Look at the generations of old and see: Who trusted in the Lord and was put to shame? Who remained in His fear and was abandoned? Who called upon Him and was disregarded by Him?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-3-v2-11]
Sirach 2:11
For the Lord is compassionate and merciful; He forgives sins and saves in a time of affliction.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-3-v2-12]
Sirach 2:12
Woe to cowardly hearts and slack hands, and to the sinner who walks on two paths!
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-3-v2-13]
Sirach 2:13
Woe to the slack heart, because it does not trust; therefore it will not be sheltered.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-3-v2-14]
Sirach 2:14
Woe to you who have lost endurance! What will you do when the Lord visits?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-3-v2-15]
Sirach 2:15
Those who fear the Lord will not disobey His words, and those who love Him will keep His ways.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-3-v2-16]
Sirach 2:16
Those who fear the Lord will seek His good pleasure, and those who love Him will be filled with the law.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-3-v2-17]
Sirach 2:17
Those who fear the Lord will prepare their hearts and humble their souls before Him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-3-v2-18]
Sirach 2:18
Let us fall into the hands of the Lord and not into human hands, for as His greatness is, so also is His mercy.
[/UNIT]

--- Sirach — Chapter 3 ---

[UNIT sirach-section-4-v3-1]
Sirach 3:1
Listen to me, your father, children, and act accordingly, so that you may be saved.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-4-v3-2]
Sirach 3:2

[/UNIT]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-39-v38-29]

[/UNIT]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-39-v38-33]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT sirach-section-39-v38-34]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT ezekiel-section-1-v1-18]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT ezekiel-section-1-v1-19]
Ezekiel 1:19
When the living creatures went, the wheels moved beside them; when the living creatures rose from the earth, the wheels rose.

[UNIT ezekiel-section-33-v33-13]

=== Daniel ===

--- Daniel 1 ---

[UNIT daniel-section-1-v1-1]
Daniel 1:1
In the third year of King Joakim of Judea, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon arrived at Jerusalem and besieged it.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-1-v1-2]
Daniel 1:2
The Lord handed the city into his hands, together with Joakim king of Judea and a portion of the Lord’s sacred vessels. He carried them away to Babylon and deposited them in his idol-temple.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-1-v1-3]
Daniel 1:3
The king told Abiesdri, his chief eunuch, to bring him some of the sons of Israel’s magnates, of the royal family and of the chosen men:
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-1-v1-4]
Daniel 1:4
young men without blemish, handsome, knowledgeable in every kind of wisdom, literate, intelligent, wise, and strong enough to be in the king’s house, and to teach them letters and the Chaldean tongue,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-1-v1-5]
Daniel 1:5
and to give them a ration from the king’s house each day, from the royal table and the wine the king drank, and to educate them for three years and place some of them before the king.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-1-v1-6]
Daniel 1:6
Among the lineage of Israel’s sons from Judea were Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-1-v1-7]
Daniel 1:7
The chief eunuch assigned them names: Daniel, Baltasar; Hananiah, Sedrach; Mishael, Misach; and Azariah, Abdenago.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-1-v1-8]
Daniel 1:8
Daniel considered in his heart how he might avoid being polluted by the king’s dinner and the wine he drank, and petitioned the chief eunuch that he might not be contaminated.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-1-v1-9]
Daniel 1:9
The Lord gave Daniel honor and favor before the chief eunuch.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-1-v1-10]
Daniel 1:10
The chief eunuch said to Daniel, “I am anxious about my lord the king, who prescribed your food and drink, lest he see your faces drawn and weak beside the foreign youths being reared with you, and I risk my own neck.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-1-v1-11]
Daniel 1:11
Daniel said to Abiesdri, appointed chief eunuch over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-1-v1-12]
Daniel 1:12
“Test your servants for ten days, and let us be given legumes from the earth to eat, and water to drink.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-1-v1-13]
Daniel 1:13
If our appearance looks drawn beside the other young men eating the royal dinner, then deal with your servants however you wish.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-1-v1-14]
Daniel 1:14
He dealt with them in this manner and tested them for ten days.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-1-v1-15]
Daniel 1:15
After ten days their appearance was good and their bodily condition better than the other young men eating the royal dinner.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-1-v1-16]
Daniel 1:16
Abiesdri kept removing their dinner and wine and giving them legumes in exchange.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-1-v1-17]
Daniel 1:17
The Lord gave the young men knowledge, understanding, and practical wisdom in every literary skill; to Daniel He gave understanding in every utterance, vision, dreams, and all wisdom.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-1-v1-18]
Daniel 1:18
After these days the king ordered them brought in, and the chief eunuch brought them before King Nebuchadnezzar.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-1-v1-19]
Daniel 1:19
The king conversed with them, and among the wise no one was found like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah. They remained beside the king.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-1-v1-20]
Daniel 1:20
In every matter of discourse, understanding, and education about which the king questioned them, he found them ten times wiser than the learned experts and philosophers throughout his kingdom. The king honored them, appointed them rulers, and declared them wiser than all his own men in affairs throughout his land and kingdom.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-1-v1-21]
Daniel 1:21
Daniel remained until the first year of the reign of Cyrus king of the Persians.
[/UNIT]

--- Daniel 2 ---

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-1]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-2]
Daniel 2:2
The king ordered the incantation-singers, magi, and sorcerers of the Chaldeans brought in to report his dreams to him. They arrived and stood beside the king.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-3]
Daniel 2:3
The king said to them, “I have seen a dream, and my spirit was stirred; therefore I wish to understand the dream.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-4]
Daniel 2:4
The Chaldeans spoke to the king in the Syrian language: “My lord king, live for ever! Report your dream to your servants, and we will explain its interpretation to you.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-5]
Daniel 2:5
The king answered the Chaldeans, “Unless you truthfully report the dream to me and disclose its interpretation, you will be made a public example, and your possessions will be taken into the royal treasury.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-6]
Daniel 2:6
But if you make the dream clear to me and report its interpretation, you will receive gifts of every kind and be honored by me. Disclose the dream to me and interpret it.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-7]
Daniel 2:7
They answered a second time, “O king, state the vision, and your servants will interpret accordingly.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-8]
Daniel 2:8
The king said to them, “I know for certain that you are buying time, since you have seen that the matter has departed from me. As I have commanded, so it will be.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-9]
Daniel 2:9
Unless you truthfully report the dream and disclose its interpretation, you will meet death. You have agreed together to speak false words before me until the time changes. Now, if you tell me what I saw during the night, I will know that you can also disclose its interpretation.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-10]
Daniel 2:10
The Chaldeans answered before the king, “No one on earth can tell the king what he has seen, as you ask. No king and no ruler asks such a thing of any wise man, magus, or Chaldean.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-11]
Daniel 2:11
The matter you seek, O king, is weighty and extraordinary. No one can disclose these things to the king except perhaps an angel, whose dwelling is not with any flesh. Therefore it cannot happen as you suppose.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-12]
Daniel 2:12
Then the king became gloomy and deeply grieved and ordered all the wise men of Babylonia brought out.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-13]
Daniel 2:13
It was decreed that all should be killed, and Daniel and everyone with him were sought so that they might perish together.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-14]
Daniel 2:14
Then Daniel shared his counsel and judgment with Arioch, the king’s chief cook, who had been ordered to bring out Babylonia’s learned men,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-15]
Daniel 2:15
and questioned him, saying, “On what matter is such a bitter decree being issued by the king?” Then Arioch explained the command to Daniel.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-16]
Daniel 2:16
Daniel quickly went in to the king and petitioned for time from the king, so that he might disclose everything before him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-17]
Daniel 2:17
Then Daniel went to his house and explained everything to his companions Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-18]
Daniel 2:18
He called for fasting and supplication and for help to be sought from the Lord Most High concerning this mystery, so that Daniel and those with him would not be handed over to destruction with Babylon’s learned men.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-19]
Daniel 2:19
Then, in a vision that very night, the king’s mystery was plainly revealed to Daniel. Daniel blessed the Lord Most High,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-20]
Daniel 2:20
and cried out, “The name of the great Lord will be blessed for ever, because wisdom and majesty belong to Him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-21]
Daniel 2:21
He changes seasons and times, transfers kings and appoints them, gives wisdom to the wise and understanding to those who possess knowledge,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-22]
Daniel 2:22
reveals deep and dark things, knows what is in darkness and what is in light, and with Him is a dwelling.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-23]
Daniel 2:23
To Thee, Lord of my fathers, I give thanks and praise, because Thou hast given me wisdom and prudence. Now Thou hast shown me everything I requested, to disclose these things to the king.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-24]
Daniel 2:24
Daniel went to Arioch, whom the king had appointed to kill all Babylonia’s learned men, and said, “Do not destroy Babylonia’s learned men. Bring me to the king, and I will disclose every detail to him.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-25]
Daniel 2:25
Then Arioch urgently brought Daniel to the king and said, “I have found a wise man from the captivity of the sons of Judea who will disclose every detail to the king.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-26]
Daniel 2:26
The king answered Daniel, who was called Baltasar in Chaldean, “Will you be able to disclose to me the vision I saw and its interpretation?”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-27]
Daniel 2:27
Daniel spoke aloud before the king, “Disclosure of the mystery the king saw does not belong to wise men, sorcerers, incantation-singers, or gazarenes,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-28]
Daniel 2:28
but there is a God in heaven who uncovers mysteries, who has disclosed to King Nebuchadnezzar what must happen in the last days. O king, live for ever! This is the dream and the vision of your head upon your bed:
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-29]
Daniel 2:29
You, O king, reclining upon your bed, saw everything that must happen in the last days, and the Revealer of mysteries disclosed to you what must happen.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-30]
Daniel 2:30
This mystery was revealed to me because of no wisdom in me beyond all people; rather, so that it might be disclosed to the king, what you conceived in your heart was made known to me.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-31]
Daniel 2:31
You, O king, saw a single image. That image was exceedingly large, its appearance was extraordinary as it stood before you, and the image’s appearance was frightening.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-32]
Daniel 2:32
Its head was good gold, its chest and arms silver, and its belly and thighs bronze,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-33]
Daniel 2:33

[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-34]
Daniel 2:34
You watched until a stone was cut from a mountain without hands. It struck the image on its feet of iron and earthenware and ground them down.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-35]
Daniel 2:35
Then the iron, earthenware, bronze, silver, and gold were ground fine together, becoming finer than chaff on a threshing floor. The wind scattered them so that nothing remained of them. The stone that struck the image became a great mountain and struck the whole earth.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-36]
Daniel 2:36
This was the vision; now we will state its interpretation before the king.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-37]
Daniel 2:37
You, O king, are king of kings, and the Lord of heaven has given you rule, kingdom, strength, honor, and glory.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-38]
Daniel 2:38
Throughout the inhabited world He has handed over into your hands human beings, wild beasts, birds of heaven, and fish of the sea, to rule them all. You are the golden head.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-39]
Daniel 2:39
After you a kingdom lesser than you will arise, and another, a third kingdom of bronze, which will rule the whole earth.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-40]
Daniel 2:40
A fourth kingdom will be strong like iron that subdues everything and cuts down every tree, and the whole earth will be shaken.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-41]
Daniel 2:41
As you saw its feet partly potter’s earthenware and partly iron, another kingdom, divided in two, will be within it, just as you saw iron mixed with clay earthenware.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-42]
Daniel 2:42
The toes of the feet were partly iron and partly earthenware; part of the kingdom will be strong and part shattered.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-43]
Daniel 2:43
As you saw iron mixed with clay earthenware, they will be mingled in human generation, but will neither agree nor have goodwill toward one another, just as iron cannot blend with earthenware.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-44]
Daniel 2:44
In the times of these kings the God of heaven will establish another kingdom, which will exist for ever and will not be destroyed. This kingdom will not leave another nation; it will strike and obliterate these kingdoms and will itself stand for ever,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-45]
Daniel 2:45
just as you saw a stone cut from a mountain without hands, pounding together the earthenware, iron, bronze, silver, and gold. The great God has shown the king what will happen in the last days. The vision is exact, and its interpretation trustworthy.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-46]
Daniel 2:46
Then King Nebuchadnezzar fell face down on the ground and prostrated himself before Daniel. He ordered sacrifices and libations made to him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-47]
Daniel 2:47
The king spoke aloud to Daniel, “Truly your God is God of gods and Lord of kings, the One who alone brings hidden mysteries to light, because you have been able to disclose this mystery.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-48]
Daniel 2:48
Then King Nebuchadnezzar exalted Daniel, gave him many great gifts, placed him over Babylonia’s affairs, and appointed him ruler and leader of all Babylonia’s learned men.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-2-v2-49]
Daniel 2:49
Daniel petitioned the king that Sedrach, Misach, and Abdenago be appointed over Babylonia’s affairs. Daniel remained in the royal court.
[/UNIT]

--- Daniel 3 ---

[UNIT daniel-section-3-v3-1]

[UNIT daniel-section-3-v3-2]

[UNIT daniel-section-3-v3-12]

[UNIT daniel-section-3-v3-13]
Daniel 3:13

[UNIT daniel-section-3-v3-16]

Daniel 3:18

[/UNIT]

[/UNIT]

For, Master, we have been diminished beyond all nations, and today we are lowly throughout the earth because of our sins.

At this time there is no ruler or prophet or leader, no burnt offering or sacrifice or offering or incense, no place to offer produce before Thee and find mercy.

[UNIT daniel-section-3-v3-41]

[/UNIT]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-3-v3-43]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-3-v3-44]

When they threw them in, those casting them were above them, while others stoked beneath them with naphtha, tow, pitch, and vine brushwood.
