--- Daniel 4 ---

[UNIT daniel-section-4-v4-4]
Daniel 4:4
In the eighteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar’s reign, he said, “I was at peace in my house and prospering upon my throne.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-4-v4-5]
Daniel 4:5
I saw a dream and became apprehensive; fear fell upon me.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-4-v4-10]
Daniel 4:10
I was sleeping, and there was a tall tree growing upon the earth. Its appearance was great, and no other was like it.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-4-v4-11]
Daniel 4:11
Its appearance was great: its top reached to heaven, and its mass to the clouds, filling what lay beneath heaven. The sun and moon dwelt in it and illuminated the whole earth.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-4-v4-12]
Daniel 4:12
Its branches were about thirty stadia long. All the wild animals of the earth found shade beneath it, and the birds of heaven nested in it. Its fruit was abundant and good, and it supplied all living creatures.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-4-v4-13]
Daniel 4:13
I was watching in my sleep, and an angel was sent in strength from heaven.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-4-v4-14]
Daniel 4:14
He called out and said to it, ‘Cut it down and destroy it, for the Most High has commanded that it be uprooted and rendered useless.’
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-4-v4-15]
Daniel 4:15
He spoke in this way: ‘Leave one root of it in the earth, so that it may graze on grass like an ox with the wild animals of the earth in the mountains;
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-4-v4-16]
Daniel 4:16
let his body be changed by heaven’s dew, and let him graze with them for seven years,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-4-v4-17]
Daniel 4:17
until he knows that the Lord of heaven has authority over everything in heaven and upon earth, and does among them whatever He wills.’
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-4-v4-17a]
Daniel 4:17a
Before me it was cut down in one day, and its destruction came within one hour of the day. Its branches were given to every wind; it was dragged away and thrown down. It ate the grass of the earth with the wild animals of the earth, was handed over to custody, and was bound by them in fetters and bronze handcuffs. I was greatly astonished at all this, and sleep departed from my eyes.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-4-v4-18]
Daniel 4:18
In the morning I rose from my bed and called Daniel, chief of the learned experts and leader of those who judge dreams. I recounted the dream to him, and he explained its entire interpretation to me.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-4-v4-19]
Daniel 4:19
Daniel was greatly astonished, and apprehension pressed upon him. Frightened, seized with trembling, and changed in appearance, he shook his head and remained astonished for an hour. He answered me in a gentle voice, ‘O king, may this dream come upon those who hate you and its interpretation upon your enemies!
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-4-v4-20]
Daniel 4:20
You, O king, are the tree planted in the earth, whose appearance was great.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-4-v4-21]
Daniel 4:21
And all the birds of heaven nesting in it—the strength of the earth and of the nations and of all languages to the ends of the earth, and all countries—serve you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-4-v4-22]
Daniel 4:22
The raising of that tree, its reaching heaven, and its mass touching the clouds mean that you, O king, were raised above all people upon the face of the whole earth. Your heart was raised in pride and strength against the Holy One and His angels. Your deeds were seen, because you laid waste the house of the living God on account of the sins of the consecrated people.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-4-v4-23]
Daniel 4:23
The vision you saw, that an angel was sent in strength from the Lord and commanded the tree’s removal and cutting down, means that the judgment of the great God will come upon you,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-4-v4-24]
Daniel 4:24
and the Most High and His angels are rushing against you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-4-v4-25]
Daniel 4:25
They will lead you away into custody and send you to a deserted place.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-4-v4-26]
Daniel 4:26
The root of the tree that was left, since it was not uprooted, means that the place of your throne will be preserved for you for a time and an hour. Behold! They are preparing against you; they will scourge you and bring the judgments upon you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-4-v4-27]
Daniel 4:27
The Lord lives in heaven, and His authority is over all the earth. Entreat Him concerning your sins, and redeem all your injustices by almsgiving, so that gentleness may be granted you, you may have many days upon your royal throne, and He may not destroy you. Love these words, for my word is accurate and your time is full.’”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-4-v4-28]
Daniel 4:28
At the completion of the words, Nebuchadnezzar, when he heard the judgment of the vision, kept the words in his heart.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-4-v4-29]
Daniel 4:29
After twelve months, the king was walking upon the city walls with all his glory and passing over its towers.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-4-v4-30]
Daniel 4:30
He spoke and said, “This is great Babylon, which I built, and it will be called the house of my kingship through the strength of my might, for the honor of my glory.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-4-v4-31]
Daniel 4:31
At the completion of his word, he heard a voice from heaven: “To you it is said, King Nebuchadnezzar: Babylon’s kingdom has been taken from you and is given to another, a despised man in your house. Behold! I appoint him over your kingdom; he will take your authority, glory, and luxury, so that you may recognize that the God of heaven has authority over human kingship and will give it to whomever He wishes. By sunrise another king will rejoice in your house and take possession of your glory, strength, and authority.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-4-v4-32]
Daniel 4:32
The angels will pursue you for seven years. You will neither be seen nor speak with any human being. They will feed you grass like an ox, and your pasture will be the earth’s greenery. Behold! In place of your glory they will bind you, and another will have your luxurious house and your kingdom.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-4-v4-33]
Daniel 4:33
By morning everything will be fulfilled upon you, Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon; nothing of all this will fail.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-4-v4-33a]
Daniel 4:33a
“I, Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, was bound for seven years. They fed me grass like an ox, and I ate the earth’s greenery. After seven years I devoted my soul to supplication and pleaded concerning my sins before the Lord, the God of heaven; concerning my acts of ignorance I entreated the great God of gods.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-4-v4-33b]
Daniel 4:33b
My hair became like an eagle’s wings, and my nails like a lion’s. My flesh and my heart were changed; I walked naked with the wild animals of the earth. I saw a dream, and apprehensions seized me. After a time a deep sleep took hold of me, and drowsiness fell upon me.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-4-v4-34]
Daniel 4:34
At the completion of the seven years, the time of my release came. My sins and my acts of ignorance reached their full measure before the God of heaven. I entreated the great God of gods concerning my acts of ignorance, and an angel called to me from heaven, saying, ‘Nebuchadnezzar, serve the holy God of heaven and give glory to the Most High; the kingship of your nation is restored to you.’
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-4-v4-36]
Daniel 4:36
At that time my kingdom was restored to me and my glory returned to me.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-4-v4-37]
Daniel 4:37
I give thanks to the Most High and praise Him who created heaven and earth, seas and rivers, and everything in them. I give thanks and praise, for He is God of gods, Lord of lords, and King of kings. He performs signs and wonders and changes seasons and times, taking kingdoms from kings and appointing others in their place.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-4-v4-37a]
Daniel 4:37a
From now on I will worship Him. Trembling has seized me through fear of Him, and I praise all His holy ones. For the gods of the nations have no strength in themselves to transfer one king’s kingdom to another king, to kill and make alive, to perform signs and great and fearsome wonders, or to change exceedingly great affairs, as the God of heaven has done in me, changing great affairs concerning me. Throughout all the days of my reign I will offer sacrifices to the Most High on behalf of my soul, as a pleasing aroma to the Lord. I will do what is acceptable before Him—I and my people, my nation and my countries under my authority. Whoever has spoken against the God of heaven, and whoever is caught speaking anything against Him, I will condemn to death.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-4-v4-37b]
Daniel 4:37b
King Nebuchadnezzar wrote a circular letter to all the nations in every place, to the countries and all languages dwelling in every country, from generation to generation: “Praise the Lord, the God of heaven, and gloriously bring Him sacrifice and offering. I, king of kings, gloriously give thanks to Him, because He has dealt with me in this way: on that very day He seated me upon my throne; I regained my authority and my kingdom among my people, and my greatness was restored to me.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-4-v4-37c]
Daniel 4:37c
“King Nebuchadnezzar to all nations, all countries, and all who dwell in them: May peace be multiplied to you at every time. Now I will explain to you the deeds that the great God has done with me. It pleased me to demonstrate to you and to your learned experts that there is a God, and His wonders are great; His kingship is an everlasting kingship, His authority from generation to generation.” He sent letters concerning everything that had happened to him in his kingdom to all the nations under his kingship.
[/UNIT]

--- Daniel 5 ---

[UNIT daniel-section-5-v5-preface]
Daniel 5:preface
King Baltasar held a great reception on the day of the dedication of his royal buildings and invited two thousand men from among his magnates. On that day Baltasar, elated by wine and boasting, praised all the nations’ cast and carved gods in his place, but gave no praise to God Most High. That very night fingers like a human’s came out and inscribed on the plaster of his house’s wall, opposite the lamp, “Mane, Phares, Thekel.” Their interpretation is: Mane, “It has been numbered”; Phares, “It has been taken away”; Thekel, “It has been weighed.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-5-v5-1]
Daniel 5:1
King Baltasar held a great banquet for his companions and drank wine.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-5-v5-2]
Daniel 5:2
His heart was exalted, and he ordered the gold and silver vessels of God’s house that his father Nebuchadnezzar had brought from Jerusalem to be brought in, and wine poured in them for his companions.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-5-v5-3]
Daniel 5:3
They were brought, and they drank from them,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-5-v5-4]
Daniel 5:4
and blessed their handmade idols. But they did not bless the everlasting God, who had authority over their breath.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-5-v5-5]
Daniel 5:5
At that very hour fingers like those of a human hand came out and wrote on the plaster of his house’s wall, opposite the light and before King Baltasar. He saw a hand writing.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-5-v5-6]
Daniel 5:6
His appearance changed, and fears and apprehensions pressed upon him. The king hurried and rose to look at that writing, while his companions around him were boasting.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-5-v5-7]
Daniel 5:7
The king cried out with a loud voice to summon the incantation-singers, sorcerers, Chaldeans, and gazarenes to report the writing’s interpretation. They came in to inspect the writing, but could not interpret it for the king. Then the king issued a decree: “Any man who explains the writing’s interpretation will be clothed in purple and have a gold necklace placed upon him, and he will be given authority over a third part of the kingdom.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-5-v5-8]
Daniel 5:8
The incantation-singers, sorcerers, and gazarenes came in, but no one could report the writing’s interpretation.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-5-v5-9]
Daniel 5:9
Then the king summoned the queen about the sign and explained to her how great it was, and that no one could report the writing’s interpretation to the king.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-5-v5-10]
Daniel 5:10
Then the queen mentioned to him Daniel, who was from the captivity of Judea,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-5-v5-11]
Daniel 5:11
and said to the king, “The man was knowledgeable and wise, surpassing all Babylon’s wise men,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-5-v5-12]
Daniel 5:12
and a holy spirit is in him. In the days of your father the king, he explained extraordinary interpretations to Nebuchadnezzar your father.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-5-v5-13]
Daniel 5:13
Then Daniel was brought before the king, and the king addressed him:
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-5-v5-16]
Daniel 5:16
“O Daniel, can you explain the writing’s interpretation to me? I will clothe you in purple and place a gold necklace upon you, and you will have authority over a third part of my kingdom.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-5-v5-17]
Daniel 5:17
Then Daniel stood opposite the writing and read it. He answered the king in this way: “This is the writing: ‘It has been numbered, it was reckoned, it has been taken away.’ The hand that wrote came to a stop. This is their interpretation:
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-5-v5-23]
Daniel 5:23
O king, you held a banquet for your friends and drank wine. The vessels of the living God’s house were brought to you, and you and your magnates drank from them and praised all the idols made by human hands. But you did not bless the living God. Your breath is in His hand, and He gave you your kingdom, yet you neither blessed Him nor offered Him praise.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-5-v5-26-28]
Daniel 5:26–28
This is the writing’s interpretation: your time of kingship has been numbered; your kingdom is ending. Your kingdom has been cut short and brought to completion; it is given to the Medes and Persians.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-5-v5-29]
Daniel 5:29
Then King Baltasar clothed Daniel in purple, placed a gold necklace upon him, and gave him authority over a third part of his kingdom.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-5-v5-30]
Daniel 5:30
The interpretation came upon King Baltasar; the kingship was taken from the Chaldeans and given to the Medes and Persians.
[/UNIT]

--- Daniel 6 ---

[UNIT daniel-section-6-v6-1]
Daniel 6:1
Artaxerxes of the Medes received the kingdom. Darius was full of days and glorious in old age.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-6-v6-2]
Daniel 6:2
He appointed one hundred twenty-seven satraps over his whole kingdom,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-6-v6-3]
Daniel 6:3
and over them three men as their leaders. Daniel was one of the three men,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-6-v6-4]
Daniel 6:4
having authority above everyone in the kingdom. Daniel was clothed in purple, great and glorious before King Darius, because he was distinguished, knowledgeable, and understanding, with a holy spirit in him, and prospered in the king’s affairs that he conducted. Then the king decided to appoint Daniel over his whole kingdom, along with the two men whom he had appointed with him and one hundred twenty-seven satraps.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-6-v6-5]
Daniel 6:5
When the king decided to appoint Daniel over his whole kingdom, the two young men devised a plan and resolution together. Since they could find no sin or ignorant fault in Daniel of which they could accuse him before the king,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-6-v6-6]
Daniel 6:6
they said, “Come, let us establish a restriction binding upon ourselves: no one is to make a request or offer a prayer to any god for thirty days, except to King Darius; otherwise he will die.” They intended to bring Daniel down before the king and have him thrown into the lions’ pit, for they knew that Daniel prayed and entreated the Lord his God three times a day.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-6-v6-7]
Daniel 6:7
Then those men approached and said before the king:
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-6-v6-8]
Daniel 6:8
“We have established a restriction and decree: anyone who offers a prayer or makes any request to any god for thirty days, except to King Darius, will be thrown into the lions’ pit.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-6-v6-9]
Daniel 6:9
They asked the king to establish the restriction and not alter it, because they knew that Daniel prayed and entreated three times a day; they intended him to be brought down through the king and thrown into the lions’ pit.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-6-v6-10]
Daniel 6:10
Thus King Darius established and ratified it.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-6-v6-11]
Daniel 6:11
When Daniel learned of the restriction established against him, he opened windows in his upper room toward Jerusalem, fell upon his face three times a day as he had done before, and made supplication.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-6-v6-12]
Daniel 6:12
They watched Daniel and caught him praying three times a day, every day.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-6-v6-13]
Daniel 6:13
Then these men appealed to the king and said, “King Darius, did you not decree a restriction that no one should offer a prayer or make a request to any god for thirty days except to you, O king, otherwise he would be thrown into the lions’ pit?” The king answered them, “The statement is exact, and the restriction will remain.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-6-v6-13a]
Daniel 6:13a
They said to him, “We adjure you by the decrees of the Medes and Persians: do not alter the command, show partiality, or diminish anything that has been stated; punish the man who has not kept this restriction.” He said, “I will do as you say; this is established with me.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-6-v6-14]
Daniel 6:14
They said, “Behold! We found Daniel your friend praying and seeking the face of his God three times a day.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-6-v6-15]
Daniel 6:15
The king, grieved, ordered Daniel thrown into the lions’ pit according to the restriction he had established against him. Then the king was deeply grieved over Daniel and tried to rescue him from the satraps’ hands until sunset,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-6-v6-16]
Daniel 6:16
but could not rescue him from them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-6-v6-17]
Daniel 6:17
King Darius cried out and said to Daniel, “Your God, whom you worship continually three times a day, will rescue you from the lions’ power. Take courage until morning.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-6-v6-18]
Daniel 6:18
Then Daniel was thrown into the lions’ pit. A stone was brought and placed at the pit’s mouth, and the king sealed it with his own ring and his magnates’ rings, so that Daniel could not be taken away from them, nor could the king pull him up from the pit.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-6-v6-19]
Daniel 6:19
Then the king returned to his royal residence and spent the night fasting, grieving over Daniel. Daniel’s God, taking care of him, shut the lions’ mouths, and they did not trouble Daniel.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-6-v6-20]
Daniel 6:20
King Darius rose early in the morning, took the satraps with him, and went and stood at the mouth of the lions’ pit.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-6-v6-21]
Daniel 6:21
Then the king called to Daniel with a loud voice and weeping: “O Daniel, are you perhaps alive? Has your God, whom you worship continually, saved you from the lions, so that they have not destroyed you?”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT daniel-section-6-v6-22]

The number of Israel’s sons was like the sand of the sea, which will not be measured or counted. And it shall come to pass that in the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not My people,’ there they will be called sons of the living God.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-2-v2-2]
Hosea 2:2
Judah’s sons and Israel’s sons will gather together, appoint one authority for themselves and come up from the land, for great is Jezreel’s day.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-2-v2-3]
Hosea 2:3
Say to your brother, ‘My People,’ and to your sister, ‘Shown Mercy.’
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-2-v2-4]
Hosea 2:4
“Enter into judgment with your mother, enter into judgment! For she is not My wife and I am not her husband. I will remove her prostitution from My face and her adultery from between her breasts,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-2-v2-5]
Hosea 2:5
so that I may strip her naked and restore her as on the day of her birth. I will make her like a wilderness, set her like a waterless land and kill her with thirst.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-2-v2-6]
Hosea 2:6
I will certainly show no mercy to her children, for they are children of prostitution.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-2-v2-7]
Hosea 2:7
For their mother prostituted herself; she who bore them brought shame. She said, ‘I will follow my lovers, who give me my loaves and water, my garments and linen cloths, my oil and everything due to me.’
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-2-v2-8]
Hosea 2:8
Therefore look, I block her way with thorns and will build up her roads, and she will certainly not find her path.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-2-v2-9]
Hosea 2:9
She will pursue her lovers but certainly not catch them; she will seek them but certainly not find them. She will say, ‘I will go and return to my former husband, for it was better for me then than now.’
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-2-v2-10]
Hosea 2:10
She did not know that it was I who gave her grain, wine and oil and multiplied silver for her; but she made silver and gold objects for Baal.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-2-v2-11]
Hosea 2:11
Therefore I will return and recover My grain at its season and My wine at its time; I will take away My garments and linen cloths so that they do not cover her shame.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-2-v2-12]
Hosea 2:12
Now I will uncover her uncleanness before her lovers, and certainly no one will deliver her from My hand.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-2-v2-13]
Hosea 2:13
I will turn away all her rejoicings, her festivals, new moons and Sabbaths, and all her festal assemblies.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-2-v2-14]
Hosea 2:14
I will obliterate her vine and fig trees, of which she said, ‘These are my wages that my lovers gave me.’ I will make them a testimony, and the field’s beasts, heaven’s birds and the earth’s creeping things will devour them.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-2-v2-15]
Hosea 2:15
“I will exact vengeance upon her for the days of the Baalim, when she sacrificed to them, put on her earrings and necklaces and went after her lovers, but forgot Me,” says the Lord.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-2-v2-16]
Hosea 2:16
“Therefore look, I am leading her astray; I will place her in a wilderness and speak to her heart,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-2-v2-17]
Hosea 2:17
and from there I will give her her possessions and the Valley of Achor to open her understanding. There she will be humbled as in the days of her infancy and the days of her ascent from Egypt’s land.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-2-v2-18]
Hosea 2:18
On that day,” says the Lord, “she will call Me ‘My Husband’ and no longer call Me ‘Baalim.’
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-2-v2-19]
Hosea 2:19
I will remove the names of the Baalim from her mouth, and they will certainly no longer remember their names.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-2-v2-20]
Hosea 2:20
On that day I will establish a covenant for them with the field’s beasts, heaven’s birds and the earth’s creeping things. I will shatter bow, sword and war from the land and settle you in hope.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-2-v2-21]
Hosea 2:21
I will betroth you to Myself forever; I will betroth you to Myself in righteousness and judgment, in mercy and compassion,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-2-v2-22]
Hosea 2:22
and I will betroth you to Myself in faithfulness, and you will know the Lord.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-2-v2-23]
Hosea 2:23
On that day,” says the Lord, “I will listen to heaven, and heaven will listen to the earth,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-2-v2-24]
Hosea 2:24
and the earth will listen to grain, wine and oil, and they will listen to Jezreel.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-2-v2-25]
Hosea 2:25
I will sow her for Myself upon the land, show mercy to Not Shown Mercy and say to Not My People, ‘You are My people.’ He will say, ‘Thou art the Lord my God!’”
[/UNIT]

--- Hosea 3 ---

[UNIT hosea-section-3-v3-1]
Hosea 3:1
The Lord said to me, “Go again and love a woman who loves evil things and is an adulteress, just as God loves Israel’s sons, though they look toward foreign gods and love cakes with raisins.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-3-v3-2]
Hosea 3:2
I hired her for myself for fifteen pieces of silver, a gomor of barley and a nebel of wine.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-3-v3-3]
Hosea 3:3
I said to her, “You will remain with me many days; you must certainly not prostitute yourself or belong to another man, and I toward you.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-3-v3-4]
Hosea 3:4
For Israel’s sons will remain many days without king or ruler, without sacrifice or altar, without priesthood or manifestations.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-3-v3-5]
Hosea 3:5
After these things Israel’s sons will return and seek the Lord their God and David their king; they will be astonished at the Lord and His good things in the last days.
[/UNIT]

--- Hosea 4 ---

[UNIT hosea-section-4-v4-1]
Hosea 4:1
Hear the Lord’s word, sons of Israel, for the Lord has a case against the land’s inhabitants: there is no truth, no mercy and no recognition of God upon the land.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-4-v4-2]
Hosea 4:2
Cursing, falsehood, murder, theft and adultery have poured over the land, and they mix bloodshed with bloodshed.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-4-v4-3]
Hosea 4:3
Therefore the land will mourn and diminish with all who inhabit it, with the field’s beasts, the earth’s creeping things and heaven’s birds; the sea’s fish will disappear,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-4-v4-4]
Hosea 4:4
so that no one brings a case and no one rebukes; but My people are like a priest being contradicted.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-4-v4-5]
Hosea 4:5
You will grow weak by day, and a prophet will also grow weak with you; I likened your mother to night.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-4-v4-6]
Hosea 4:6
My people were likened to one without knowledge. Because you thrust away recognition, I too will thrust you away from serving Me as priest. You forgot your God’s law, and I too will forget your children.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-4-v4-7]
Hosea 4:7
According to their multitude, so they sinned against Me; I will turn their glory into dishonor.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-4-v4-8]
Hosea 4:8
They will eat My people’s sins and take their souls amid their injustices.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-4-v4-9]
Hosea 4:9
It will be as with the people, so with the priest; I will exact punishment upon him for his ways and repay him for his schemes.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-4-v4-10]
Hosea 4:10
They will eat but certainly not be filled; they prostituted themselves but will certainly not prosper, because they abandoned keeping faith with the Lord.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-4-v4-11]
Hosea 4:11
My people’s heart welcomed prostitution, wine and intoxicating drink.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-4-v4-12]
Hosea 4:12
They inquired by signs, and by his rods they announced things to him; they were led astray by a spirit of prostitution and prostituted themselves away from their God.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-4-v4-13]
Hosea 4:13
On the mountaintops they sacrificed, and on the hills they offered sacrifice, beneath oak, poplar and a tree providing shade, because shelter is good. Therefore your daughters will prostitute themselves and your daughters-in-law commit adultery.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-4-v4-14]
Hosea 4:14
I will certainly not call your daughters to account when they prostitute themselves, or your daughters-in-law when they commit adultery, for the men themselves mixed with prostitutes and sacrificed with initiates; the people who understood became entangled with a prostitute.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-4-v4-15]
Hosea 4:15
But you, Israel, do not be ignorant; and Judah, do not enter Gilgal or go up to the house of On, and do not swear by the living Lord.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-4-v4-16]
Hosea 4:16
For Israel has run wild like a heifer running wild. Now the Lord will pasture them like a lamb in an open place.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-4-v4-17]
Hosea 4:17
Ephraim, a partner of idols, set stumbling blocks for himself.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-4-v4-18]
Hosea 4:18
He chose Canaanites. They prostituted themselves thoroughly; they loved dishonor arising from their arrogance.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-4-v4-19]
Hosea 4:19
You are a whirlwind within its wings, and they will be put to shame because of their altars.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-5-v5-1]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-5-v5-8]
Hosea 5:8

[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-5-v5-9]
Hosea 5:9
Ephraim was brought to ruin in days of rebuke. Among Israel’s tribes I revealed trustworthy things.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-5-v5-10]
Hosea 5:10
Judah’s rulers became like people moving boundaries; upon them I will pour My onrush like water.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-5-v5-11]
Hosea 5:11
Ephraim oppressed his adversary and trampled judgment, because he began to follow worthless things.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-5-v5-12]
Hosea 5:12

[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-5-v5-13]
Hosea 5:13
Ephraim saw his illness and Judah his pain; Ephraim went to the Assyrians and sent ambassadors to King Jarim. But he could not heal you, and pain will certainly not cease among you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-5-v5-14]
Hosea 5:14
For I am like a panther to Ephraim and like a lion to Judah’s house. I seize and will go away and take, and there will be no one to rescue.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-5-v5-15]
Hosea 5:15
I will go and return to My place until they disappear; they will seek My face, and in their affliction they will rise early toward Me, saying,
[/UNIT]

[/UNIT]

All grew hot like an oven and devoured their judges. All their kings fell; there was no one among them calling to Me.

[UNIT hosea-section-7-v7-12]

[UNIT hosea-section-7-v7-13]

Woe to them, because they sprang away from Me! They are miserable, because they acted impiously toward Me. I redeemed them, but they spoke falsehoods against Me.

[UNIT hosea-section-7-v7-14]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-7-v7-15]
Hosea 7:15

[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-7-v7-16]

They will cry to Me, ‘God, we know Thee!’

[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-9-v9-2]

[/UNIT]

[/UNIT]

Hosea 9:4

[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-9-v9-5]
Hosea 9:5
What will you do on a day of assembly and on the day of the Lord’s festival?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-9-v9-6]
Hosea 9:6

[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-9-v9-7]

The days of vengeance have come; the days of your repayment have come. Israel will be afflicted like the deranged prophet, a spirit-bearing man. Because your injustices were many, your madness increased.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-9-v9-8]
Hosea 9:8
Ephraim’s watchman is with God; a prophet, a crooked trap upon all his ways. They fixed madness in the Lord’s house.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-9-v9-9]
Hosea 9:9
They were corrupted as in the hill’s days. He will remember his injustices; He will punish his sins.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-9-v9-10]
Hosea 9:10
Like a cluster of grapes in a wilderness I found Israel, and like an early lookout in a fig tree I saw their fathers. They went to Beel-phegor and became estranged into shame, and the beloved became like the detested.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-9-v9-11]
Hosea 9:11
Ephraim flew away like a bird; their glories are from births, labor pains and conceptions,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-9-v9-12]
Hosea 9:12
because even if they rear their children, they will be bereaved among humankind. Indeed, woe is upon them: My flesh is from them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-9-v9-13]
Hosea 9:13
Ephraim, as I saw them, presented their children for a hunt; and Ephraim must bring his children out to piercing.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-9-v9-14]
Hosea 9:14
Give them, Lord—what wilt Thou give them? Give them a childless womb and dry breasts.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-9-v9-15]
Hosea 9:15
All their evils are at Gilgal, because there I hated them. Because of their wicked practices I will expel them from My house. I will certainly love them no longer; all their rulers are disobedient.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-9-v9-16]
Hosea 9:16
Ephraim suffered; he dried up at his roots; he will certainly bear fruit no longer. Even if they give birth, I will kill the desired offspring of their womb.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT hosea-section-9-v9-17]
Hosea 9:17
God will thrust them away because they did not listen to Him, and they will be wanderers among the nations.
[/UNIT]

I saw the Lord standing upon the altar. He said, “Strike the atonement cover, and the foregates will shake; cut through the heads of all. I will kill their survivors with a sword. No one fleeing from among them will escape, and no one seeking safety will be saved.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT amos-section-9-v9-2]
Amos 9:2
If they burrow into Hades, My hand will pull them up from there; if they climb to heaven, I will bring them down from there.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT amos-section-9-v9-3]
Amos 9:3
If they hide on Carmel’s summit, I will search them out and take them from there. If they plunge from My eyes into the sea’s depths, I will command the dragon there, and it will bite them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT amos-section-9-v9-4]
Amos 9:4
If they go into captivity before their enemies, I will command the sword there, and it will kill them. I will fix My eyes upon them for evils and not for good things.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT amos-section-9-v9-5]
Amos 9:5
The Lord, Lord God Almighty, touches the earth and shakes it; all who dwell in it will mourn. Its consummation will rise like a river and descend like Egypt’s river.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT amos-section-9-v9-6]
Amos 9:6
He builds His ascent into heaven and establishes His promise upon the earth; He calls for the sea’s water and pours it upon the earth’s surface. The Lord God Almighty is His name.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT amos-section-9-v9-7]
Amos 9:7
“Are you not like the children of Ethiopians to Me, children of Israel?” says the Lord. “Did I not bring Israel up from Egypt’s land, the foreigners from Cappadocia and the Syrians from a pit?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT amos-section-9-v9-8]
Amos 9:8
Look, the Lord God’s eyes are upon the kingdom of sinners, and I will remove it from the earth’s surface. Yet I will not completely remove Jacob’s house,” says the Lord.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT amos-section-9-v9-9]
Amos 9:9
“For look, I am giving a command: I will winnow Israel’s house among all the nations as one winnows in a winnowing basket, and no fragment will fall to the ground.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT amos-section-9-v9-10]
Amos 9:10
All the sinners of My people will die by a sword, those who say, ‘Evils certainly will not draw near or come upon us.’
[/UNIT]

[UNIT amos-section-9-v9-11]
Amos 9:11
On that day I will raise David’s fallen tent; I will rebuild its fallen parts, raise its demolished parts and rebuild it as in days of old,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT amos-section-9-v9-12]
Amos 9:12
so that the remnant of humankind and all the nations over whom My name has been called may seek,” says the Lord God, who does these things.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT amos-section-9-v9-13]
Amos 9:13
“Look, days are coming,” says the Lord, “when threshing will overtake the vintage and grapes will darken to ripeness at seedtime. The mountains will drip sweetness, and all the hills will be planted together.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT amos-section-9-v9-14]
Amos 9:14
I will reverse the captivity of My people Israel. They will build ruined cities and inhabit them, plant vineyards and drink their wine, plant gardens and eat their fruit.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT amos-section-9-v9-15]
Amos 9:15
I will plant them upon their land, and they will certainly never again be uprooted from the land I have given them,” says the Lord God Almighty.
[/UNIT]

=== Obadiah ===

--- Obadiah 1 ---

[UNIT obadiah-section-1-v1-1]
Obadiah 1:1
The vision of Obadiah. Thus says the Lord God to Idumea: I heard a report from the Lord, and He sent a dispatch to the nations: “Rise up! Let us rise against her for battle!”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT obadiah-section-1-v1-2]
Obadiah 1:2
Look, I have made you insignificant among the nations; you are greatly dishonored.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT obadiah-section-1-v1-3]
Obadiah 1:3
The pride of your heart has lifted you up, you who camp in holes in the rocks, raising his dwelling high and saying in his heart, “Who will bring me down to the ground?”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT obadiah-section-1-v1-4]
Obadiah 1:4
If you soar like an eagle, and if you place your nest among the stars, from there I will bring you down, says the Lord.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT obadiah-section-1-v1-5]
Obadiah 1:5
If thieves came in to you, or robbers by night, where would you have been cast away? Would they not have stolen enough for themselves? And if grape gatherers came in to you, would they not have left a gleaning?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT obadiah-section-1-v1-6]
Obadiah 1:6
How Esau has been searched out, and his hidden things seized!
[/UNIT]

[UNIT obadiah-section-1-v1-7]
Obadiah 1:7
All the men of your covenant sent you out as far as your borders; the men at peace with you opposed you and prevailed over you. They set ambushes beneath you. There is no understanding in them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT obadiah-section-1-v1-8]
Obadiah 1:8
On that day, says the Lord, I will destroy the wise from Idumea and understanding from Mount Esau.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT obadiah-section-1-v1-9]
Obadiah 1:9
Your warriors from Teman will be terrified, so that a person may be removed from Mount Esau,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT obadiah-section-1-v1-10]
Obadiah 1:10
because of the slaughter and the impiety toward your brother Jacob; and shame will cover you, and you will be removed forever.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT obadiah-section-1-v1-11]
Obadiah 1:11
From the day you stood opposed, on the day foreigners took his strength captive and strangers entered his gates and cast lots over Jerusalem, you too were like one of them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT obadiah-section-1-v1-12]
Obadiah 1:12
Do not look on your brother’s day, on the day of strangers; do not rejoice over the sons of Judah on the day of their destruction; do not speak boastfully on the day of affliction.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT obadiah-section-1-v1-13]
Obadiah 1:13
Do not enter the gates of peoples on the day of their suffering. You, too, must not look on their assembly on the day of their destruction, and do not join in attacking their strength on the day of their destruction.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT obadiah-section-1-v1-14]
Obadiah 1:14
Do not stand at their escape routes to destroy those of them who are being saved, and do not shut in those fleeing from them on the day of affliction.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT obadiah-section-1-v1-15]
Obadiah 1:15
For the day of the Lord is near against all the nations. Just as you acted, so it will be for you; your recompense will be repaid upon your own head.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT obadiah-section-1-v1-16]
Obadiah 1:16
For just as you drank on My holy mountain, all the nations will drink wine; they will drink and go down, and they will be as though they did not exist.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT obadiah-section-1-v1-17]
Obadiah 1:17
But on Mount Zion there will be salvation, and it will be holy; the house of Jacob will possess those who possessed them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT obadiah-section-1-v1-18]
Obadiah 1:18
The house of Jacob will be a fire, the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau stubble. They will blaze against them and consume them, and there will be no bearer of fire in the house of Esau, because the Lord has spoken.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT obadiah-section-1-v1-19]
Obadiah 1:19
Those in the Negeb will possess the mountain of Esau, and those in the Shephelah will possess the foreigners. They will possess the mountain of Ephraim, the plain of Samaria, Benjamin and the land of Gilead.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT obadiah-section-1-v1-20]
Obadiah 1:20
And this is the beginning of the deportation: for the sons of Israel, the land of the Canaanites as far as Zarephath; and the deportation of Jerusalem as far as Ephrathah. They will inherit the cities of the Negeb.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT obadiah-section-1-v1-21]
Obadiah 1:21
And men who have been saved shall ascend from Mount Zion to execute judgment upon the mountain of Esau; and the kingdom shall be the Lord’s.
[/UNIT]

=== Jonah ===

--- Jonah 1 ---

[UNIT jonah-section-1-v1-1]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT jonah-section-1-v1-2]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT jonah-section-1-v1-3]

But Jonah rose to flee to Tarshish from the presence of the Lord. He went down to Joppa, found a ship traveling to Tarshish, paid its fare and boarded it, to sail with them to Tarshish from the presence of the Lord.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT jonah-section-1-v1-4]
Jonah 1:4 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
The Lord stirred up a wind upon the sea, and there was a great surge on the sea; the ship was in danger of being shattered.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT jonah-section-1-v1-5]
Jonah 1:5 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
The sailors were afraid, and each was crying out to their god. They threw the equipment in the ship into the sea, to lighten their load. But Jonah had gone down into the hollow of the ship, and was sleeping and snoring.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT jonah-section-1-v1-6]
Jonah 1:6 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
The ship’s officer approached him and said, “Why are you snoring? Rise and call upon your god, so that the god may bring us safely through and we may not perish.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT jonah-section-1-v1-7]
Jonah 1:7 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
Each said to his neighbor, “Come, let us cast lots and learn on whose account this calamity is among us.” They cast lots, and the lot fell on Jonah.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT jonah-section-1-v1-8]
Jonah 1:8 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
They said to him, “Tell us on whose account this calamity is among us. What is your occupation? Where do you come from? What country and what people are you from?”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT jonah-section-1-v1-9]
Jonah 1:9 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
He said to them, “I am a servant of the Lord, and I worship the Lord, the God of heaven, who made the sea and the dry land.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT jonah-section-1-v1-10]
Jonah 1:10 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
The men were greatly afraid and said to him, “What is this you have done?” For the men knew that he was fleeing from the presence of the Lord, because he had told them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT jonah-section-1-v1-11]
Jonah 1:11 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
They said to him, “What shall we do to you, so that the sea may subside for us?” For the sea kept raising a greater surge.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT jonah-section-1-v1-12]
Jonah 1:12 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
Jonah said to them, “Lift me up and throw me into the sea; then the sea will subside for you. For I know that this great surge is upon you because of me.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT jonah-section-1-v1-13]
Jonah 1:13 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
But the men strained to return to land and could not, for the sea kept rising more fiercely against them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT jonah-section-1-v1-14]
Jonah 1:14 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
They cried out to the Lord and said, “By no means, Lord! May we not perish for this man’s life, and do not lay innocent blood upon us, for Thou, Lord, hast done as Thou didst wish.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT jonah-section-1-v1-15]
Jonah 1:15 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
They took Jonah and threw him out into the sea, and the sea stopped its tossing.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT jonah-section-1-v1-16]
Jonah 1:16 [COMPARED; RETAINED]
The men feared the Lord with great fear, offered a sacrifice to the Lord and made vows.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT jonah-section-4-v4-9]

[UNIT jonah-section-4-v4-11]

=== Micah ===

--- Micah 1 ---

[UNIT micah-section-1-v1-1]
Micah 1:1
The word of the Lord came to Michaiah of Morashthi in the days of Jotham, Ahaz and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, concerning what he saw about Samaria and Jerusalem.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT micah-section-1-v1-2]
Micah 1:2
Hear words, you peoples! Let the earth and everyone in it attend! The Lord will be among you as a testimony, the Lord from His holy house.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT micah-section-1-v1-3]
Micah 1:3
For look, the Lord is coming out of His place; He will descend and step upon the heights of the earth,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT micah-section-1-v1-4]
Micah 1:4
and the mountains will be shaken beneath Him, and the valleys will melt like wax before fire and like water flowing downhill.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT micah-section-1-v1-5]
Micah 1:5
All this is because of Jacob’s impiety and the sin of Israel’s house. What is Jacob’s impiety? Is it not Samaria? And what is the sin of Judah’s house? Is it not Jerusalem?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT micah-section-1-v1-6]
Micah 1:6
I will make Samaria a fruit watcher’s hut in a field and a vineyard plantation. I will pull her stones down into a chasm and uncover her foundations.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT micah-section-1-v1-7]
Micah 1:7
They will cut up all her carved images and burn all her wages in fire, and I will consign all her idols to obliteration. For she gathered from prostitution wages and amassed from prostitution wages.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT micah-section-1-v1-8]
Micah 1:8
Because of this she will lament and mourn; she will go barefoot and naked. She will make lamentation like dragons and mourning like daughters of sirens.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT micah-section-1-v1-9]
Micah 1:9
For her blow has prevailed; it came as far as Judah and touched the gate of My people, as far as Jerusalem.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT micah-section-1-v1-10]
Micah 1:10
You in Gath, do not magnify yourselves! You in Akim, do not rebuild from a house for laughter; sprinkle yourselves with earth in keeping with your laughter.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT micah-section-1-v1-11]
Micah 1:11
Dwelling well in her cities, the inhabitant of Sennaan did not come out to mourn the house adjoining her; she will receive from you a blow of pain.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT micah-section-1-v1-12]
Micah 1:12
Who began good things for the woman dwelling in pains? For calamities came down from the Lord upon Jerusalem’s gates,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT micah-section-1-v1-13]
Micah 1:13
the noise of chariots and horsemen. Inhabitant of Lachish, she is a leader of sin to the daughter of Zion, for Israel’s impieties were found in you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT micah-section-1-v1-14]
Micah 1:14
Therefore you will give away those being sent as far as the inheritance of Gath—vain houses; it became empty things for Israel’s kings.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT micah-section-1-v1-15]
Micah 1:15
Until I bring heirs to you, O inheritance dwelling in Lachish, the glory of Israel’s daughter will come as far as Odollam.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT micah-section-1-v1-16]
Micah 1:16
Shave yourself and shear your hair for your delicate children. Enlarge your widowhood like an eagle, for they have been taken captive away from you.
[/UNIT]

--- Micah 2 ---

[UNIT micah-section-2-v2-1]
Micah 2:1
They became people planning troubles and working evil on their beds, and at daybreak they carried them out, because they did not raise their hands to God.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT micah-section-2-v2-2]
Micah 2:2
They coveted fields and plundered orphans, oppressed houses and plundered a man and his house, a man and his inheritance.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT micah-section-2-v2-3]
Micah 2:3
Therefore thus says the Lord: “Look, I am planning calamities against this tribe, from which you will certainly not lift your necks, and you will certainly not suddenly walk upright, for it is an evil time.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT micah-section-2-v2-4]
Micah 2:4
On that day a parable will be taken up against you, and a lament will be sung in melody, saying: ‘We have suffered grievous misery! The portion of My people was measured with a cord, and there was no one to prevent him from turning away; our fields were divided.’
[/UNIT]

[UNIT micah-section-2-v2-5]
Micah 2:5
Therefore you will have no one casting a measuring cord by lot in the assembly of the Lord.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT micah-section-2-v2-6]
Micah 2:6
Do not weep with tears, nor let them shed tears over these things, for he will not reject reproaches.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT micah-section-2-v2-7]
Micah 2:7
The one who says, ‘Jacob’s house has provoked the Lord’s Spirit’: Are these his practices? Are not his words good with him, and have they walked uprightly?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT micah-section-2-v2-8]
Micah 2:8
And formerly My people stood opposed in enmity; facing his peace, they flayed his skin to take away hope—a shattering of war.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT micah-section-2-v2-9]
Micah 2:9
Therefore the leaders of My people will be cast out of their luxurious houses; because of their evil practices they were expelled. Draw near to everlasting mountains!
[/UNIT]

[UNIT micah-section-2-v2-10]
Micah 2:10
Rise and go, for this is no resting place for you because of uncleanness. You were corrupted with corruption,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT micah-section-2-v2-11]
Micah 2:11
you were pursued with no one pursuing. A spirit established falsehood; it dripped to you into wine and strong drink. And it will be from the drop of this people:
[/UNIT]

[UNIT micah-section-2-v2-12]
Micah 2:12
Jacob will surely be gathered with everyone. I will surely receive Israel’s remaining ones; I will put their turning back together. Like sheep in affliction, like a flock within their resting place, they will leap out from among people.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT micah-section-2-v2-13]
Micah 2:13
Through the breach before them they broke through, passed a gate and went out through it. Their king went out before them, and the Lord will lead them.”
[/UNIT]

--- Micah 3 ---

[UNIT micah-section-3-v3-1]
Micah 3:1
He will say: “Hear these things now, authorities of Jacob’s house and remaining ones of Israel’s house! Is it not for you to know justice,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT micah-section-3-v3-2]
Micah 3:2
you who hate good things and seek evil things, who snatch their skins from them and their flesh from their bones?”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT micah-section-3-v3-3]
Micah 3:3
Just as they ate the flesh of My people, flayed their skins from their bones, crushed their bones and divided them into pieces like flesh for a cauldron and meat for a cooking pot,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT micah-section-3-v3-4]
Micah 3:4
so they will cry to the Lord, but He will not listen to them. He will turn His face away from them at that time, because they acted wickedly in their practices against them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT micah-section-3-v3-5]

[UNIT habakkuk-section-1-v1-10]

[UNIT habakkuk-section-1-v1-11]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT habakkuk-section-1-v1-12]

Art Thou not from the beginning, Lord, my holy God? We shall certainly not die. Lord, Thou hast appointed him for judgment, and He formed me to reprove his discipline.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT habakkuk-section-1-v1-13]
Habakkuk 1:13
Thine eye is pure, not to see evil things, and Thou wilt not be able to look upon distress. Why dost Thou look upon despisers? Wilt Thou remain silent when the impious swallows the righteous?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT habakkuk-section-1-v1-14]
Habakkuk 1:14
Thou wilt make people like the fish of the sea and like creeping things with no leader.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT habakkuk-section-1-v1-15]
Habakkuk 1:15
They hauled up an entire catch with a hook, dragged it in a casting net and gathered it in their seines; therefore they will rejoice and their heart will be glad.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT habakkuk-section-1-v1-16]
Habakkuk 1:16
Therefore they will sacrifice to their seine and burn incense to their casting net, for through them they fattened their portion, and their foods are choice.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT habakkuk-section-1-v1-17]
Habakkuk 1:17
Therefore they will cast their casting net and will not spare nations from continual killing.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT habakkuk-section-2-v2-1]

I will stand at my watch and step onto a rock; I will look out to see what He will speak within me and what I shall answer concerning my reproof.

[UNIT habakkuk-section-2-v2-6]
Habakkuk 2:6
Will not all these take up a parable against him and a riddle for his account? They will say, ‘Woe to the one multiplying for himself what is not his—how long?—and heavily weighting his collar!’

[UNIT habakkuk-section-2-v2-7]

For suddenly those biting him will rise, and those plotting against you will awake; you will become their plunder.

[UNIT habakkuk-section-2-v2-8]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT habakkuk-section-2-v2-9]
Habakkuk 2:9
O you who acquire evil gain for your house, setting your nest on high to escape the hand of evils!
[/UNIT]

[UNIT habakkuk-section-2-v2-10]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT habakkuk-section-2-v2-11]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT habakkuk-section-2-v2-12]
Habakkuk 2:12
Woe to the one building a city with bloodshed and preparing a city with injustices!
[/UNIT]

[UNIT habakkuk-section-2-v2-13]
Habakkuk 2:13
Are these things not from the Lord Almighty? Many peoples failed in fire, and many nations lost heart.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT habakkuk-section-2-v2-14]
Habakkuk 2:14
For the earth will be filled with knowing the Lord’s glory, as water will cover them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT habakkuk-section-2-v2-15]
Habakkuk 2:15

[/UNIT]

[UNIT habakkuk-section-2-v2-16]
Habakkuk 2:16
Drink, you too, a fullness of dishonor instead of glory; be tossed and shaken! The cup of the Lord’s right hand has come around to you, and dishonor has gathered upon your glory.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT habakkuk-section-2-v2-17]
Habakkuk 2:17
For Lebanon’s impiety will cover you, and the misery of wild animals will terrify you, because of human bloodshed and impiety against land, city and all its inhabitants.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT habakkuk-section-2-v2-18]
Habakkuk 2:18

[/UNIT]

[UNIT habakkuk-section-2-v2-19]
Habakkuk 2:19

[/UNIT]

[UNIT habakkuk-section-2-v2-20]
Habakkuk 2:20
But the Lord is in His holy sanctuary; let all the earth revere Him.”

--- Habakkuk 3 ---

[UNIT habakkuk-section-3-v3-1]
Habakkuk 3:1
A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet, with a song.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT habakkuk-section-3-v3-2]
Habakkuk 3:2
Lord, I have heard Thy report and was afraid; I considered Thy works and was astonished. In the midst of two living creatures Thou wilt be known; when the years draw near Thou wilt be recognized; when the season arrives Thou wilt be revealed. When my soul is troubled, in wrath Thou wilt remember mercy.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT habakkuk-section-3-v3-3]
Habakkuk 3:3
God will come from Teman, the Holy One from a mountain shaded and thickly wooded. Diapsalma. His excellence covered the heavens, and the earth is full of His praise.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT habakkuk-section-3-v3-4]
Habakkuk 3:4
His brightness will be like light; horns are in His hands, and He established mighty love of His strength.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT habakkuk-section-3-v3-5]
Habakkuk 3:5
A word will go before Him, and He will go out, His feet in sandals.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT habakkuk-section-3-v3-6]
Habakkuk 3:6
He stood, and the earth shook; He looked, and nations melted. Mountains were crushed violently; everlasting hills melted.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT habakkuk-section-3-v3-7]
Habakkuk 3:7
I saw His everlasting journeys in place of toils; the dwellings of Ethiopians will be terrified, and the tents of the land of Midian.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT habakkuk-section-3-v3-8]
Habakkuk 3:8
Wast Thou angry with rivers, Lord? Was Thy fury against rivers, or Thine onrush against the sea, that Thou wilt mount Thy horses and Thy riding is salvation?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT habakkuk-section-3-v3-9]
Habakkuk 3:9
Thou wilt surely bend Thy bow against scepters, says the Lord. Diapsalma. The earth will be torn apart by rivers.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT habakkuk-section-3-v3-10]
Habakkuk 3:10
Peoples will see Thee and travail, as He scatters waters in His passage. The abyss gave its voice, the height of its appearance.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT habakkuk-section-3-v3-11]
Habakkuk 3:11
The sun was raised, and the moon stood in its appointed place. Thy missiles will go into light, into the brightness of Thy flashing weapons.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT habakkuk-section-3-v3-12]
Habakkuk 3:12
With threat Thou wilt diminish the earth, and in fury Thou wilt bring nations down.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT habakkuk-section-3-v3-13]
Habakkuk 3:13
Thou didst go out for Thy people’s salvation, to save Thine anointed ones. Thou didst cast death upon the heads of lawless people and didst raise bonds up to the neck. Diapsalma.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT habakkuk-section-3-v3-14]
Habakkuk 3:14
Thou didst cut the heads of rulers in bewilderment; they will be shaken in it. They will open their bridles like a poor person eating secretly.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT habakkuk-section-3-v3-15]
Habakkuk 3:15
Thou didst drive Thy horses into the sea as they troubled much water.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT habakkuk-section-3-v3-16]
Habakkuk 3:16
I kept watch, and my belly was terrified at the sound of the prayer of my lips. Trembling entered my bones, and my bodily condition beneath me was troubled. I will rest on a day of affliction, to go up to the people of my sojourning.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT habakkuk-section-3-v3-17]
Habakkuk 3:17
For the fig tree will not bear fruit, and vines will have no produce; the olive’s labor will fail, and fields will not produce food. Sheep have failed for lack of food, and there are no cattle at feeding troughs.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT habakkuk-section-3-v3-18]
Habakkuk 3:18
But I will exult in the Lord; I will rejoice in God my Savior.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT habakkuk-section-3-v3-19]
Habakkuk 3:19
The Lord God is my strength; He will set my feet toward completion and lead me onto the heights, to conquer in His song.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT zephaniah-section-1-v1-18]

[UNIT zephaniah-section-2-v2-15]

I said, “Only fear Me and accept discipline, and you will certainly not be destroyed from her eyes,” with all I exacted upon her. Prepare, rise early! All their gleaning has been ruined.

Zephaniah 3:8

=== Haggai ===

--- Haggai 1 ---

[UNIT haggai-section-1-v1-1]
Haggai 1:1
In the second year under King Darius, in the sixth month, on the first day of the month, the word of the Lord came through Haggai the prophet, saying: “Speak now to Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, from the tribe of Judah, and to Joshua, the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, saying:
[/UNIT]

[UNIT haggai-section-1-v1-2]
Haggai 1:2
‘Thus says the Lord Almighty: These people say, “The time has not arrived to rebuild the house of the Lord.”’”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT haggai-section-1-v1-3]
Haggai 1:3
The word of the Lord came through Haggai the prophet, saying:
[/UNIT]

[UNIT haggai-section-1-v1-4]
Haggai 1:4
“Is it time for you to live in your houses with recessed ceilings, while this house has been laid waste?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT haggai-section-1-v1-5]
Haggai 1:5
And now, thus says the Lord Almighty: Set your hearts upon your ways.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT haggai-section-1-v1-6]
Haggai 1:6
You sowed much and brought in little; you ate, but were not satisfied; you drank, but not to intoxication; you clothed yourselves, but were not warmed in them. The one gathering wages gathered them into a bundle with holes.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT haggai-section-1-v1-7]
Haggai 1:7
Thus says the Lord Almighty: Place your hearts upon your ways.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT haggai-section-1-v1-8]
Haggai 1:8
Go up onto the mountain, cut wood and rebuild the house. I will take pleasure in it and be glorified, said the Lord.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT haggai-section-1-v1-9]
Haggai 1:9
You looked for much, and it came to little; it was brought into the house, and I blew it away. Therefore, thus says the Lord Almighty: Because My house is desolate, while each of you hurries to his own house,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT haggai-section-1-v1-10]
Haggai 1:10
therefore heaven will hold back dew, and the earth will withhold its produce.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT haggai-section-1-v1-11]
Haggai 1:11
I will bring a sword upon the land and the mountains, upon grain, wine and oil, and whatever the earth produces, upon people and livestock, and upon all the labors of their hands.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT haggai-section-1-v1-12]
Haggai 1:12
Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, from the tribe of Judah, Joshua, the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and all the remnant of the people listened to the voice of the Lord their God and the words of Haggai the prophet, as the Lord their God had sent him to them. The people feared before the Lord.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT haggai-section-1-v1-13]
Haggai 1:13
Haggai, the messenger of the Lord, said to the people, “I am with you, says the Lord.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT haggai-section-1-v1-14]
Haggai 1:14
The Lord stirred up the spirit of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, from the tribe of Judah, the spirit of Joshua, the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of the remnant of all the people. They came in and were carrying out work on the house of the Lord Almighty, their God,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT haggai-section-1-v1-15]
Haggai 1:15
on the twenty-fourth day of the sixth month, in the second year under King Darius.
[/UNIT]

--- Haggai 2 ---

[UNIT haggai-section-2-v2-1]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT haggai-section-2-v2-2]
Haggai 2:2
“Speak now to Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, from the tribe of Judah, to Joshua, the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and to all the remnant of the people, saying:
[/UNIT]

[UNIT haggai-section-2-v2-3]
Haggai 2:3

[UNIT haggai-section-2-v2-4]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT haggai-section-2-v2-5]
Haggai 2:5

[/UNIT]

[UNIT haggai-section-2-v2-6]

[/UNIT]

[UNIT haggai-section-2-v2-7]
Haggai 2:7

[/UNIT]

[UNIT haggai-section-2-v2-8]
Haggai 2:8

=== Malachi ===

--- Malachi 1 ---

[UNIT malachi-section-1-v1-1]
Malachi 1:1
A pronouncement of the word of the Lord concerning Israel through His messenger. Take it to your hearts!
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-1-v1-2]
Malachi 1:2

[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-1-v1-3]
Malachi 1:3
but Esau I hated. I appointed his territories for desolation and his inheritance as gifts of a wilderness.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-1-v1-4]
Malachi 1:4
Because Idumea will say, “It has been overthrown; let us return and rebuild the deserted places,” thus says the Lord Almighty: “They will build, but I will overthrow. They will be called ‘Territories of Lawlessness’ and ‘A People Against Whom the Lord Has Drawn Up His Forces Forever.’”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-1-v1-5]
Malachi 1:5
Your eyes will see, and you yourselves will say, “The Lord has been magnified beyond Israel’s territories!”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-1-v1-6]
Malachi 1:6
“A son honors his father, and a slave his master. If I am a father, where is My honor? If I am a master, where is the fear of Me?” says the Lord Almighty. You priests who belittle My name! But you said, “How have we belittled Thy name?”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-1-v1-7]
Malachi 1:7
“By bringing polluted loaves to My altar.” But you said, “How have we polluted them?” “By your saying, ‘The Lord’s table is despised, and the foods placed upon it are despised.’”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-1-v1-8]
Malachi 1:8
“For if you bring a blind animal for sacrifice, is that not evil? If you bring one that is lame or sick, is that not evil? Bring it, then, to your ruler! Will he accept it? Will he show you favor?” says the Lord Almighty.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-1-v1-9]
Malachi 1:9
“And now appease the face of your God and plead with Him. These things have happened in your hands. Will I show favor to any of you?” says the Lord Almighty.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-1-v1-10]
Malachi 1:10
“For even among you doors will be shut, and you will not kindle My altar for nothing. I have no desire for you,” says the Lord Almighty, “and I will not accept a sacrifice from your hands.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-1-v1-11]
Malachi 1:11
“For from the sun’s rising to its setting, My name has been glorified among the nations, and in every place incense is brought to My name, together with a pure sacrifice, because My name is great among the nations,” says the Lord Almighty.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-1-v1-12]
Malachi 1:12
“But you profane it by your saying, ‘The Lord’s table is polluted, and the foods placed upon it are despised.’
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-1-v1-13]
Malachi 1:13
“And you said, ‘These things are from hardship,’ and I blew them away,” says the Lord Almighty. “You were bringing things seized by force, the lame and the afflicted. If you bring the sacrifice, shall I accept these things from your hands?” says the Lord Almighty.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-1-v1-14]
Malachi 1:14
“Cursed is one who was able, and had a male in his flock and a vow concerning it, yet sacrifices a damaged animal to the Lord. For I am a great King,” says the Lord Almighty, “and My name is manifest among the nations.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-2-v2-7]
Malachi 2:7
For a priest’s lips will guard knowledge, and people will seek law from his mouth, because he is the messenger of the Lord Almighty.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-2-v2-8]
Malachi 2:8
But you have turned aside from the way and weakened many through the law; you have corrupted the covenant of Levi,” says the Lord Almighty.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-2-v2-9]
Malachi 2:9
“And I have made you despised and neglected among all the nations, because you did not guard My ways but showed partiality in the law.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-2-v2-10]
Malachi 2:10
Did not one God create you? Is there not one Father of you all? Why have you each abandoned your brother, so as to profane the covenant of your fathers?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-2-v2-11]
Malachi 2:11
Judah has been abandoned, and an abomination has occurred in Israel and Jerusalem, because Judah profaned the Lord’s holy things, in which he delighted, and devoted himself to foreign gods.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-2-v2-12]
Malachi 2:12
The Lord will destroy the person who does these things, until he is also humbled away from Jacob’s dwellings and from those who bring a sacrifice to the Lord Almighty.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-2-v2-13]
Malachi 2:13
And you were doing these things that I hated: you covered the Lord’s altar with tears, with weeping and groaning from hardships. Is it still fitting to look toward a sacrifice or accept it from your hands?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-2-v2-14]
Malachi 2:14
And you said, “For what reason?” Because the Lord bore witness between you and the wife of your youth, whom you abandoned, though she is your partner and the wife of your covenant.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-2-v2-15]
Malachi 2:15
And no other did it, and there was a remnant of his spirit. And you said, “What else does God seek but offspring?” So guard your spirit, and do not abandon the wife of your youth.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-2-v2-16]
Malachi 2:16
But if, after hating her, you send her away, says the Lord, the God of Israel, impiety will cover your thoughts, says the Lord Almighty. So guard your spirit, and you must not abandon.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-2-v2-17]
Malachi 2:17
You who provoke God with your words! And you said, “How have we provoked Him?” By your saying, “Everyone who does evil is good before the Lord, and He has delighted in them,” and, “Where is the God of righteousness?”
[/UNIT]

--- Malachi 3 ---

[UNIT malachi-section-3-v3-1]
Malachi 3:1
“Look, I am sending out My messenger, and he will look to a way before My face. Suddenly the Lord whom you seek will come to His own sanctuary, and the messenger of the covenant whom you desire. Look, he is coming,” says the Lord Almighty.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-3-v3-2]
Malachi 3:2
And who will endure the day of his entrance? Or who will stand at his appearance? For he enters like a smelting fire and like launderers’ herb.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-3-v3-3]
Malachi 3:3
He will sit, smelting and purifying as with silver and gold. He will cleanse the sons of Levi and melt them like gold and silver, and they will be those who bring a sacrifice to the Lord in righteousness.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-3-v3-4]
Malachi 3:4
And the sacrifice of Judah and Jerusalem will please the Lord, as in the days of old and as in the former years.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-3-v3-5]
Malachi 3:5
“I will draw near to you in judgment, and I will be a swift witness against sorceresses, adulteresses and those who swear falsely by My name, against those who withhold a hired worker’s wages, those who oppress a widow, those who strike orphans with their fists, those who turn aside the judgment of a sojourner, and those who do not fear Me,” says the Lord Almighty.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-3-v3-6]
Malachi 3:6
“For I am the Lord your God, and I have not changed. But you, sons of Jacob, do not refrain
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-3-v3-7]
Malachi 3:7
from the injustices of your fathers. You have turned aside from My ordinances and have not guarded them. Return to Me, and I will return to you,” says the Lord Almighty. And you said, “How shall we return?”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-3-v3-8]
Malachi 3:8
“Will a human defraud God? Yet you are defrauding Me.” And you will say, “How have we defrauded Thee?” “Because the tithes and the firstfruits are with you.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-3-v3-9]
Malachi 3:9
And you keep looking away, yet you are defrauding Me. The nation has been brought to an end.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-3-v3-10]
Malachi 3:10
And you brought all the produce dues into the storehouses, and his plunder will be in his house. Examine, then, by this,” says the Lord Almighty, “whether I will not open heaven’s floodgates for you and pour out My blessing for you until there is enough.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-3-v3-11]
Malachi 3:11
And I will give you instructions for food, and I will certainly not destroy the fruit of your land, and your vine in the field will certainly not grow weak,” says the Lord Almighty.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-3-v3-12]
Malachi 3:12
“All the nations will call you blessed, because you will be a desirable land,” says the Lord Almighty.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-3-v3-13]
Malachi 3:13
“You have made your words heavy against Me,” says the Lord. And you said, “How have we spoken against Thee?”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-3-v3-14]
Malachi 3:14
You said, “The one who serves God is futile. What advantage is there because we guarded His observances and because we walked as supplicants before the Lord Almighty?
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-3-v3-15]
Malachi 3:15
And now we call outsiders blessed. All who practice lawlessness are being built up; they opposed God and were saved.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-3-v3-16]
Malachi 3:16
Those who feared the Lord spoke these things, each to his neighbor. The Lord paid attention and listened, and He wrote a book of remembrance before Him for those who feared the Lord and revered His name.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-3-v3-17]
Malachi 3:17
“They will be Mine,” says the Lord Almighty, “for a day that I am making for an acquisition, and I will choose them as a man chooses his son who serves him.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-3-v3-18]
Malachi 3:18
And you will return and see the distinction between the righteous and the lawless, and between one who serves God and one who does not serve.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-3-v3-19]
Malachi 3:19
For look, the day of the Lord is coming, burning like an oven, and it will burn them. All the foreigners and all who practice lawlessness will be straw, and the coming day will ignite them,” says the Lord Almighty, “and neither root nor branch will remain from them.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-3-v3-20]
Malachi 3:20
But for you who fear My name, a sun of righteousness will rise, and healing in its wings; you will go out and leap like little calves released from bonds.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-3-v3-21]
Malachi 3:21
You will trample the lawless, because they will be ashes beneath your feet on the day that I am making,” says the Lord Almighty.
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-3-v3-22]
Malachi 3:22
“And look, I am sending you Elijah the Tishbite before the coming of the Lord’s great and manifest day,
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-3-v3-23]
Malachi 3:23
who will restore a father’s heart toward a son and a person’s heart toward his neighbor, lest I come and strike the land utterly.”
[/UNIT]

[UNIT malachi-section-3-v3-24]
Malachi 3:24
“All of you, remember the law of Moses My servant, as I commanded him at Horeb for all Israel, ordinances and judgments.”
[/UNIT]
